tei:div.tei:p: mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/ṭ+wāṃX sngi ṭaṃX rdongh+ru+oṭ+wāṃ ༷ṭ+wāṃ twa/997

dpar sbongs dang por deb grangs 1༷༷༷ 1lngaṭha7stu17ci stuspu spyo10ba 1000 dzu0ji1 dzi3’ 1997shāchirdordoltapyiḍi 16shārdo0 5dzi‘lnga 140balnga3 1khu /)ba15dzi731 smokam pu ṭar 'debs 'dzugs pa/ser smad dpe mdzod khang gi kam pu ṭar sde tshan/dzutram̐/shāsbya shā7sbyistu~Xbyikhu stu~Xpyirlo ༷di5shā~X3༵rdo ser smad dpe mdzodi khang nas dpar bskrun zhus/byaXdi~Xswāshāsmoṭī༈6me+eṭ+wāṃ0 shādzicisdurnyidi~Xshā~Xshāba~Xr+harnyi1shā~X rā1)13514smo501dzi’ 1dud+kung 8spyolngasmolnga’ 1baspu13 271ba dzi61ba1bsku1lnga

mngonartogasargyanagyiṭik+kabashadabasgrigasastanang / su byas pa las skabs brgyad kyi tshig 'grel bzhugs 5saku0sa༅1 06rdo༅/6/two sa6twa 55memadzad pa po/ co ne rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub/dzu( badziX/ོ ༷rdob/༵bye+oXbyeX//smodzispusde95rngu5cab 5spurdoskrerteX |rte+obye ༷༷/lngasnulnga 0ba

dkar chaga.ang / bsdusang tshan/ shog grangs/skabs dang po/ka ched brdzod/ 11kha rtsom pa po'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus/ 13sngon du 'gro ba spyi'i rnam bzhag bshad pa la gdul bya bsnan pa la 'jug tshul/ 172 rje btsun gyis mdodo na bshad thabs yan lag lnga yis bkral tshul/ 1ṭha3 skabs su babs pa'i gzhung don so sor bshad pa la/ 214 klad kyi don la mtshan don dang / 'gyur phyag 32lta bshad pa la 'jug pa/ mchod brjod dang / bshad pa dam bca'/ 3ltaca bshad pa nye bar 'god pa la dgos don/ 3ca7 bsdus don la/ lus mdor bstan pa dngos po brgyad so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams 2rngu

2 dkar chaga.ang / gzhung tshan/ shog grangs/mkhyen gsum gyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la// sems bskyed sogs chos bcu so sor bshad pa/ 31ṭha lam shes mtshon byed chos bcu gcig so sor bshad pa/ 3ca1༷ bzhi shes mtshon byed chos dgu so sor bshad pa/ 4༷11 rnam sbyor mtshon byed chos bcu gcig so sor bshad pa/ 4 ra13 rtse sbyor mtshan byed chos brgyad so sor bshad pa/ 4rngu13 mthar gyi sbyor ba'i lus rgyas bshad dang chos thas/glu ngan/snaskyob/ ni ༷14 skad cig sbyor ba'i lus rgyas bshad dang chos bzhi/ lta11lta 'bras bu chos sku'i lus rgyas bshad/ lta1tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad pa la/1ca sems bskyed dang gdams ngag 7317 dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa/ lta71rngu nges 'byed cha mthun/ 7lnga1lnga dmigs rnam rgyu chung 'bring gi khyad par/ 7gyi

dkar chag 365nga / gzhung tshan/ shog grangs/3༷ sbang bya'i khyad par dang yangs 'dzin gyi /byad par/ ca431 zeg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs/ cuca23 rigs la rtsod spong 'chad pa dang sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ ca723 theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ 7༷24 go sgrub dang 'jug sgrub/ 712lta tshogs sgrub dang yongs sbyong bye brag tu bshad pa/ 723ca sa bcu pa mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas 'chad tshul dang nges 'byung sgrub pa bshad/ 1skabs gnyis pa/lam shes kyi tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad 27 'dir lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang lam shes kyi 44na lag 73/ khyab pa'i don bye brag tu bshad pa/ /lnga3lnga nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ ṭha3

4 dkar chaga.ang / bsdusang tshan/ shog grangs/3༷ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ ṭhaca31 theg chen mthong lam mdor bstan rgyas bshad/ lngaṭha32 theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa/ 1༷333 mos pa sgom lam dngos/ 1༷43dze bsngo ba sgom lam/ 1༷ca3lta rjes su yid rang sgom lam/ 1༷rngu34 sgrub pa sgom lam/ 10lnga37 rnam dag sgom lam la rgyu dang yul gyi khyad par/ 1113/ gsum pa 'bras bu'i khyad par/ 1133lnga bzhi pa ngo bo la rnam dag shin tu ba yin min khyad par/ 1144༷ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba sgrub pa/ 11ltaskabs gsum pa/bzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa/41 skabs 'dir bzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 117

dkarachag 5ang / gzhung tshan/ shog grangs/42 nye ring gi rgyu mtshan dang de nyid bsgrub pa/ 11khyagasum pa mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po phyogs kyi dbye ba bshad pa la/43 dang po bzhi lam la mtshan 'dzin spang gnyen/ 12༷44 gnyis pa 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang gnyen/ 1324lta gsum pa mjug bsdu ba/ 123gnyis pa gzhi shes sbyor ba bshad pa la gnyis las/4tsu dang po sems dpa'i bzhi shes sbyor ba'i tsho ba/ 12447 gnyis pa sbyor ba'i rang bzhin mnyam nyid/ 12ltagasum̐ pa sbyor ba sgom pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa la gnyis las/4rngu dang po mthong lam skad cig ma mdor bstan pa/ 12caganyis pa rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa la/4lnga dang po rnam pa so sor bshad pa/ 127ltaX gnyis pa don bsdu ba/ 13༷lta1 gnyis pa mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba/ 131

6 dkar chaga.ang / bsdusang tshan/ shog grangs/skabs bzhi pa/lta2 skabs 'dir rnam ljoḍa sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 13ltalta3 mi mazun phyogs kyi gnyen po rnam pa'i bye brag mdor bstan pa/ 13cuganyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum las/lta4 dang po gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun/ 137lta7 gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug 13lnga7ca gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu/ 142lta7 bden 'dzin dngos su 'joms byed kyi sbyor ba khyad par can bshad pa/ 14caltarngu sbyor ba'i yon tan dang sbyor ba'i skyon/ 14jiltaṭha sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la mdor bstan pa/ 17༷cuX rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi las dang po shes mtshan/ 171ca1 gnyis pa khyad mtshan bshad pa/ 1ltacaca2 gsum pa byed mtshan bshad pa/ 1ltarngu

dkar chag 7ang / bsdusang tshan/ shog grangs/tsu3 ngo bo nyid mtshan bshad pa/ 1caXtsu4 mthar pa cha mthun nas bzung ste rgyud la skyes ba'i rim pa bshad pa/ 1ca3cu7 rgyud smin byed nges byed cha mazun bshad pa/ 1ca7cucu sbyor lam phyir mi ldog si rtags/ 1cacutsu7 marmonge lam phyir mi lngog gi rtags/ 1tsugyitsu/ sgom lam rgyas par bshad pa/ 173cuṭha grangs nges kyi rtsod spong / 1737༷ byed las la rtsod spong la don dam dang tha snyad la bltos pa'i gnyis/ 17471 sgom lam phyir mi snog gi rtags/ 17cu72 srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba dang de'i klan ka bzhi/ 17ca73 zhing dag sbyor ba dang thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang bdud bzhi'i khyad par/ 17ṭha

8 dkar chagacagang / bsdusang tshan/ shog grangs/skabs 'u/ pa/74 rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 1/777 sbyor lam rtse sbyor so se'i rtags bshad pa/ 1rngulta7tsu mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya rtog pa mdor bsnan/ 1/ṭha77 rgyas bshad la gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhir dgu re dbye ba/ 1ṭhaX7ji gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi rgyu dang 'bras bu byang chen ngos bzung ba/ 1lnga77lnga dngos po bden grub khas len pa la rigs pa dang lung gi 'gal ba/ 1lngacarnguX dbu ma pas chos thams cad bden stong khas len dgos par bstan pa/ 1ṭha7rngu1 mthong lam̐ rtse sbyor dngos dang spangs pa la dbang byed pa/ 1lnga/khu2 gnyen potho da rgal gyi sgom lam rtse sbyor/ 2༷0/3 spang bya rtog pa bzhir dgu dgu dbye ba/ 2༷2

dkar chag 965nga / bsdusang tshan/ shog grangs/rngu4 de spangs pa'i phan yon/ 3༷calha7 bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dngos bshad pa/ 2༷7rngutsu bsal bya log rtog bcu drug 2༷rngo/7 skabs drug pa/ mthar gyis sbyor ba/ 211ṭ+wāṃrngu skabs bdun pa/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ 211skabs brgyad pa/rngulnga skabs 'dir chos sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 217༅༷ ngo bo nyid sku khyad chos gsum lngan/ 21/gyi1 ye shes chos sku dngos la sde mtshan nyer gcig 21gyilnga2 'phags seng gnyis kyis 'grel tshul khyad par/ 331lnga3 nyon mongs med dang smon gnas mkhyen pa'i stang nges 'dzin bshad pa/ 232lnga4 chos sku rtag pa la rtsod spong / 223༅7 khyab rtag gnyis ka la rtsod spong / 224

10 dkarachagadzigang / gzhung tshan/ shog grangs/ṭhaca longs sku mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas mdor bsnan pa/ 327lnga7 mtshan so gnyis dang sgrub byed kyi rgyu/ 32cuṭharngu dpe byed bzang po brgyad bcu/ 23lngalnga② mchog gi sprul sku bshad pa/ 2311༷༷ mdzad pa 'phrin las mdor bstan/ 3331༷1 lam dang 'bras bu la 'god pa bcas 'phrin las ter bdun/ 3341༷2 bsdus don gzhan la/ drug dang gsum du bsdu tshul/ 2371༷3 dpar byang smon tshig 241

11ched brdzod/༈ ser smad thos bsam nor gling grwa tshang gi dpe mdzod khang nas/rang re gangs can bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang rig gzhung mi nyams rgyun 'dzin dang / nyams pa slar gse'i thabs lam gong 'phel du gtong ba'i 'gan 'khur rkang 'dzin 'og grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi yig chas gtsos ris med bsungs rab sna cho+ogs mu mazud dpar 'grems zhu yod na'ang / deng gi char grwa tshang 'di nyid phyi nang gang cir yar rgyas ches cher phyin te/ thos bsam slob gnyer ba'ang lo re bzhin nge mang du 'gro bzhin par brten/ grwa tshang gi yig cha dkon drags snabs kyis/ser smad dpe mdzod khang gi las byed thun mong nas gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug co ni rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka bshad bsgrigs su bkod pa/ 'di nyid par 'grems zhu rgyur bsam gros gcig mthun gyi 'char 'god thog da lam dpe mdzod khang nas gong gsal phyag dpe deb gzugs grangs 1༷༷༷ tham pa dpar bskrun zhus pa dang chabs cig du lhag bsamagyis yangs su phyug cing dad pa dang gtong phod yangs pa'i bstan sbyin chen po sku zhabs bde khang bsod nams bstan 'dzin lags dang / sku zla bkrin dpal sgron lags rnam

12 chedabarjod/gnyis nas sku gshegs tshe smon gling bde skyid khang gsar gzim shag sku ngo mkhan chung thub bstan nyi ma mchog gi bkrin ched gsos dang grwa tshang 'dir zhabs 'degs la dmigs te/ thugs 'khur che bzhed kyis gong gsal phyag deb grangs ltaX tsam gyi par bskrun rgyu sbyor cha tshang gnang bar 'di ga dpe mdzod khang gi las byed thun mong nas thugs rje lan brgyar che zhes zhu zhing / dpar du bskrun pa'i dge rtsa rlabs po che 'di dag gi mazu la brten nas/ rgyal bsnan spyi dang bye brag 'jam mgon bla ma'i bzhed srol tshang la ma nor ba 'di nyid dang / khyad par grwa tshang 'di'i bshad sgrub 'chad nyan sogasami nyams yun du gnas pa/ bsnan 'dzin gyi skye chen dam pa rnams sku tshe brten cing mdzad bzang phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i mthu las/ gong gi mazun 'gyur byed po rnam pa gnyis kyi thugs dgongs lhun gyi grub pa/ de bzhin rigs brgyud sbun 'khor/ dge grogs 'phyogs rgyas rta mgrin dbang phyug gtsos ma 'gyur rigs drug sems can rnams dal brgyud rim sbyang bla med byang sems chen po gang myur 'thob pa'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu dang bcas/ser smad dpe mdzod khang nas 1lngalnga7 zla tsu tshes shar dge ba la//

13rtsom pa po'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus/༈ co ne+e grags pa bshad sgrub ni mdo smad co ne dpon gyis mnga' 'og zu'u ju'i yul gyi bye brag g.yo sa'am/ rab po zhes par yab skyabs 'bum dang / yum skal bzang sman gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gcig shing yas phyi lo 1tsu7lta lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun la khre chen dge 'dun grags pa'i mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog slob pa'i dbu btsugs/ dgung lo dgu la rje 'di'i drung du rab byung bsgrubs/ de nas ma 'ga' yi ring chos spyod sogs blo 'dzin mdzad/ sman pa stag ris dge slong drung nas sman dpe gsan sbyong sgas nad bcos kyi bya ba cung zad sgrub/ dgung lo nyer gcig la dbus phyogs su phebs/ dgung lo nyer gnyis lor ser smad thos bsam nor gling grwa tshang du chos zhugs mdzad/rje bkra shis dpal bzang dge ba'i bshes gten du bsden nas gzhung chen bka' pod lngar gsan bsam gnang / dgung lo so gcig la lha ldan smon lam chen mor grwa skor gyis ming btags bzhes/ dbus su dus 'khrugs kyis sde srid sku gshegs / lo de'i zla ba brgyad par grub mtha' ris me da kyi 'dus sde nyi khri lhag tsam tshogs te smon lam 'phar ma'i sar slob dpon tshul khrims rin chen gyi bka' bzhin ma tshan btags bzhes/ rje nyid

14 mdzad rnam snying bsdus/gtsang bkra shis lhun por phebs nas paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes drung du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dbus su phebs nas dga' lngan dang /'bras spungs bcas su dam bca' bzhag pas tshang ma ngo mtshar ba byung zhing / dgung lo so gnyis la phebs skabs mdo smad co ne+e dgon du phyir phebs/ skabs der co ni bsnan pa'i mnga' bdag go shri nang so yes de nyid pho brang du gong ma mjal ba'i skabs kyi bka' mngags ltar nang sos shing rta lor dgon pa der mtshan nyid grwa tshang gsar du btsugs nas rje nyid dgung lo bzhi bcur phebs/ dgon pa de'i bla ma mdzad/ dgung lo zhe gcig lo rje 'di'i yum gshegs/ dgung lo zhe drug lor grwa tshang bla ma dgongs zhu mdzad nas lo bdun tsam ring mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang /sgra dang sman rtsis la sogs pa'i bsnan bcos brtsams/ gsung 'bum po ti bcu gcig bzhugs/ dgung lo nga drug lo slar yang dgon de'i khri la bzhugs/ dgung lo nga brgyad lo/ra rang dgon du rgyud pa grwa tshang btsugs te bla ma dang slob dpon zung 'brel du mdzad/ dgung lo re gnyis bar 'chad rtsom rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad mthar dgung lodo na bzhi tsam la ba/zhegs pa 63na nam snyam mo/ /

15mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka bshad bsgrigs su byas pa las skabs dang po'i tshig 'grel bsdokyigs so/ /༈ na mo ār+ya mi tri ye/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i ston pa shākya'i tog /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /shing rta chen po klu sgrub thogs med sogs/ /'dzam gling rgyan sdo/ra rnams la phyag 'tshal lo / / rgyal sras smra ba'i khyu mchog seṅge bzang / /rgyal ba'i dmochos kun 'dzin tsong kha pa/ /rgyal tshab mkhas grub rje btsun bstan dar sogs/ /dam pa'i bshes gnyen rnams la gus btud nas/ /sher phyin rgya mtsho'i sbas don rin chen gyi/ /bzhin ras rgyan gyi me long dwangs pa'i ngos/ /'char kun gsal bar ston pa'i thabs kyi mchog /ṭik+ka snang byed sgron me sbar bar bya/ /de la 'dir rang cag rnams kyi ston pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dren pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis/'u'i/can mtha' dag sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog la 'god pa'i ched du/dang por byang chub mchog tu zugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsumodu tshogs bsags/ /mthar bla med byang chub mngon du ma dzad nas

16 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'khor 61 ngem pa gsum bskor zhing / de las brdzod bya'i ngos nas rab dang phul du gyur pa ni/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum po 'di nyid yin te/ 'di'i bstan don dngos la bstan stong nyid gtso bor snon pa'i rim pa dang / sbas don mngon rtogs ston pa'i rim pa gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rtsa ba shes rab la sogs pa dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug mdzad/ phyi ma gtso bor 'grel pa la/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos bsnan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyarme sogs mdzad pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi nang nas phyi ma'i dgongs pa gtso bor 'grel ba'i dbang du byas na/ de yang rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i shing rta chen potho gas med ces bya ba de nyid kyis rje btsun byams mgon bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs te/ yum gyi mdo'i tshig don ma lus pa rdzogs par gsan zhing / rje btsun gyis/ kyang phyis rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du sher phyin gyi mdo'i sbas don zams cad phyin ci ma log pa rdzogs par 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 'di nyid mdzad nas gnang bas/ slar 'dzam bu'i gling du byon te dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas dar rgyas su mdzad la/

skabs dngapo'iṭik+ka/ 17'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos kyang de nyid yin te/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i brdzod bya zab pa dang rgya che ba'i phyogs gnyis ma lus pa mngon sum du gzigs pa ni sangs rgyas nyan gcig yin yang / rje btsun 'di nyid ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyis rang gi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur zhing / yum gyi mde'i dgongs pa rdzogs par 'grel pa la bka'i snang ba dngos su thob par ma zad/ thun mong ma yin pa nges pa'i don nyad du rje btsun 'dis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang brnyes pas rang stobs spyi'irtsakyang yum gyi mde'i dgongs pa mtha' dag phyin ci galog par 'grel nus pa'i phyir/ gal te 'dir rgyan gyi mtshan la bsnan bcos zhes 'byung bas rje btsun nyid byang sems dngos yin nam zhe na/ skyon med de/ bstan bcos kyi sgra bshad du yod pa la dgongs shing / gdul bya thun mong ba rnams rjes su bzung ba'i ched du rje btsun nyid byang sems kyi tshul bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas re zhig de ltar du khas len pa mi 'gal ba'i phyir/despon bstan bcos 'di'i tshig don 'chad par byed pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba sbyi'i rnam gzhag bshad pa dang / skabs su babs pa'i gzhung don so sor bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ /༈ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyid zar 'dod kyi 'jug ngogs su bstan

18 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/nas de la 'jug pa'i tshul bshad pa dang / rgyan gyis mdo 'chad pa'i bshad thabs ji ltar yin pa'i tshul bshad pa dang bcas pa gnyis/ dang po ni / thar 'dod kyi skyes bu rnams kyi 'jug ngogs bla na med pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid yin la/ de yang rgyal ba dang des bstan pa'i chos dang de sgrub pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su song ba'i sgo nas de'i bstan pa la 'jug rigs pa yin te/ spel mar bstod pa las/ de ring gang la skyabs su 'chi/ /gang la nyes pa thams cad kun/ /gtan nas yong ye mi mnga' zhing / /gang zhig la ni yon tan kun/ /rnam pa kun tu gnas gyur pa/ /gal te sems shig yod na ni/ /de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro sang / /de bstod de ni bkur ba dang / /de yi bstan la gnas par rigs / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'jug bya rgyal ba'i bsnan pa de la gnyis yod de/ lung gi bstan pa dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis la 'jug pa'i tshul yod de/ lung gi bsnan pa la 'chad nyan dang 'brel ba'i thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'jug pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa la nyams len dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'jug dgos pa'i phyir/bsnan pa gnyis 'dzin pa yang tshul de gnyis kyi sgo nas yin te/ de skad du'ang mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 19lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzen byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung gi bstan pa la zos bsam gyis 'jug tshul yod de/ sde snod dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ci rigs dang por bzhan la thos nas bzhan snobs kyis nges par byed pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa thos pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa yin la/ de nas de'i don rang stobs kyis nges par byed pa ni bsam pa'i sgo nas 'jug tshul yin pa'i phyir/rtogs pa'i bstan pa la sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'jug tshul yod de / bslab gsum yan lag dang bcas pa ci rigs rang rgyud la bsten nas gzhung don la yang yang dpyod cing 'dris pa dang de la yid rtse gcig tu gnas par byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig la 'dor len tshul bzhin byed pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun gyis mdo'i don bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas bshad pa yin te /dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan dang lnga'i sgo nas 'chad par byed pa'i phyir/de yang yin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ /zhes sogs kyis dgos don dang / shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brdzod/ /ces pa'i bar dang/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba

20 mngonartogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/dang / / zhes pa nas/don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bsdus don dang /sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes pa nas/rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gyis tshig don dang / de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /ces pa nas/ de nas sesmre rnam bsgyings pa'i/ /zhes pas mtshams sbyar dang / chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /zhes sogs dang / de la klan ka spangs pa yis/ /zhes sogs dang /dngos po brdzod du med pa la/ /zhes d+dho gas dang / 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /zhes sogs kyis brgal lan gyi sgo nas bshad cing mtshams sbyar phal cher shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ bshad thabs de lār bstan pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ dgos don gyis dgos pa dang / bsdus don gyis lam gyi lus dang / tshig don gyis mtha' chodi pa dang / mtshams sbyar gyis snga phyi'i 'brel dang / brgal lan gyis 'gal med du shes par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yad pa'i phyir te/de ltar yang rnam bshad rig pa las/ mdodo na smra ba rnams la ni/ /ngas ni man ngag sbyin par bya/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig done bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /zhes dang /

skabs dngapo'iṭik+ka/ 21zog mar dgos pa brdzod par bya/ /de sgrub de ni bsdus don la/ /bsdus pa'i don ni tshig don las/ /go rim rim pa snga phyi dag /mi 'gal ba ni gnyis las so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa skabs su babs pa'i gzhung don so sor bshad pa la / klad gyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don bshad pa dang gsum/dang po la/ mtshan gyi don dang / 'gyur gyi phyag bshad pa dang gnyis/dang po la/ mtshan bsgyur ba dang / mtshan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po/bstan bcas 'di'i mtshan la ci bya zhe na/ de yang rgya gar gyi skad du a lha sa ma ya zhes sogs su 'bod pa yin te/ bod skad du de la a lha sa ma ya ni mngon par rtogs pa/ a laṅka ra ni rgyan/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba/ pradz+nyā ni shes rab/ pā ra mi ta ni pha rol tu phyin pa/ u pa de sha sne man ngagashāsta ni bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bsnan bcos 'di chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan la de ltar brdzod pa'i rgyu mtshan yad de/khyodi la brton nas yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum gyi don rtogs par byed pas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ljan pas na bsnan bcos/don mngon par rtogs pa

22 ma ngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/brgyad gsal bar ston pas na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir rgyan gyi don gtso bor gsal byed kyi rgyan la byed pa yin te / skyes bu'i lus bzang po rgyan gyis spras pa gsal byed me long nang du shar ba dga' ba bskyed pa ltar yum gyi lus bzang po la mdzes byed don bdun cus spras pa gsal byed bstan bcos 'dir snang bas/ mkhas pa rnams dga' ba bskyed pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'gyur phyag ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'gyur gyi phyag yod de/ ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs shing shes bya la blo rgyas pas sangs rgyas dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa gzhung don bshad pa la/ bshad pa la 'jug pa dang / bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ mchod par brdzod pa dang / bshad par dam bcas pa dang gnyis/ dang po de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams/ zhes pa nas/ yum de la phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di'i don la yum mkhyen gsum la bsnod pa dang de la phyag 'tshal ba dang gnyis/ dang po sna/

skabs dang po'i ṭik+ka/ 23rigs can gsum las rten nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rang don du sdug //na spangs pa'i zhi ba myang 'das 'tshol ba po rnams chos can/ khyod 'bras bu sdug kun nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhir zhakhrid pa'i thabs yod de/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i kun shes te gzhi shes gang yin pa'i zabs de nyid kyis 'khrid par mdzad pa'i phyir/ rten 'gro ba la phan pa sgrub par byed pa'i byang 'phags rnams chos can/ khyod kyis 'bras bu 'jig rten gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi deni sgrub pa'i thabs yod de/ lam gsum bdag med par rtogs pa'i lam shes gang yin pa'i thabs de nyid kyis 'khrid par mdzad pa'i phyir/ rten thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos can/ khyod kyis 'bras bu bamod bya rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i sde snod rin po che sna tshogs pa 'di gsungs pa'i thabs yod de/ chos rnams kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi rnam pa thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i rnamomakhyen gang dang yang dag ldan pa'i thabs de la brten nas bskor ba'i phyir / mkhyen gsum chos can/ phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub nus pa'i yan tan dang ljan pa yin te/ rang sras nyan thos 'phags pa dang byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa ste rang rgyal dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnams kyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i yan tan rnams dang lngan pa'i

24 mngon rtogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/phyir / gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun chos can/ khyod kyis rgyan rtsom pa'i thog mar yum mkhyen gsum la phyag 'tshal ba yin te/ rang don dang bzhan don gyi dgos pa gnyis kyi sgo nas gus pas 'dud pa'i phyir/ gal te tshig rkang gsum pa'i gang zhes pa spyi sgra yin pas bye brag rnam mkhyen la ji ltar go zhe na/ de rnam mkhyen la go bar thal/ spyi sgra yin kyang mkhyen gsum la bstod pa'i skabs dang /thub rnams zhes pa'i tshig dang 'brel bas de la go ba'i phyir/ kha cig tshig rkang dang bar gnyis kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / rgyu lam shes med gsung pa ni mi 'thad de/ smo rang gnyis nyer zhir gakhrid pa'i thabs la ni rang rgyud kyi gzhi shes dgos shing / byang 'phags rnams kyis rang rgyud kyi lam shes la brten nas rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub par mdzad pa'i phyir te/ de rnams kyis rang rgyud kyis lam la ma brten par 'brel med gzhan zhig la brten nas de ltar mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na tshig rkang dang bar gnyis kyis rim pa bzhin mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / rgyu lam shes dngos su bstan par 'dod dgos te/ bzhan du don med kyi tshig tsam zhig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'o na/ 'dir bstan bcos lus kyi rim pa dang mi mthun par dang por bzhi shes de la bsnod pa

skabs dang po 'i ṭik+ka 25ci yon zhe na/ de ltar bstod pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i lam nyams len gyi rim pa dang mazun par bstod pa'i phyir/ de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byas rnam mkhyen 11 pa la/ lam shes rang rgyud la bskyed pa sngon du 'gro dgos shing /de'i sngon du skyes bu 'bring dang zun mong ba'i bsam pa sbyong dgos pa'i rim pa dang mthun par bstod pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag las thar 'dod med na ni lam shes mi skye la/ de ma skyes na/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen 'thebo par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa bshad pa nye bar dgod pa la/ dgos don dang /bsdus don dang / tshig don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po de nyid ston pa la / rnam pa thams cad mkhye/na nyid lam/ /zhes pa nas/ bya ba brtsams pa'i dgos pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ bstan bathe sa mngon par rtogs pa'i 41na chos can/ khu+o1ོda brtsams pa la yum gyi mdo dang zlos pa'i skyon med cing dgos pa yad de/khyod la brten nas yum gyi mdo'i don bde blag tu rtogs pa bzhes bya ba de khyod brtsams pa'i dgos pa yin pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos 'di chos can/ dgos pa khyad par can dang ldan te/ khyod la brten nas rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos

26 mngon rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/bcu yi bdag nyid can gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi don thos bsam gyi dran pa la bzhag nas blo gros dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'di chos can / brjod bya khyad par can dang lngan te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid kyis mngon sum du gzigs shing / der bsgrod pa'i lam rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu po gnas skabs don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad du phye ba ston pas yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum po 'di las bzhad pa gang yin pa de khyod kyi brjod bya yin pa'i phyir/ khyod kyi brdzod bya'i rim pa de rnams chos can/ gang zag gang yang rung bas rdzogs par nyams su myong ba ma yin te/ phyi rol pa dang nyan rang la sogs pas gzhan gyi rang lam nas rdzogs par nyams su len mi nus pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa bsdus don bshad pa la/ lus mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ 'chad bya 'chad byed mdor bstan pa dang / 'chad byed kyi rkang grangs bshad pa dang gnyis/dang po la/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad / / ces gsungs/ ngag don ni/ bsnan bcos 'di chos can/khyod kyis gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum

skabs dngapo'i ṭik+ka/ 27gyi don ni phyin ci ma log par gtan la phabra pa yin te/ khyod kyis rdzod byed la skabs brgyad dang brdzod bya la dngos po brgyad du phye ba de nyid kyis yang dag par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad byed kyi rkang grangs ngos bzung nas 'chad par byed pa la/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /ces pa nas/ chos kyi sku dang de rnams brgyad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/'di la tshig don dang / so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis / dang po la/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mkhyen pa gsum yod de/ shes bya'i rnam pa kun mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen nyid dang / theg pa gsum gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes nyid dang / de nas mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po thams cad shes pa'i bzhi shes nyid dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sbyor ba bzhi yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang / de'i rnam pa sgom pa la goms pa dbang du gyur pa'i rtse mor phyin pa'i rtse sbyor dang / de'i rnam pa sgom pa la brtan pa thob pa mthar gyis sbyor ba dang /skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ba'i skad cig sbyor ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mthar zug gi 'bras bu chos sku yod de/sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku dang bcas pa de ltar

28 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/na grangs rnam pa brgyad yad pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa la/ 'dir rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ chos bcu mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug de skabs 'dir bsnan pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi ma nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de / sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod pa'i phyir/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yad de/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na gnyis yod de/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i lam shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir / sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yad de/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang /theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / gnyen po'i phyogs kyi bzhi/ shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan

skabs dang po'i ṭik+ka/ 29nyid yod de/ mkhyen gsum gang rung gi rnam pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sbyor bas rdzogs par bsgomapa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shesade de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yad de/ brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod pa'i phyir༈ rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yod de/theg chen gyi sbyor lam thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi mkhyen gsum gang rung gi rnam pa nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na bzhi yod de/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor nas bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi bar bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ mthar gyis sbyong ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ mkhyen gsum gang rung gi rnam pa la brtan pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na bcu gsum ste/ phyin drug rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba drug dang / dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba gsum dang / lha dang gtong ba dang tshulokhrims rjes su dran pa'i de gsum dang dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis sbyong ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi

30 mngon rtogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar yad pa'i phyir/ skad cig sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yad de/ rtsol ba gcig gis byed pa la brten nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum go rim ma 'chol bar rdzogs par bsgom pa'i nus pa thob pas rab tu phye ba'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na bzhi yod de/ rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang / rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i de dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i de dang / gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ rgyun mtha'i sbyor dngos gang rung kho na na yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu chos sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/sbyor bzhi bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i thob bya mthar thug de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dge na bzhi yod de/ ngo bo nyid sku/ longs sku/sprul sku/ ye shes chos sku rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang / /zhes pa nas/rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag bamod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di'i skabs su/ mkhyen gsum gyi lus rgyas par bshad pa dang / sbyor bzhi'i lus rgyas par bshad pa dang / chos sku'i lus rgyas par bshad pa dang

skabasadang po 'i ṭik+ka/ 31gsum/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen dang lam shes dang gzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum/ /༈ dang po la/ mtshon byed kyi chos bcu ngos bzung ba dang /bstan bshad sbyar ba dang gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ sems bskyed pa dang zhes pa nas/ nges par 'byung bcas rnams/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs / 'di la'ang / tshig don dang / so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ shes bya chos can/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu yad de/ darnga po bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / gnyis pa gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa'i gdams ngag dang / gsum pa sgrub pa'i ngobo nges 'byed yan lag rnam pa bzhi dang / bzhi pa sgrub pa yi ni rten du gyur pa chos kyi dbyengs kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / lnga pa theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dag dang / drug pa de'i ched du gnyer bya chen po gsum dang / bdun pa phyin drug nyams su len pa 'i go cha'i sgrub pa dang / brgyad pa sbyor ba'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i 'jug sgrub dang / dgu pa tshogs sgrub dang / bcu pa nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen

32 mngon rte gas rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yad de/ gzhan don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs shing rang gi grogs rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gtso bo'i yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na nyer gnyis yod de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed nas sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar nyer gnyis yod pa'i phyir / sa mtshams pa/ོda de/ theg chen tshogs lam nas sangs shākyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi ched du gnyer bya thob pa'i thabs ma nor bar 'doms pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bkar gyur pa'i zeg chen gyi rdzod byed rnam dag de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa 'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yad de / rjes dran gyi gdams ngag dang / 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams )de de/ lam ma zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yad pa'i phyir/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/rang sga nyer len du gyur pa 'i theg chen thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su byuri ba'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/dbye na bzhi yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyo ra lam drod sogs bzhi yad pa 'i

skabs dang po'i ṭik+ka/ 33phyir /tsho sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam kho na na yod pa'i phyir / rigs kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ rang bzhin gnas rigarnga4 dang rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis yad pa'i phyir/ theg chen sbyor lam thebo pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i chos nyid gang zhig theg chen sgrub pa'i dngos kyi rten gzhi byed pa de/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs gyi mtshan nyid dang /sbyir chos waṃngs gang zhig ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na spyir lam du zhugs mozhugs kyi dbye bas gnyis yod kyang 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i dbang du byas na du ma yod de/ bcu gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ribatag tsam dang rang bzhin gnas ribs ni sems can thams cad la khyab kyang / theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs ni theg chen gyi tshomogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar dang / 'dir dngos bstan ni theg chen sbyore lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid yod de/ zeg chen sgrub pa 'i sgro 'dogs gcad bzhi de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum yod de/ dge mi

34 mngon rtogs rgyan gyiṭilko/dge lung ma bstan gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sa mchams ni phyogs re ba ma yin te/ shes bya thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba mthar thug gi mtshan nyid yad de/ gang gi ched du byang sems sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i thob bya mthar thug de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na spyor mang yang 'dir dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas na gsum sne/sems spong ba rtogs pa chen po gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa bzhi'i dang po go sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yad de/ phar phyin re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i skusashes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na so drug ste/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub nas shes rab kyi go sgrub kyi bar so drug yad pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen (1 tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir / 'jug sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yad de/ theg chen gyi sbyoralam thob pa'i snong nyid rtogs pa'i bsgoms byung gi shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas theg pa chen po'i rgyu 'bras kyi chos ci rigs pa sbyor ba lag len gtso bor byas nas nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yad de/ dgu yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de / theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar yad pa'i phyir/

skabs dang po'i ṭik+ka/ 35tshags sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yad de/ rang 'bras gnas skabs dang mthar zug gi byang chen gang rung dngos su 'byin pas rab tu phye ba'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir / nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yad de/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen gdon mi za bar 'byin par byed pa'i dag sa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ dag pa sa gsum kho na na yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/zub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces gsungs/ ngag don ni/ chos bcu po mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/rnam pa kun tu mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa nyid yin te/ thub pa'i dbang po'i mngon rtogs mthar zug yin pa'i phyir/ 'dis chos bcus rnam mkhyen mtshon tshul bsnan pa yin te/ de yang rgyus 'bras bu mtshon tshul cung zad bshad du rung mod/ slob dpon gyis yul gyis yul can mtshon pa'i dbang du mdzad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ ji ltar mtshon na bshad du yod de/ sems bskyed sogs chos bcu po mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes ni rnam mkhyen du 'jog /ces pa'i tshul gyis

36 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭilko/mtshon pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa lam shes kyi lus rgyas pa ra bshad pa la/ mtshon byed kyi chos dang / bstan 4'ad sbyar ba dang gnyis/ dang po de nyid 'chad pa la/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang / /zhes pa nas/bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di'i skabs su tshig don dang / so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po sna/ shes bya chos can/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig yad de / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i 'od mog mog por byed pa la sogs pas bsnan pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag lnga dang /slob ma nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang / bse ru rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang / tshe 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyi phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam dang / theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa dang /mos pa sgom lam dang / phan yon bsnod dang bkur dang bsngags pa'i sgom lam dang / dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang de la rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang /theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam dang / tsong tu rnam dag sgom lam zhes bya ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ skabs 'dir

skabs dang po'i ṭik+ka/ 37dngos su bstan pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid yod de/ lam shes rdzogs byed kyi khyad par du gyur pa'i sems dpa'i yon tan de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na lnga yod de/ der gyur pa'i gegs mngon pa'i nga rgyal mngon 'asdi/ra ba dang bral ba sogs rnam pa lnga yad pa'i phyir / sa mtshams yod de/ 'dir dngos su bsnan pa ni zeg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i rgyu lam shes dang 'bras bu lam shes gnyis yad pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs lgu+os kyi sa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/dbye ba dang sa mtsham/sa yad de/ sngar ltar yod pa 'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa 'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis te/ der gyur pa'i mnyam

38 mngonartogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/rjes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ mnyam zhag la dbye na du ma yod de/ theg chen gyi mtho+ong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yad de/ sa dang po'i dkyil snod na yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen sgom lam bsgoms stobs ṣ+kos thob pa'i phan yon de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na lnga ste / der gyur pa'i skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu sogs lnga yad pa'i phyir/sa mtshams yod de/ 'dir dngos su bsnan pa ni theg chen gyi sgom lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yod cing spyir lam ma zhugs nas yod par khas blangs kyang mi 'gal snyam du sems pa'i phyir/ mos pa sgom lam lha/ mtshan nyid yod de/ yum rang 'bras don gsum po gang yang rung ba'i 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum yod de/ rang don mos pa sgom lam sogs gsum yod pa'i phyir/ mos pa sgom lam 21 phan yon gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ mos pa sgom lam sgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gang yang rung bas thugs dgyes pa'i cha dang de gang yang rung bas dngos gnas kyi yan tan

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 39brjod pa'i cha gang rung du dmigs pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/dbye na nyer bdun yod de/der gyur pa'i bstod bkur bsngags pa gsum po re re la'ang dgu dgu yod pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa yul khyad par can du sgyur bar byed pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bcas pa'i zeg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ bcu gnyis yad pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ sa bcu'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs na yad pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan rjes su yi rang sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa la dga' ba sgom pa'i rang gi grogs yid bde dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa 'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod cing / sa mtshams sngar ltar yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yad de/ gtso bor rtogs pa mthar thug sga lag rjes 'jog byed kyi theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/dbye na lnga yad/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gtso bor sbangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed kyi theg chen gyi zag med sgom

40 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/lam de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis lag rjes 'jog tshul gyi sgo nas so sor bshad pa yin gyi 'gal ba sna ma yin te/ ngo bo sa mtshams sobatag sa bcu'i mnyam bsdunag gi gnas skabs na yad par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig sa dang po'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa sgom lam dag rnam dang sgom lam yod kyang mos pa sgom lam med zer ba mi 'thad de/ rnam bshad las/ rang don mos pa sgom lam gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te ma dag sa bdun du bzhag par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa ni/byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi/ /lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad/ /ces gsuras/ ngag don ni/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi/ /lad+dha/ shes nyid ni chos can/ khyod mtshon byed kyi chos sngar ltar yin te/ mtshon byed de 'dra bar yum gyi mdo las bshad pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ rgyu ngo bo byed las ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa gzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshon byed kyi chos dang / bstan bshad sbyar ba dang gnyis/ dang po de nyid 'chad pa la/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /zhes pa nas/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/'di la'ang tshig don

skabasadang po'iṭik+ka/ 41dang / so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba soges bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/shes bya chos can/ gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu yod de/ shes pas srid la mi pa—/nas pa'i lam shes dang / snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i lapa shes dang / thabs la mkhas pa min pas 'bras yum la ring ba'i bzhi thekhog dang / thabs la mkhas pas ring ba ma yin pa 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang / mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba dang / de'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid dang / 'da' bya 'da' byed kyi mthong lam rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yo da de/ bzhi kun rdzob la ltos te/srid mtha' 'gog byed kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi kun rdzob la ltos te zhi mtha' 'gog byed kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i zeg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i lam shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings

42 mngon rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa / 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes ṣ+ko mtshan nyid/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i sgo nas zeg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i bzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ snga ma la gnyis yad de/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/phyi ma la'ang gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu lam shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ snga ma dang 'dir theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis don gcig la/ phyi ma dang theg dman be+o rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis don gcig par 'jog tu rung ba'i phyir/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang /gnyen po phyogs kyi bzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid sogs kyang sngar dang 'dra'o/ /sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ rnam pa bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/sa mtshams yod de/ zeg chen rlurmi tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar yad pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba'i yul yul can bden snong mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes/ sems dpa'i gzhi

skabasadang po 'iṭik+ka/ 4 3shes sbyor ba'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi sde/zine byed kyi sgo nas bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ bden pa mngon rtogs de de'i ma nyid yin pa'i phyir/'dir dbye na gnyis te/ 'da' bya 'da' byed kyi mthong lam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /ces gsungs / ngag don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i nyan rang byang sems 'phags/ pa'i mngon rtogs de chos can/ kun shes te gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/ de 'dra nyid du byams mgon nyid kyis 'dod pa'i phyir/mtshon tshul yod de/ ngo bo dang zin byed kyi sgo nas mtshon pa'i phyir/gnyis pa sbyor bzhi'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ mthar gyi sbyor ba/ skad cig sbyor ba'i lus rgyas par bshad pa dang bzhi/ /༈ dang po la/ mtshon byed dang / brnya na bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang / /zhes pa nas /thabs mkhas bcas pa yin zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la'ang tshig don dang / so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/dang po sna/

44 mngonartogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/shes bya chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig yod de / sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i rnam pa dang / sbyor bar bcas pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang / sbyor bar yon tan dang / de'i sbyor ba'i skyon dang /lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid dang bcas pa dang / thar pa cha mthun dang / nges 'byed cha mthun dang / slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rtags dang bcas pa dang / srid pa dang zhi ba mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang / zhing dag bla na med pa'i sbyor ba dang / thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang bcas pa rnams su yad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bstan gnyen po'i mtshan nyid yod de/ rang yul gyi rnam pa legs par shar ba'i sgo nas rang gi dmigs pa'i chos la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs la dngos su gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas gsum yod pa'i phyir/ rnam pa'i dbang du byas na gnyis yod de/ don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis yad pa'i phyir/ sa ma tshams yod de/ 'dir bsnan gnyen po'i tshogs lam nas sa/ngas rgyas kyi bar yad la/ spyir lam ma zhugs na'ang yod pa'i phyir/ rnam pa la khyab che chung yod de/don rnam ni shes bya thams cad la khyab cing / shes rnam ni lam ma zhugs

skabasadangapo 'iṭik+ka/ 45nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yod pa'i phyir te/ don rnam dang bsgom bya'i rnam pa rnam grangs yin la/ shes rnam ni spyir shes pa thams cad la khyab cing / sgom byed kyi shes rnam ni mi mthun phyogs ci rigs kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i shes pa zhig la byed pa'i phyir/ 'dir bsnan sems dpa'i snre ra ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ rang yul bden med du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la daza na nyi shu yod de/der gyur pa'i ngo spu sbyor ba lnga dang gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen 4) tshogs lam nas sdo/na maza'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba skye ba dang gnas pa gang rung 'a gegs byed de/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid/dbye na zhe drug yod cing / sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen (1 tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar rngu5ོda pa 'i phyir/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i se mas dpa'i ye shes / lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi sde/ shes ma tshan khyad mtshan byed mtshan ngobo nyid mtshan dang bzhi yod pa 'i phyir smabs 'dir dngos su brnya na pa'itheg chen tshogs lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ zag med ye shes sde tho nyer gcig si rigs la myong ba thon pa'i theg chen gyi chos mngod+dha

46 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum sde/ chung 'bring chen po gsum yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid yad de/ gtso bor thabs kyi chas khyad pa ra du byas pa'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/dbye na bzhi sde/ der gyur pa'i drod sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ snga phyi'i sa mtshams kyi khyad par yad de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i dbang du byas na rim pa bzhin du dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen tshogs sbyor nyid na yad pa'i phyir/ 'dir bsnan phyir mi ldog pa'i don yang yod de/lam gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur bar nges pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum ste/ der gyur pa'i sbyor lam pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba lngog pa sogs rtags nyi shu po gang rung thob pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun la gnas pa'i sems dpa'/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog nga 'i rtags thob nga 'i byang sems smyor lam pa 'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na du ma yad de/ der gyur pa'i bzhi dang rtags kyi dbang du byas na nyi shu yong pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yad de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod yan chad na yad pa'i phyir/ mthong lam pa dang sgom lam pa phyir mi 3ོ ga pa 'i rtags

skabasadangapo'i ṭik+ka/ 47dang dbye ba'ang shes par bya'o/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ mnyam gzhag gi gnas skabs ྅/ srid zhi bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa la brten nas rjes kyi gnas skabs su bden 'dzin mngon 'gyur ba skye ba'i go skabs bcom pa 'i dag sa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ zhing dag sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yad de/ rten gyi gang zag gang du 'tshang rgya 'gyur gyi zhing khyad par can 'grub pa'i dge rtsa nus pa mthu can du gyur nga 'i dag sa 'i ye bes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/'bad rtsol rags pa zhi ba'i sgo nas 'phrin las lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dag sa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de gsu ma po mi 'gal te yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na re re la'ang gnyis/ gnyis yod de/ mnyam rjes gnyis gnyis yod pa 'i phyir/ gsum ka'ang dag sa kho na na yad/ /༈ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ rnam spru/na mngon rdzogs rtogs pa sne ༈ / zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ sngar bzhed pa 'i bcu gcig po 'di ji tshe can/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed yin te/jicacabyed las khyad chos ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ /

48 mngon rtogs rgyan lha/ ṭik+ka/༈ gnyis pa rtse sbyor gyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshon byed dang / bsnan bshad gnyis/dang po 'chad pa la/ de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang / /zhes pa nas/ log par sgrub dang bcas pa ni/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la tshig don dang / mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad yod de/ sbyor lam drod thob pa de'i rtags bcu gnyis po gang rung dang ldan pa'i nges cha dang po dang / bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba sogs bcu drug po gang rung thob pa'i nges cha gnyis pa dang / gzhan don la brtan pa thob pa'i nges cha gsum pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la sems kun tu gnas pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha bzhi pa dang / mthong lam rtse sbyor dang sgomalam rtse sbyor zhes bya ba gnyis po so so la gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa rtog par bzhi'i gten po baji/ bzhi dang / bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gsal bya log par sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ drod rtse sbyor sogs kyi mtshan nyid yod de / rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su chos thams cad bden med du rtogs nas rmi lam lta bur lta ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu gnyis po garnga rung thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha dang po drod rtse sbyor gyi ma nyid/ bsod nams

skabasadangapo'iṭik+ka/ 49rnam par 'phel ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu drug po gang rung thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha gnyis pa/ rtse mo'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ thabs shes kyi rtogs pa brtan po gnyis thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha gsum pa/'dir bsnan bzod pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ bsod nams mang pos mtshon te bstan pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha bzhi pa/ 'dir bsnan chos mchog rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ mthong spang rtog pa'i gnyen po byed pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ sgom spang rtog pa'i gnyen po byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na re re la'ang de bzhi bzhi yod de/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa rtog par kun btags dang lhan skyes bzhi bzhi'i gnyen po bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de / dang po ga chen gyi mthong lam dang / phyi ma sa bcu'i gnas skabs su yod pa'i phyir/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yod de/bsod nams mang pos mtshon te bstan pa'i sgo nas gnas ngan len /glu dri ma phra mo dngos su 'joms byed kyi theg chen gyi bar chad med lam de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dang rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gnyis don gcig cing / sa mtshams ni rgyun mtha' kho na na yod/ bden

50 mngonartogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/gnyis gzhi gcig gi steng du 'dur mi rung bar 'dzin pa'i log rtog chos can / skabs 'dir bstan pa'i bsal bya log rtog gi mtshan nyid yin te / de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yad de/ bcu drug yad pa 'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs/ zhes gsungs/ngag don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i brgyad po de rnams chos can/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/ de'i ngobo yon tan spang bya ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa mthar gyis sbyor ba'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/mtshon byed dang / bsnan bshad gnyis/ dang ngo ni/ rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ bes bya chos can/ mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum yo da de/ phar phyin drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba drug dang / sa ngas rgyas chos dge 'dun lha gtong ba tshul khrims te rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba drug dang ༈ dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis sbyor ba gcig sne/ de ltar rnam pa gsum dang bcas pa'i bcu gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ mthar gyis pa zhes gsungs / ngag don ni/ sngar bshad pa de dag chos can/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/ de ngobo dang khyad par gyi sgo nas

skabasadangaro 'iṭik+ka/ 51mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ /༈ bzhi pa/ skad cig sbyor ba'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/mtshon byed dang bsnan bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/skad cig sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi yad de/ngobo gcig la lngog pa tha dad pa'i mtshan nyid kyis dbye ba rnam pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de yang yod de/ rnam par smin pa dang / rnam ji ra ma smin pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ chos bzhi po de chos can/skad cig ma gcig gi mngon par rdzogs pa ra byang chub par 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba mchon byed kyi chos yin te/ de ngo bo dang nus pa 'i yon tan gyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/mtshon byed dang bsnan bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brdzod / / ces pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la tshig don dang / so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ shes bya chos can/

52 mngonartogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi yad de/ ngo bo snyad sku dang /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang bcas pa dang / de bzhin du de gnyis las gzhan pa sprul pa'i sku dang / ye shes chos sku mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/ dag pa gnyis lngan gyi chos nyid kyi sku de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ tsho na gnyis yod de/glo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang / rang bzhin rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ longs sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/ nges pa lnga dang ldan pas rab tu phye ba'i gzugs sku mthar thug de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ longs sku chos can/nges pa lnga dang lngan pa yin te/ sku nges pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs dang /'khor nges pa byang 'phags sha stag gis bskor ba dang / dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul mi ston par bzhugs pa dang / chos nges pa theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig gsungs pa dang / gnas nges pa 'og min kho nar bzhugs pa'i nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ sprul sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/ nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pa'i gzugs sku de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum yod

skabs dang po 'i ṭik+ka/ 53de / bzobo sprul sku/ skye ba sprul sku/ mchog sga sprul sku dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /zhes pa 'i tshig zur gyi chos sku zhes pa'i gzhung 'di gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sngar bshad pa'i chos bzhi po de dang 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/ de ngo bo dang byed las ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ de mi 'thad par thal/ chos sku zhes pa'i tshig de bsnan bshad sbyor ba'i gzhung ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/de ye shes chos sku'i lus 'chad byed kyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/skyon med de/ de de gnyis ka 'chad byed kyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ der thal / slob dpon 'phags pas/ de bstan bshad sbyor ba'i gzhung du sbyar zhing slob dpon seng ge bzang pos ye shes chos sku'i lus rgyas par bshad pa'i gzhung du sbyar bas gang byas kyang ṣ+pe'agal ba'i phyir/ gsum pa tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas 'chad pa la/ mkhyen gsum rgyas par bshad pa dang / sbyor bzhi rgyas par bshad pa dang / chos sku rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen bshad pa dang / lam shes bshad pa dang / gzhi shes bshad pa dang gsum/ /༈ dang po de 'chad par byed pa la/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan

54 mngonartogs rgyan sgyeṭik+ka/don phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin zhes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la'ang mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i nang nas/ dang po sems bskyed 'chad pa la/ sems bskyed pa ni zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ mtshan nyid dang rab tu dbye ba'i sgo nas 'chad tshul gnyis yad pa las/ dang po ni/ gzhan gyi don gyi phyir du rang gi grogs yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gtso bo'i yid kyi rnam rig khyed par can chos can/ khyod theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yin te/de'i don ldog yin pa'i phyir/ dmigs yul byang chub de dang gzhan gyi don de ni chos can/yum gsum ka las kyang bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sno nas brdzod pa yin te/ yum bar ma las bstan pa de bzhin du gzhan gnyis las kyang bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dir theg chen sems bskyed la 'dod pa'i sgras bstan pa'i dgos pa yod de/ gzhan don 'dod pa sems bskyed kyi rgyu dang / byang chub 'dod pa grogs su 'byung bar shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed de yang chos can / khyod la dbye na rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ dkar chos kyi rten

skabasadangapo'i ṭik+ka/ 55gzhi byed pa'i sa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang / de bzhin du sbyar te byang chub kyi bar du mi nyams pa'i gser lta bu dang / dge ba'i chos gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i zla ba lta bu dang / mkhyen gsum bsgom pa la sgrib pa'i bud shing mngon 'gyur ba bsreg pa'i me lta bu dang / longs spyod kyis sems can tshim par byed pa'i gter lta bu dang / yan tan rin po che'i rten byed pa'i rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu dang / mi 'dod pa thog tu bab kyang mi 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho lta bu dang / theg chen gyi lam la mi phyed pa'i brtan pa thob pa'i rdo rje lta bu dang / g.yeng ba'i rnam rtog gis mi bskyod pa'i ri rab lta bu dang / nyon mongs pa'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i sman lta bu dang / sems can yongs su mi gtong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu dang / mngon shes ci+os ji ltar 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu dang / gdul bya smin par byed pa'i nyi ma lta bu dang /chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs ji 'i glu lta bu dang / mthu thogs pa med pas gzhan don sgrub pa'i rgyal po lta bu dang / tshogs gnyis/ kyi mdzod 'dzin pa'i bang mdzod lta bu dang / theg chen gyi 'phags pa thams cad kyang de nas bakhegs shing gsheḍa pas 'gyur pas lam po che lta bu dang / srid zhi'i mthar mi ltung bar bgrod pa'i bzhon pa lta bu dang / chos kyi ma dzod mi

56 mngonartogs rgyan gyisnyik+ka/zad pa 'dzin pa'i bkod ma'i chu lta bu dang / gdul bya rnams la chos kyi snyan pa sgrogs pa'i sgra snyan lta bu dang / gdul bya 'dul ba'i tshul la rgyun mi 'chad du 'jug pa'i chu bo lta bu dang / mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams kyang phye bas nyi shu rtsa gnyis yad pa'i phyir ro/ /sa dang / gser dang / zla ba tshes pa dang / me dang / gter dang / rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang /rgya mtsho dang / rdo rje dang / ri'i rgyal po dang / sman dang / bshes gnyen dang / yid bzhin nor bu dang / nyi ma dang / glu dbyangs dang / rgyal po dang / mdzod dang / lam po che dang / bzhon pa dang / bkod ma'i chu dang / sgra snyan dang / chu bo dang / sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar nyer gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas pa'i sa mtshams kyi khyad par yod de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs dang po gsum po de theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung 'bring chen po gsum dang / me lta bu'i sems bskyed sbyor lam dang / gter lta bu'i sems bskyed nas glu dbyangs lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar bcu po de sa dang po nas/ bcu pa'i bar dang / rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs lnga po de/ dag pa sa gsum dang / tha ma gsum po de sa bcu pa dang longs sku dang / mchog

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 57gi sprul sku'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa la rim pa bzhin du sbyor ba'i phyir/spyir theg chen sems bskyed yin na/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed yin dgos te/ de yin na spyod pa'i rten byed pa'i rigs gnas kyi sems bskyed yin dgos pa'i phyir/ slob pa'i rgyud la chu bo dang sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed yad par khas blangs kyang 'gal ba med de/ dag sa na de dag yod par go ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa gdams ngag 'chad pa la/ sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni/ /zhes pa nas/ bcu yi bdag nyid shes par bya / / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la dbye ba dang / dge 'dun dkon maḥtshog bye brag tu bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag de ni chos can/ khyod la bcu yi bdag nyid du shes par bya ste/sgrub pa'i ngo bo dang bden gnyis la 'doms pa dang / dmigs pa bden pa bzhi rnams dang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gsum dang /bya ba ngan la zhen pa'i brtson 'grus dang / yongs su mi ngal ba dang /theg chen gyi lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang / spyi na lnga dang / mngon shes /rmi ༷/ོna tan drug dang / mthong lam dang / sgom lam zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gdams ngag dang bcas pa bcu yad pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /

58 mngonartogs rgyan gyi snyik+ka ces pa nas/ bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni / shes bya chos can/ mtshon bya mtshon byed kyi dge 'dun gyi nang nas mtshon bya don gyi dbe 'dun nyi shu yod de/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dbang po rtul po dang dbang porno na po'i ming can gyi byang sems gnyis dang /ro/gas bstan rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po ba'i ming can gcig dang /phyir 'ong dang / phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i ming can dbang rtul dad mos pa dang dbang rnon mthong zob pa gnyis dang / rgyun zhugs rigs gnas rigs skye'i ming can gnyis dang / shugs bsnan phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po ba dang / phyir 'ong tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa'i ming can gcig dang / phyir mi 'ong bar 'da' ba dang / skyes nas 'da' ba dang / 'du byed bcas te 'da' ba dang / 'du byed min par 'da' ba dang bcas pa'i phyir mi 'ong gi ming can bzhi dang / dbye gzhi 'og min 'gro la phye ba'i gong 'pho 'phar ba gsum gyi ming can rnams dang / srid pa 'i rtse mo'i mthar thug bar 'gro ba'i gzugs kyi chags bcom gzhir byas nas de las phye ba'i phyir mi 'ong mthong ba yi chos la zhi ba dang / lus mngon sum du byed pa gnyis/ shugs bstan dgra bcom zhugs pa'i ming can gcig dang / bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi ming can gcig ste nyi shu yad

skabasadang po'iṭik+ka 59pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang slob dpon gyi bzhid ji ltar bshad pa yin gyi/der nges pa ni min te/ slob dpo na 'phags pas sngar gyi de dang cung zad mi 'dra bar bshad pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa nges 'byed cha mthun 'chad pa la/ mdor bsnan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ bcas pa dag las khyad par 'phagasi /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa yi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi chos can/ nyan thos bse ru lta bu dang bcas pa'i sbyor lam dag las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / rgyu dang yongs su 'dzin pa yis dang / bdag nyid shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bzhi po ji bden spang bya'i ngo bor ldan pa la brten pa dang chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ /zhes pa nas/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ngag don ne+e/ bden pa bzhi'i rten can mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po chos can / theg chen sbyor lam drod chung ngu'i dmigs pa yin te/ de'i sgro

60 mngon rte gsargyan gyi ṭik+ka/'dogs gcad par bya ba'i bzhi yin pa'i phyir/ rtags 'di 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar dgos pa yin te/ thams cad kyi sgro 'dogs gcad gzhir mtshungs pa'i phyir/ bden pa bzhi po de yi ni khyad chos bcu drug 'a༈ bden par mngon par zhen pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa 'gog pa'i drod chung ngu'i ye shes chos can/ drod chung ngu'i rnam pa yin te/ de'i dmigs pa'i chod+dha la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs 'gog byed kyi drod chung ngu'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ rnam pa gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar dgos te/ thams cad kyis rang gi dmigs pa'i chos la phyin ci log tu zhen pa'i sgro 'dogs 'gog par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod chung ngu'i ye shes chos can/ rang 'bras khyad par can gyi rgyu byed pa yin te/ theg pa gsum car gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nye rgyu byed pa'i phyir/'di yang lhag ma rnams la sbyar dgos te/ nyer 'bras de 'byin par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ drod 'bring gi dmigs rnam gyi khyad par yod de/gzugs sogs rnams don dam par 'du 'god bden pa dang bral bas khyad par du byas nas bden bzhi'i dmigs pa dang / ming gi rgyun don dam par gnas pa dang bral ba ste gnas pa med par rtogs pa'i drod 'bring gi

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 6/ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ drod chen po'i dmigs rnam yad de/gzugs sogs brdar btags pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang / de dag don dam par brjod du med par rtogs pa'i drod chen po'i ye shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtse mo chung ngu'i dmigs rnam yod de/ bden pa rnam par bzhag ma bzhag gnyis las phyi ma'i dbang du byas na/ gzugs tshor sogs don dam par mi gnas pa de dag ni don dam par de yi ngo tshe rang bzhin med pas khyad par du byas pa sa dmigs pa dang / gzugs sogs dang de'i chos nyid de dag bden stong gcig gi rang bzhin gcig tu rtogs pa'i rtse mo'i chung ngu'i ye shes rnam pa dang /dang po'i dbang du byas na gzugs sogs de rnams de'i ngo bo bden pas stong pas de dag don dam par mi skye ba la sogs par mi gnas pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang / mi rtag sogs dang de'i chos nyid de dag sga bden stong gcig gi rang bzhin gcig tu rtogs pa 'i rtse mo'i chung ngu'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa 'i phyir/ rtse mo 'bring gi dmigs rnam gyi khyad par yod de/ chos rnams bden grub kyi mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa gang yin pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang / de dag bden pa ra grub pa'i mtshan mar mi mthong bar rtogs pa'i

62 mngonarte+ogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/rtse mo 'bring gi ye shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtse mo chen po'i dmigs rnam yad de/ don dam dpyod byed kyi shes rab sku+os ni yongs su rtogs pa'i tshul gyis dpyad pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang / 'khor gsum thams cad dmigs su med par rtogs pa'i rtse mo chen po'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa chung ngu'i dmigs rnam yod de/ gzugs sogs don dam par ngo snyad med pa nyid kyis khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang / gzugs sogs de rnams don dam par ngo bo nyid med pa nyid yin kyang tha snyad pa'i ngo bo snyad du rtogs pa'i bzod pa chung ngu'i ye shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa 'bring gi dmigs rnam yad de/ gzugs sogs de dag don dam par skye ba med pa dang nges par 'byung ba med pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang / sgo gsum bden grub kyis rnam par dag pa'i bzod pa 'bring gi ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa chen po'i dmigs rnam yod de/ sgo gsum de dag bden grub kyi mtshan ma med pas khyad par du byas pa dmigs pa dang / de gsum don dam par de yi mtshan mar mi brten pas yid gnyis kyi mos pa min pa dang 'du shes med pa ra rtogs pa'i bzod pa chen po'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos

skabasadangapo'i ṭik+ka/ 63mchog chung ngu'i dmigs rnam yad de/ bsgom bya'i stang nge 'dzin gyi ngo bor gyur pa dmigs pa dang / stang nge 'dzin de'i byed pa lhun grub tu 'jug par rtogs pa'i chos mchog chung ngu'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/chos mchog 'bring gi dmigs rnam yad de/ skog tu lung ston pa'i rgyu khyad par can dmigs pa dang / don dam par rlom pa rags pa zad pa'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos mchog chen po'i dmigs rnam yod de/ 'khor gsum po bden pas snong pa phan tshun ngo des gcig pa dmigs pa dang / chos mchog gi ting nge 'dzin mtha' gang du'ang rnam par mi rtog par bden med du rtogs pa'i chos mchog chen po'i ye shes de de'i rnam pa yi na pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bcu gnyis yod de/ sngar bshad pa de ltar re re la'ang chung dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye bas rnam pa bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gzhung de rnams kyis ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul yod de/ shes sgrib spong ba la bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po de bden med du gco bor bsgom pa nyid gal che zhing / de yang theg chen sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs su 'byung gi theg dman sbyor lam /) gnas skabs su ni bcu drug po gtso bor bsgom par byed kyang / bden med du gtso bor mi bsgom par bstan pa 'i phyir/

64 mngonartogasargyan gyiṭik+ka/der thal/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis ka stong nyid gtso bor bsgoms snobs kyis spong bar byed nus kyi/ kha ton byed pa tsam gyis spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ /༈ theg chen sbyor lam gyi spang bya de 'chad pa la/ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis/ /zhes pa nas/ phung sogs rten la'ang de bzhin no / / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi spang bya yod de/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gzung bar rtog pa de chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ gzhi kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs dang / de yi gnyen po'i phyogs la brten pa'i dbya ba yis de ltar yad pa' phyir/ gnyis pa de ni chos can/ so sor dbye bas rnam pa dasdo/ dgu yad de/ rmongs pa dang mi rtag pa dang phung sogs la dmigs pa'i bye brag gis de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa'ang chos can/ rnam pa gnyis su 'dod de/ gang zag rnams dang skyes bu btags pa'i rten can gyi dbye bas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis po de ni chos can/ rnam pa dgu dgu yad de / rang dbang can gyi bdag sogs kyi ngo bo dang / phung sogs kyi rten la dmigs pa la de bzhin du yod pa'i phyir/ snga phyi bzhi po de'i khyad par

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 65yod de/ spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyad bya'am shes byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de shes sgrib nyon mongs gzung rtog dang / gnyen po rnam byang phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyad bya'am shes byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ shes sgrib rnam byang gzung rtog yin la/ rdzas 'dzin gyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyod byed dam shes byed du bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / btags 'dzin gyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyod byed dam shes byed du bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog par 'jog pa'i phyir/de re re la'ang gnyis gnyis yod de/ kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis yad pa'i phyir/ skabs/ 'dir dngos bsnan gyi dbang du byas na kun btags gtso che sde/ lhan skyes ni skabs lnga par 'chad par byed pa'i phyir/ theg chen sbyor lam pa'i yongs 'dzin de 'chad par byed pa la / sems mi 'gong pa nyid la so gas / /zhes pa nas / rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ stong nyid zab mo la sems mi 'gong zhing mi skrag pa nyid la sogs pa'i thabs 5mkhas dang / de'i mi mthun phyogs nyan rang yid byed dang bden zhen ci

66 mngonartosas rgyanagyiṭik+ka risas bor spro'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ rnam pa kun tu byang klums sbyor lam pa'i nang gi yangs 'dzin yin te/ de srid zhi gangarngung du mi ltung bar 'dzin par byed pa'i de'i ye shas yin pa'i phyir / byashā sems sbyor lam pa la chos thams cad don dam par ngo rwasno nyid med pa tshags su ston par byed cing de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba'i mchog gi nyul sku chos can/ byang sems sbyor lam pa 'i phyi'i yongs 'dzin yin she de la thabs shes rdzo gas par snon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gar+sā yin spru'iphyir/ /༈ bzhi pa zeg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs 'chad pa la/rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang / /zhes pa nas/ 'jug pa'i rten la rirgas zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen sbyor lam drod tshagos bzhi dang / theg chen gyi mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis te rtogs pa yini chos drug dang / gnyen po'i bar chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyoges pa dang / spang bya'i sa bon 'gag ji la mngon du phyoges pa'i tshul gyis spong ba dang / spang bya dag yongs su gtugs pa sde zad pa 'i rnam sgroglu lam dang / srid zhi'i mtha' 'gog byed kyi shes rab snying brtser bcanu pa dang / slob ma nyan thos sogs dang thun mong ma yin pa

skabasadangapo 'iṭik+ka/ 67nyid dang / gzhan gyi don gyi go rims sgrub ji dang / ji lta ji snyed la ye shes rtsol ba rags pa spangs shing / mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rten chos nyid bcu gsum po de chos can/ khyod la rigs zhes bya ste/theg chen sgrub pa rang nyid la dmigs nas bsgoms pas de rtogs pa gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi sa mtshams kyi khyad par yod de/ rtogs pa'i chos drug ni sngar ltar dang / gnyen po dang ni spong ba dang / /zhes pas theg chen mthong sgom gnyis la ni gnyen po'i bar chad med lam dang spong ba'i bar chad med lam gnyis spang bya 1 nga tshul gyis gnyis su phye nas bsnan/ de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang zhes pas/ de gnyis kyi rnam grol lam gcig tu byas te sa bdun pa man chad dang / shes rab snying brtser bcas pa sa brgyad pa dang / slob ma zun mong ma yin pa sa dgu pa dang / gzhan don go rims su byed pa dang / ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' ba gnyis ka sa bcu pa dang sbyar zhing /de yang 'di'i dngos bstan la dgongs pa'i phyir/ /༈ rigs la rtsod pa spong ba 'chad pa la/ chos kyi dbyings la ngakhyer med phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /ces khu bar gsungs/ 'di la rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes

68 mngon rte gas rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/bya chos can/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs kyi dbye ba ni tha dad par rung ba ma yin par thal/ de gsum bden pas stong pa'i chos dbyings la ngo tshe rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ rigs can gsum ka'i slob ma rnams chos can/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi gnas skabs kyi rigs la gnas par thal/ rtags de'i phyir/ zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ shes bya chos can/ rigs gsum dang rigs can gsum gyi dbye ba mi rung ba'i skyon de med par thal/ de'i chos dbyings kyi ngobo la rigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med kyang rten pa'i chos sgrub pa gsum gyi bye brag gisarigs dang rigs can gsum po de yi dbye ba yangs su brdzod rigs pa'i phyir/dper na/ rten bum pa gcig gi nang du brten pa sbrang rtsi dang bu ram sogs blugs pa de'i tshe sbrang rtsi'i bum pa dang / bu ram sogs kyi bum pa zhes brdzod du rung ba bzhin no/ /gzhung 'dis sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can du bstan pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi sems bden snong de sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung gi rigs su bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab sde/ spyir chos thams cad bden pas stong bzhin du bya byed kyi rnam gzharga 'thad par thal/ sems can thams cad kyi sems bden pas stong zhing dri ma glo bur ba yin pa la 'khor 'das kyi rnam gzhag

skabs dang po 'i ṭik+ka/ 69thams cad 'thad par/ rgyud bla ma rtsa 'grel las dpe dgu don dgu'i sgo nas rgyas par gtan la phab pa ltar gnyen po dang 'phrad na ni dri ma sbyong nus pas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der ma zad/ 'phags pas chos dbyings bstod pa las kyang / gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor la/ sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba / / de nyid sbyang ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de ni mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /zhes rang bzhin gnas rigs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yad pa dang / de nyid sbyangs pa las chos kyi skur 'gyur bar gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ lnga pa/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa 'chad pa la/dmigs pa chos rnams tham sa cad de/ /zhes pa nas/ gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ dge so gas kyi ཿthos rnams thams cad chos can/theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin te/de'i sgro 'dogs gcad pa ra bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa'i chos de yang chos can/ du ma yod de/ dge ba dang / la sogs pas mi dge ba dang ༈ lung ma bstan dang / 'jig rten pa yi rtoges pa phung po lnga

7() mngon rtogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/dang / 'jig rten las 'das par 'dod pa ni bsam gtan bzhi gang dag dang / zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga dang / zag pa med pa'i chos dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang / 'dus byas khams btasum po gang dag dang /'dus ma byas de bzhin nyid dang / slob ma nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i chos bsam gtan bzhi rnams dang / thub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i chos gang dag rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ yod na theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin pas khyab sde/ de'i sgro 'dogs gcad gzhi yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/der thal/ yod na theg chen sgrub pas rang latsho dmigs nas bden med du rtogs dgos pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yod na dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum po gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ dge mi dge gang rung ma yin pa'i chos yin na/ lung ma bstan yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/der thal/ de yin na rang 'bras rnam smin yid 'ong dang yid mi 'ong gang rung 'byin rung ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ /༈ drug pa/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba 'chad pa la sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang / /zhes pa nas/ ched du bya ba 'dir shes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba 'di chos can/ khyod gang gi shes par bya ba'i gang zag
