skabasadang ro 'iṭik+ka/ 7/yod de/ rang byung gi ming sgas/ brdzod pa byang sems rnams kyis shes par bya ba'i phyir/ gang gi sgo nas shes par byed pa yod de/ chen po gsum gyi sgo nas shes pa ra byed pa'i phyir/ chen po gsum yang chos can/ yod de sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems chen po dang spong ba chen po dang rtogs pa chen po dang gsum po rnams su yad pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi yod de/ sangs rgyas 'phags ji 'i rgyud kyi thugs rje chen po dang ji+o dang / mi gnas pa'i myang 'das gnyis pa dang / ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ bdun pa/ go sgrub 'chad pa la/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs / / zhes pa nas / drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don sna/ go cha'i sgrub nga gang yin pa de ni chos can/'jog tshul yad de/ mdo las sbyin pa'i sbyin pa sogs drug nas/ shes rab kyi shes rab bar drug tshan drug sga sgo nas ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'byed ji ra rung sde/ go cha'i sgrub pa de dag so sor te re res nas kyang sbyin ji la sogs pa rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa'i phyir / brgyad pa 'jug sgrub 'chad pa la/ bas ma gtan gzugs med jisbyin sothakha dang / /zhes pa nas/ 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhes

72 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/pa'i bar gsu ngas/ ngag don ni/ theg chen lam gyis bsdus pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med bzhi dang / sbyin sogs drug dang /mthong sgom gyi lam dang / byams sogs tshad med bzhi dang / bden grub kyi dmigs pa med pa dang lngan pa dang / gang la gang gis ji ltar sbyin pa'i 'khor gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i rnam par dag pa dang / ched du bya ba chen po gsum gyi phyir du bsngo ba'i dge ba dang mngon shes drug dang /'bras bu rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i 'jug sgrub kyi ye shes rnams chos can/ theg chen gyi lam la 'dzenu pa yin par shes par bya ste / theg pa chen po'i rgyu 'bras kyi chos ci rigs pa gong 'phel du 'jug pa'i sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ dgu pa tshogs sgrub 'chad pa la/ dngos dang 'phros pa'i don sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyong dang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang bcas pa bshad pa gnyis / dang po 'chad pa la/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /ces pa nas / rim pa yin par shes par bya/ ༈zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod nyams su len pa'i rim pa la bcu bdun yod pa yin par shes par bya ste/ de la yang der gyur pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po dang / sbyin pa la sogs drug nyams su len pa dang / zhi

skabasadangapo'i ṭik+ka/ 73gnas lhag mthong dang bcas pa dang / zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang yin pa dang / gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas pa gang yin pa dang /e shes dang ni bsod nams kyis bsdus pa dang / mthong sgom gyi lam dang / tshig don gyi gzungs dang / sa bcu dang / gnyen po'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi khyad par bcu bdun rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de thams cad bsdus na gnyis su 'du ste/ ye shes dang bsod nams kyi tshogs sgrub gnyis su 'du pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ dang po yongs sbyong bye brag tu bshad pa la/ yangs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /zhes pa nas/ bcu pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la dang po'i yongs sbyong bshad pa dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa dang / drug pa dang / bdun pa dang / brgyad pa dang / dgu pa'i yongs sbyong dang / bcu pa mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bshad pa dang bcu/dang po de 'chad pa la/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /zhes pa nas/yongs su sbyong ba shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don sna/sa ni dang po rab tu dga' ba ཿthos can/ khyod thob par 'gyur ba'i thabs yod de/ 'chad pa ltar yongs su sbyong ba rnam pa bcu yi sgo nas thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ yangs sbyong bcu yang yod de/ g.yo sgyu sogs

74 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi snyik+ka/med pa'i bsam pa dang / rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la phan pa'i dngos po nyid dang / sems can rnams la tshad med bzhi'i sgo na sa sems mnyam pa nyid dang / dge rtsa sogs gzhan la gtong ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / theg chen gyi sde snod sogs dam pa'i chos kyi ngamigs pa 'tshol ba dang / rtag tu nges par 'byung ba'i sems dang bcas pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par 'dod pa la dga' ba dang / chos ston pa la dpe mkhyud med pa dang / tshig thams cad bden par smra ba yi/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong ni bcu pa yin par 'dod pa'i phyir/khyod kyis sa dang po yongs su sbyong bar byed tshul yad de/ snying rje chen po dang 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas de'i skyon sel zhing yon tan rdzogs par byed pa'i tshul gyis shes par bya ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod/ /ces pa nas/ brgyad pa sbyin la sogs la brtson/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong brgyad yod de/ tshul khrims kyi nyams len lhag par thob pa dang /byas pa gzo ba dang / bzod pa sgom pa dang / dge ba sgrub pa la rab tu dga' ba dang / gzhan la snying brtse che ba dang bcas pa dang / mkhan

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 75sogs la bkur snyi byed pa dang / bla ma la gus pas chos nyan pa dang /brgyad pa sbyin pa la sogs kyi nyams len lobartson pa'i yongs sbyong rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'chad pa la/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni / / zhes pa nas/ rlom med bdag nyid de rnams lnga/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs / ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyong rnam pa lnga yod de/ thos pas mi ngoms pa nyid kyis chos 'tshol ba dang /nyon mongs pa'i zang zing med par chos kyi sbyin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun sbyong bar byed pa dang / 'khor ba pas gnod pa byas kyang de'i don la yongs su mi skyo ba dang / sdig pa la mi 'dzem pa'i ngo tsha khrel yod ces bya ba rnams su yod la/ de rnams la rlom sems med pa'i bdag nyid can gyi shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'i phyir / bzhi pa 'chad pa la/ nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang / /zhes pa nas/ mi zhum pa dang lta ba med/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ shes bya cho sa can/ sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong la bcu yod de/ nyan rang yid 3byed kyi bsam pas dben pa'i nags na gnas pa dang / 'dod pa chung ba rdo pa / chog shes pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag sde ngas pa'i sngom pa la brten pa dang / bslab pa khas blangs yongs su

76 mngonarte gsargyan gyi ṭik+ka/mi gtong ba dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan la chags pa smod cing spong ba dang / gzhan myang 'das la 'god pa dang / bdog pa'i dngos po kun gtong ba dang / chos kyi dka' spyod la mi zhum pa'i spro ba dang / bden grub twe lta ba'i zhen pa med pa rnams su yad pa'i phyir/lnga pa 'chad pa la/'dris dang khyim la 'khrin pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ sa lnga pa ni yang dag thob / / ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngagadon ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa lnga pa la yongs sbyong bcu yod de/ rnyed bkur gyi ched du khyim la 'brid pa spong ba dang / khyim la 'khren pa'i rkyen gyis gzhan la de mi snon pa dang /'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas spong ba dang / rnyed bkur gyi ched du bdag la bstod cing / gzhan la brnyas pa spong ba gnyis dang / mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu spong ba dang / nga rgyal gyi rlom pas khengs pa spong ba dang /dge sdig la blang dor phyin ci log tu byed pa sbong ba dang / blo ngan 'jig lta spong ba dang / nyon mongs phyogs la bzod cing dang du len pa sgong ba dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad pa ltar bcu po 'di ni chos can/ sbyang gzhi yod de/ mi mthun phyogs rnam pa bcu sbyangs shing rnam par spangasapasan salnga pa ni yang dag par thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/drug pa 'chad pa la/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /zhes

skabasadangapo'iṭik+ka/ 77pa nas/ sa ni drug pa yang dag thob/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa drug pa la yangs sbyong bcu yad de/ sbyin sogs drug dang de'i spang bya drug sbyar nas sbyong zhing / de yang sbyin pa'i nyams len gyis slob ma nyan zos kyi byang chub 'dod pa spong ba dang / rang don yid byed kyi sems spong ba'i tshul khrims kyis bse ru rang rgyal gyi byang chub la dga' ba spong ba dang / snong nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pas zab done la skrag pa'i sems sbong ba dang / sbyin pa la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyis slong ba pos bslangs pa'i sems mi zhum pa dang / sbyin pa 'dayang sems rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan gyis phyi nang gi bdog pa kun btang yang yid mi dga' ba med pa dang / sbyin pa'i yon tan rtogs pa'i shes rab rab tu rdzogs pas btang bas rang nyid dbul yang slong pa po ṣ+pelha nga bar bslabs nas sa ni drug pa yang dag par thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir / de ltar bsnoms na drug yod kyang phye na bcu gnyis su 'gyur te/sbang bya dang spong byed kyi sgo nas so so phye ba bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba'i phyir/bdun pa 'chad pa la/ bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang / /zhes pa nas / ston pa nyid dang nyi shu'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di spang bya sdong / gnyen po'i sgo nas sbyang pa gnyis las/ dang po sna/ shes bya chos

78 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/can / sa bdun pa'i yangs sbyong la spang bya spong tshul gyis bzhag pa nyi shu yad de/ 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar nyi shu yad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ spang bya gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / sems can du 'dzin pa dang / de bzhin du srog dang / rang dbang can gyi gang zag dang / sems can chad pa dang / bdag rtag pa dang / blang dor gyi mtshan ma dang / rgyu mi 'dra ba gsum dang / phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag dang / khams gsum po la gnas byar dang / dor byar bden par chags pa dang /sems ni kun tu mi zhum pa dang / dkon mchog gsum re re dang / tshul khrims la der bdenapar lta ba'i mngon zhen dang / stong pa nyid la phyin ci log tu rtsod pa dang / bden stong de dang kun rdzob 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i nyes pa ni nyi shu rnams gang las rnam par chad pa'i byang sems de yis sa ni bdun pa thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa gnyen po'i yongs sbyong nyi shu yod de/ de yang sngar bshad pa'i spang bya nyi shu po rnams kyi gnyen por rim pa bzhin du sbyor na rnam par thar pa'i sgo snong pa nyid la sogs pa gsum shes pas bdag dang sems can dang srog tu 'dzin pa rnams spong ba dang / de dgi bcu'i 'khor gsum la bden par zhen pa med pa'i rnam par dag pa nyid kyilorang dbang can gyi sems can du 'dzin pa spong ba dang /

skabs dang po'i ṭilko/ 79sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rjes sems can chad par 'dzin pa spong ba dang / bden grub tu rlome pa med pas sems can rtag par 'dzin pa sponge ba dang / chos thams cad bden snong mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas blang dor mtshan mar 'dzin pa sbong ba dang / mazar zug zeg pa chen po'i tshul gcig tu shes pas rgyu rigs mi 'dra ba gsum du 'dzin pa spong ba dang /'dus byas rnams don dam par mi skye bar shes pas phung po la bden zhen spong ba dang / stong nyid zab mo la bzod pa shes pas khams gsum la bden zhen spong ba dang / chos rnams bden snong gi rnam pa gcig tu ston pas skye mched la bden zhen sbong ba dang / bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa kun tu 'joms pas khams gsum la gnas byar bden par zhen pa spong ba dang /tshul min yid byed kyi 'du shes dang / lta ba lnga dang / chags sogs kyi nyoni mongs pas khams gsum la dor bya bden par zhen pa spong ba dang /zhi gnas nges par sems shing bsgoms pas sems zhum pa spong ba dang /lhag mthong gi lam la ni mkhas pas sangs rgyas dang / sems dul bas chos dang / chos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang ldan pasadage 'dun la bden par zhen pa spong ba gsum dang / chos gang dzir+sāngang bden par chags pa'i sa min par rtogs pas tshul khrims la

80 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/bden zhen spong ba dang / chos kyi don du gar 'dod par sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du ni dus mnyam du 'gro bas stong pa nyid la rtsod pa spong ba dang /gdul bya'i don du 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun tu bdag gi lus kyi ngo bo nyid rab tu ston pa nyid dang nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ spang bya de rnams ni/ phra rags ci rigs la dgongs pa yin gyi/ phra ba thams cad la min te/lugs 'dir bden 'dzin ma lus par spangs pa dang sangs rgyas pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa sa'i yongs sbyong 'chad pa la/ sems can kun yid shes pa dang / zhes pa nas/ las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad / / ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag deni ni/ sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong gi las ni chos can/ rnam pa 'di brgyad du bshad pa yin te/ sems can kun gyi yid kyi spyod pa bzang ngan shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su rdzu 'phrul gyis mngon par shes pas brtse ba dang / rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzang po sgrub pa dang / chos kyi tshig yongs su btags pa'i phyir du sangs rgyas brten pa dang / gdul bya rnams kyi dbang porno rtul shes pa dang / rgyal ba yi zhing gi sems can gyi nyon mongs sbyong ba dang / de dag thams cad bden stong sgyu ma lta bur blta ba la gnas pa dang sems can gyi dan du bsam bzhin du srid

skabasadang po'iṭik+ka/ 81par skye ba len pa dang brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/dgu pa 'chad pa la/smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang / /zhes pa nas/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag doni ni/ shes bya chos can / sa dgu pa la yongs sbyong bcu gnyis yod de/ byang chub tu smon pa'i smon lam dag ni maza' yas pa dang / lā dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i skad shes pa dang / spobs pa chu bo lta bur zad mi shes pa dang / ma'i mngal du 'jug pa mchog dang / rgyal rigs sogs rigs phun sum cho+ogs pa dang / bu ram shing pa ltar rus phun sum tshoḍa par skye ba dang /gnyen gyi cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang ༈ brgya byin sogs kyis bstod pa'i skye ba phun sum tshogs pa dag dang / sangs rgyas dang lha sogs kyis bskul te nges par 'byung ba dang /tsho byang chub kyi shing rnams kyi drung du 'dug pa dang / stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rdzigis par byed pa rnams su yad pa'i phyir/ /༈ bcu pa mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas 'chad pa la/ sa dgu 'das pyonas ye shes ni/ /zhes pa nas/ bcu pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhes gala'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ dman pa'i sa brgyad dang sa dgu pa

82 mngon n+togs rgyan gyi snyik+ka/man chad byang sems kyi sa zhes gcig tu byas nas sa dgu'i snga ma brgyad la shes mthong dang phyi ma la gnas nas 'das par byas nas thob pa'i sa bcu pa'i ye shes de ni chos can/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu pa yin par shes par bya ste/ rgyu mtshan gang gis na mdo las 'da' bya sa dasdo/ 'das nas sa bcu pa la gnas pa de la sangs rgyas kyi sar gnas zhes ming gis btags nas bshad pa'i phyir/ sa bcu pa chos can/khyod 'dir mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dngos su bshad nas yongs sbyong gyi sno nas dngos su ma bshad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod 'da' bya'i sa de dag gi 'bras bu'i sa yin par shes pa dang / 'da' bya'i sa dgu po thams cad kyi yon tan gyi rigs yar lngan du yod par shes pa'i 'chad du yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod sangs rgyas kyi ming gis 'dog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su gzhan don byed pa'i sgo sangs rgyas dang phyogs mthun mnyam pa'i rgyu mchon gyigade ltar brdzod pa'i phyir / gnyis pa gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub 'chad pa la/ mablong dang goms pa'i lam dag la/ /zhes pa nas/ gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang sgom pa'i lam dag chos can/ khyod la gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya ba yod pa

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 83yin te/spang bya shes sgrib gzung rtog dang 'udzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnam pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir du grangs kyi sgo nas brgyad yod pa'i phyir/der thal/ shes sgrib kun btags lhan skyes gnyis po re re la'ang nyon mongs gzung rtog dang rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis re dang / rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis re sde so sor phye ba brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ bcu pa nges 'byung sgrub pa 'chad pa la/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang / /zhes pa nas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin zhes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ bsgril na/ nges par 'byung ba brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'og nas 'byung ba 'di rnams bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa'i dag sa'i ye shes chos can/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin par shes par bya ste/ rnam mkhyen gdon mi za bar thob par byed pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ nges 'byung sgrub pas 'byung ba'i dbye ba la brgyad yod de/ sngar bshad pa ltar ched du bya ba ba'i/ma dang / chos thams cad bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thugs rje dang / sems can gyi don rdzogs par byed pa dang / 36 de 'bad med lhun grub tu byed pa dang / srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das gingares par 'byung ba dang / theg pa gsum gyi zob bya'i rigs thams

84 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/cad thob pa'i mtshan nyid nges par 'byung ba dang / chos bcu'i rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen nyid dang / rnam mkhyen de'i khyad par gyi lam gyi yul can nges par 'byung ba sne brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir dngos su bsnan pa'i nges 'byung yin na/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ nges par 'byung ba dang po bdun po de nges 'byung sgrub pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dang po bdun po de sangs rgyas kyi sar 'jog dgos shing / tha ma de sa bcu pa'i khyad par gyi lam la 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/༈ gser 'phreng las/ mi slob lam na bdun dang / slob lam gcig tu byas pa na rigs so/ /zhes pa 'di ni bzhan gyis bskul ba'i ngo bor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis rang gi yig cha dang mthun par gtso bor byas nas bzhan la'ang phan snyam pa'i bsam pas bris pa'o / / zhes pa'i gsung par 'di bzhin ser smad grwa tshang gi mkhas grub chen po bstan pa dar rgyas kyi yig cha gzhir bzung ste yig cha'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus rnams spros bshad dang / kha skong / mtha' dpyod/thun mong min pa'i khas len mi gsal ba rnams der gsal yad par brten snga dus blo gsal ba rnams nas yig cha dang zung sbrel gsan sbyong

skabasadang po'i ṭik+ka/ 85mdzad mus dang / kho gnad kyang shin tu che rung / gsung par co ne dgon chen du bzhugs pa dus 'gyur dbang gis sngar nas me bzhes zin 'dug pas da phan slob gnyer ba'i khrod du dpe cha dkon gshis grwa tshang mkhan po rgyal rong blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / dge bshes/ slob gnyer ba rnams nas yig cha cha tshang gsung par zhig 'grub thabs thugs gnyer che ba dang bcas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub dar rgyas gong 'phel yun ring du gnas ched ser smad gzhung pa grwa sku bcar mkhan drung tā bla ma rong rnam sras pa thub bstan nor bzang 4ltaka tshang nas lhag bsam rnam par dag pas rgyu sbyor 'du 'god kyis gong gsal yig cha co ne'i par rnying khungs dag rang la ma phyi byas te rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags pho snag kha4ོra gsung par du legs bskrun thog grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi chos mdzod du bzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i sa bon legs smin thub pa'i ring lugs yangs 'du'i ljon/ /bstan 'dzin rkang drug bye ba rnam rtsen kun dga'i me tog phyogs mthar rgyas/ /ma nor lam bzang 'bras bu'i khur chen bstan srid 'gro phan zungs su dud/ /bla med zhi ba'i grib bsil snum pore 'gro ba ma lus dbugs 'byin shog /sarba maṅga lo/ /

87skabs gnyis pa'i ṭik+ka legs par bshad pa'i snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dzelkelke༈ rje btsun mi pham mgon po la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o / / gnyis pa lam shes tshig don yan lag gi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la/ skabs 'dir lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu ma bshad pa dang /gzhung don dngos bshad pa dang gnyis/ /༈ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ skabs dang por rnam mkhyen bshad zin pa'i 'og tu lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam mkhyen thob pa la lam shes bsgom pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang 'grel pa'i mtshams sbyar du/ rnam gathams cad mkhyen pa nyid rtogs pa ni lamashes pa nyid yongs su shes pa med na med pas lam shes pa nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la| lam shes kyi yan lag bshad pa dang / de'i rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis /tsho dang po ni/ rtsa ba las/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ 'di la tshig don dang / khyab pa'i don bye

88 mngonartogasargyan gyiṭik+ka/brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ngag tu bsgril na/ shes bya chos can / yum gyi mdo las lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su bab pa na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i 'od mog mog por mdzad nas zil gyis mnan pa la dgos pa yod de/ lha de rnams kyi nga rgyal bcom nas rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed dang lam shes skye rung bar bya ba'i phyir du yin pa'i phyir/ lam shes skye ba'i rten gyi yul nges pa yin te/ lam gsum rdzobatag par bsgom pa'i lam la mkhas pa la sna / de'i sngon du rigs can gsum ka'i don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi rten nges par dgos pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' ma zad/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la lam shes skye rung ba yin te/ de thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi rigs rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab pa'i phyir/ lam shes chos can/ nyan rang gi lam las rang bzhin gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ nyan rang ltar nyon mongs gtso bor mi spong bar nyon mongs 'ga' zhig gzhan don sgrub pa'i yano lag tu sgyur bar byed nus pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyid shes bya chas can/ nyan rang gi lam las lam shes de'i byed las kyang khyad par du 'phags te/dus ma yin par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed cing / sems can

skabs gnyis pa 'iṭik+ka/ 89mtha' yas pa smin cing grol bar byed nus pa'i byed las can yin pa'i phyir / bsdu na 'dir bstan pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag de la lnga yod de/der gyur pa'i gegs ma ngon pa'i nga rgyal mngon gyur ba dang bral ba/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab pa/ nyon mongs gtso bor mi spong ba'i rang bzhin/ sems can smin cing grol bar byed nus pa'i byed las dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa la/ khyab pa'i don bshad pa dang / rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dir khyab pa'i don yod de/ 'grel pa las / theg pa gsum rnam nga /ra bzhag pa ni dgongs pa can yin gyi/ma nyid pa ni ma yin no zhes lugs las 'byung bas/ skye bo thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug pa can yin te / zhes pa nas/ lam shes pa nyid bsgom par bya bas khyab pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyis khyab pas/ lam shes bsgom par byar rung bas khyab la/ de la brten nas kyang mthar 'tshang rgya bas kyang khyab pa ni khyab pa'i don yin pas khyab pa rnam pa gsum ga yang 'dir bstan pa'i phyir/ de ltar na'ang mthar thug theg pa gsum bsnan pa'i mdo dang mi 'gal te/ dgongs

90 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/gzhi / dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'grel pa'i phyir/ dgongs gzhi yod de/ gnas skabs rigs gsum so sor nges pa yod pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ dang po nas theg chen du 'jug mi 'dod pa 'ga' zhig rim gyis bkri ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed yod de/ lung du ma dang / rigs pa du mas gnod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ dam chos pad dkar dang /dpal 'phreng gi mdo la sogs pa'i lung du mas gnod pa'i phyir/rigs pas gnodi pa'i tshul mthar zug pa yang / sems can thams cad kyi sems don dam par rang bzhin gyis med cing / dri ma rnams glo bur ba sems rgyud la 'bral rung du gnas pa la nges pa thob dgos pa yin te/de'i tshul rgyas par ni rgyud bla ma rtsa 'grel las bshad pa ltar shes datre sa shing / bsdu na kun 'byung gi chos thams cad tha snyad du yod kyang / don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa yang dag gis dpyad cing btsal na btags don mi rnyed pas/ chags sogs nyon mongs gzhan thams cad kyi rtsa ba bden 'dzin de nyid zhen yul la 'khrul par rtogs pas spong nus su 'grub pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ nyon mongs kyi rtsa ba bden 'dzin de/thag khra la sdul 'dzin gyi blo ltar 'khrul bar nges snobs kyis/ des

skabs gnyisapa 'i ṭik+ka/ 91bskyed pa'i nyon mongs gzhan thams cad kyang glo bur ba yin par nges nus la / de la brten nas gnyen po bsgoms na chags sogs kyi nyon mongs thams cad kyang spong nus su go bas/ mthar sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa'i sangs rgyas thob nus su shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der ma zad/rigs pa des 'khor ba la thog ma med kyang phyi mtha' yod par yang nges nus te/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa las/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rigs yad pa'i phyir 'ga' yang gtan rnam par dag par mi 'gyur ba ni 'os pa ma yin te/ thog med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa/ /rang bzhin gyis dag rtag pa'i chos can phyir/ /thog med sbubs kyis khyim sgrib mi mthong sde/ /ji ltar gser gyi gzugs ni sgrib pa bzhirna/ /zhes dang /bzhi brgya pa las/ji ltar sa bon mtha' mthong zhing / /de la thog ma yod min ltar/ /zhes sogs dang / de bzhin du rgyan snang / rnam 'grel sogs las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de rnams 'dir mtshon tsam zhig bstan gyi / / rgyas par ni gzhung gzhan dang kho bos kyang phar phyin gyi skabs gnyis par bshad zin pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs gtso bor mi spong ba'i sgo nas nyan rang gi lam las rang bzhin gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ra bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan

92 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/du / nyon mongs 'ga' zhig gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu sgrur ba byed par 'god na/ nyon mongs do gang yin zhe na/ yod de/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags/gzugs kyi sas bsdus kyi nyon mongs 'ga' zhig byang chub sems dpas gozhan don sgrub pa'i+o yin lag tu sgyur bar byed dgos pas spang bya'i gtsa bar byas nas mi spang ba'i phyir/ der thal/ byang 'phags 'khor lo sgrur rgyal lto bur skye ba blangs nas sras bskrun te gzhan don byed pa'i yan lag tu 'dad pa'i 'dad chags dgas r+shang / gzugasakhams su skye ba blangs nas de rnams kyi don byed pa la gzugs kyi 'dod chags yan lag tu sgrur bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang thun mong du grags tshul gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ byang 'phags skye ba blangs nas sras bskrun te gzhan don byed pa'i yan lag tu 'dod chags nges par dgos pa min te/ skye ba la dbang thob pa'i byang 'phags nyon mongs spangs pa 'ga' zhig 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal lta bur skye ba blangs nas yum sras kyi 'brel ba ston pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po gzhon nu don grub dang /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po bzhin/ gzhan yang de ltar yad de/ rje'i rim lnga gsal sgron las de med par 'dod pa la dgag pa mdzad nas yod pa ra lung rigs gnyis kyis bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /

skabs gnyis pa'i ṭik+ka/ 93༈ gnyis pa lam shes kyi rang bzhin bshad pa la/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo bshad pa dang / rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis/ /༈ dang po ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ ngag don ni/ lam shes rdzogs par sgom pa nyid kyi tshul la ni nyan thos kyi lam 'di chos can/ khyod ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul shes par bya ba yad de/ sdug bden la sogs pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag gi rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / sems bskyed dang / rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i bsngo ba gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas sgom par byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i don bsdu na 'di ltar yin te/ ska thos rnams kyis mi rtag la sogs bcu drug bsgoms nas thar pa thob par mdzad la/ byang 'phags kyis kyang gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa dang /rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs sbyong ba'i ched du sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab gsumogyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi sgom tshul de dang tshul mthun par ṣ+pertag la sogs bcu drug sgom par mdzad pa'i mkhyen pa de la nyan zos kyi

94 mngon rtogasargyan gyi snyik+ka/lam shes pa'i lam shes zhes pa'i tha stsad mdzad pa'i phyir/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'dir bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug nyams su len pa'i tshul lan mang du gsu ngas pas bcu drug gi ngos 'dzin tsam zhig kyang shes pa gal che ste/ de yang sdug bden nyer len gyi phung po la ni skye 'jig gi mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong ba dang bdag med pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang / kun 'byung las nyon gnyis la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pa dang / kun nas 'byung ba dang rab tu skye ba dang rkyen gyi rnam pa bzhi dang / 'gog pa nyon mongs spangs pa'i bral ba la ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang zhi ba dang gya nom pa dang nges par 'byung ba'i rnam pa bzhi dang / sa lam dang bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes la ni thar lam dang rig pa dang sgrub pa dang nges 'byin gyi bzhi rnam pa bzhi sde bcu drug tu 'byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni/ /zhes pa nas/ mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs / ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi lam mngon sum du shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu la ni sbyor lam drod la sogs pa nges 'byed cha mazun bzhi yad de/ de yang yum gyi mdo las gzugs la sogs pa don dam par rang sga ngobo sa stong pa'i phyir na de dag sga snong pa

skabasaganyesapa 'iṭaṃska/ ()5nyid rnams ngo bo dbyer med par bsnan pa'i gzhung gis bshad pa 'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam dro ba dang / gzugs sogs de dag don dam par mi dmigs shing mi gnas par bsnan pas bshad pa'i zeg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod pa dang / gzugs sogs de dag la don dam par rtag pa dang mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bkag cing mi gnas par bstan pas bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa rnams dang / sa dang po sogs la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas par mi bya'o zhes sogs kyi mdo las sa bcu po dag las brtsams nas ni don dam par mi gnas pa'i tshul rgyas par bstan pa yis mdo las bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos kyi mchog tu gyur pa dang bzhi bshad pa'i phyir/de ltar bshad pas ci phyir zhe na yod de/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos nyid mngon sum du mkhyen nas chos rnams don dam par gnas par ma gzigs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo tshog 'dir lam shes de'i rgyu ngega'abyed cha mthun la snong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin dgos par bsnan gyi stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyob sge/ de nyan thos gyi lam shes pa'i 'a /shes dang 'dra bar nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa zhig dgos r+sā phyir ro/ /

96 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/༈ gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la/ lam bgrod pa'i khyad par/ chos ston tshul/ lam ji ltar ḍās tshul/ de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa nas/ zab pa nyid du mngon par brdzod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ rang 'byung sne rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod kyis srid pa tha ma'i tshe rang gi byang chub mngon du byed par slob dpon bzhan 27sa gdams ngag bstan pa la bltos mi dgos te/de'i tshe de la mi bltos par bdag nyid kyis byang chub rtogs pa ste mngon du byed nus pa'i phyir/ yang zhes smos pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/de'i tshe ngag gis gzhan la chos mi ston par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/bse ru lta bu'i ye shes de ni chos can/ nyan thos las rtogs pa zab pa nyid du mngon par brdzod pa yin te/ nyan thos ltar chos snon pa'i ngag gi 'bras rtags las rtogs mi dgos shing /sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos snon pa'i rtogs pa zab mo dang lngan pa'i phyir/ 'dir bse ru lta bu zhes smos pa ni phyogs gcig gi sgras bsnan pa yin gyi/ rang rgyal yin na/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal yin pas ma khyab ste/ rang rgyal la bse ru lta bu dang tshogs spyod che chung gi rang rgyal gsum yod pa'i phyir/

skabs gnyisapa'i ṭik+ka/ 97rang rgyal slob pa yin na/ rang gi byang chub mngon du byed nges yin pas ma khyab sde/ tshogs spyod che chung gi rang rgyal rigs ma nges pa bar skabs su theg chen lam du 'jug pa yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyis sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos snon pa mang yang / sgra med du chos snon pas ma khyab ste/ tshogs spyod kyi rang rgyal la sgra bcas su chos ston pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos snon tshul ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can / rang rgyal gyis sgra med kyang chos ston pa mi 'gal te/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur bstan pa'i sgo nas gdu0/ bya gang dang gang yin pa des rtogs bya'i r+pā ni gang dang gang la rnam pa ji lta ji ltar to par 'dod pa de dang de la don de dang de bshad pa de ltar snang bar byed nus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa lam ji ltar shes tshul ni/ gzung don rtogs pa spong phyir dang / /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ bse ru lta bu'i lam de ni chos can / khyad chos gsum dang lngan pas yang dag par bsdus par shes par bya ste/ gzung ba gzugs sogs phyi rol don du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gtso bor spong ba'i phyir dang / gzugs 'dzin shes pa sogs nang 'dzin pa la bden par zhen pa gtso bor mi spong ba'i phyir dang ni/ rang rgyal gyi

98 mngonirtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/rigs la brten pa'i rten gyi khyad par gyi sgo nas shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir / gzhung 'dis rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyang bstan pa yin te/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa bamod pa'i tshul gyis tshig gi zur la bstan pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyis gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir du don 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong bar byed pa'i rang gi ye shes rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes su bstan pa'i phyir/'on kyang rang rgyal gyis nang shes pa bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gtso bor mi spong ba ltar byang 'phags kyis ma yin te/ byang sems kyis bden 'dzin lhan skyes thams cad gtso bor spong dgos pa'i phyir ro / / bzhi pa ni/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar/ /zhes pa nas/rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la bzhi yod de/ phyi don med par rtogs kyang brdar btags pa'i chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar chos ston pa'i rnamopa can gyi theg chen gyi sbyor lam dro bar gyur ba dang / gzugs la sogs pa phyi rol don du 'grib pa med par rtogs pa la sogs pas phye bas sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa dang /nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa rtogs pa'i mthu yis gzugs sogs phyi

skabs/ gnyis pa'i ṭik+ka/ 99rol don gyi ched du mi 'dzin pa'i phyir du zhugs pa'i sbyor lam bzod pa dang / gzugs sogs phyi rol don du phye ba med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos kyi mchog ces bya ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gzhung 'dis rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzhi rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyur bstan pa yin te/ snong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas phyi don med par rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi lam shes de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun du bsnan par 'dod dgos pa'i phyir/rnam bshad ltar na de ltar yin spong / 'grel pa'i tshig ris la zin byed kyi sbyor lam bzhi dngos su bsnan par bshad do/ /༈ gsum pa byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes 'chad pa la / mthong lam dang / sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la gnyis / mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po sna/bden dang bden la bzod pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ phan yon bcas pa 'di bshad do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam shekho nyid kyi skabs la mthong ba'i lam phan yon dang bcas pa 'di bshad par bya ste/ sdug kun gyi bden pa dang 'gog lam gyi bden pa bzhi la

10() mngonartogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/bzod pa dang shes pa'i skad cig ma rnam pa bzhi bzhi yi sgo nas bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces pa nas / lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi mthong lam la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod de/ done dam par sdug bden gyi de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas te de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can gyi ye shes dag phan tshun rten dang brten pa med pa'i phyir na don dam par rten brten pa'i rnam grangs khas mi len zhing len pa med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sdug bsngal chos bzod dang / gzugs sogs kyi chos dbyings rgya chen por gyur pa don dam par med par rtogs pa'i ye shes sdug bsngal chos shes dang / sdug bsngal don dam par 'jal ba'i tshad ma dang bcas pa med par rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal rjes bzod dang / sdug bsngal gyi tshad don dam pa ra med par rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal rjes shes dang / kun 'byung don dam par maza' med par rtoḍa pa'i kun 'byung chos bzod dang /chos bzod der gnas nas gzugs la sogs pa la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin bden snong nyid du nges par 'dzin ji 'i kun 'byung chos shes dang /don dam par blang bar bya ba med cing dor ba med pa sogs su rtogs pa'i

skabs gnyis pa'i ṭik+ka/ 101kun 'byung rjes bzod dang / byams pa la sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i yan tan dang ldan pa'i kun 'byung rjes shes dang / 'gog pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'gog pa chos bzod dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob par byed pa'i 'gog pa chos 3kho dang /rnam par byang ba'i rigs kun yongs su bsdus pa'i 'gog pa rjes bzod dang / phyi'i 'tshe ba nyam nga ba dang nang gi nad kun sel bar byed pa'i 'gog pa rjes shes dang / lam bden gyi thob bya mthar zug gi mya ngan las 'das pa ni bden 'dzin gyi spros pa zhi ba'i bden snong nyid du rtogs pa'i lam rjes bzod dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis rang nyid la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa srung ba la sogs par byed pa'i lam chos shes dang / srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa'i dge bcu rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa'i tshul la ni bdag nyid kyang gnas te/ sems can gzhan dag 'god par byed pa'i lam rjes bzod dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa phyin drug gi dge rtsa rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar byed pa'i lam rjes shes dang bcas pa lam shes pa nyid kyi skabs su mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug yad pa'i phyir/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug ni ldog pa phye ba yin gyi/ bsdu na bzod shes gnyis

102 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/su 'du sde/ theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam la bzod pa brgyad dang / rnam grol lam la shes pa brgyad du phye bas de gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir / bzod shes gnyis las bzod pa brgyad sngon du skye zhing / shes pa brgyad rjes su skye ba yin te/ mthong lam bar chad med lam sngon du skyes nas rnam grol lam rjes su skye ba'i phyir/des na bzod pa brgyad cig car dang / shes pa brgyad cig car tu skye yang / brgyad kyi tha snyad byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bden bzhi'i chos nyid dang de rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis chos nyid gzigs tshul gyi sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir te/ sdug bsngal chos bzod dang rjes bzod/ de bzhin du kun 'byung / 'gog pa/ lam la'ang sbyar te/ bzod pa brgyad dang / sdug bsngal chos shes dang rjes shes dang de bzhin du gzhan gsum la sbyar bas shes pa brgyad du 'jog pa'i phyir te/yul bden bzhi'i chos nyid gsar du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas chos bzod dang / yul can chos bzod bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes bzod du 'jog la/ bden 'dzin kun btags spangs pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas chos shes dang / chos shes kyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rjes shes su 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/bzod pa dang shes pa zhes brdzod pa'i rgyu

skabasaganyis ri 'iṭik+ka /()kyimatshan yod de/ chos nyid mngon su ma du rtogs ji na bya byed kyi rnam bzhage 'jig pa ltar 'gyur bas skrags rigs pa las mi skrags pas skye med la bzod pa dang / bden 'dzin kun btags spangs pa'i 'gog ji/ mngon du byas pa'i cha nas chos nyid mngon sum du shes pas shes pa zhes brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir mthong lam mnyam gzhag ye shes dngos su bstan nas mthong lam rjes thob ye shes don gyis 'phangs pa yin te/theg chen gyi mthong lam thams cad ston pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir༈ /༈ gnyis pa sgom lam bshad pa la/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang /byed pa can gyi sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun nas 'i dang thams cad la/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ ces pa'i bar rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ thel chen sgom lam gyi byed pa de la drug yod de/ byang sems sgom lam nga thugs khengs pa'i nga rgyal sogs kun nas zhib dang / de'i ma thus dbe ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la 'dud pa dang / nyon mongs ci rigs pa 'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang / pha rol gyi gnod pas brdzi ba med pa nyid dang bcas pa'i skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu bzhi dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nas chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gcig

104 mngon rtogs r+ghaṃn gyi ṭik+ka/dang / rten sgom lam pa rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de gzhan gyis mchod pa'i gnas nyid du 'gyur ba'i bdag po'i 'bras bu gcig dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir byed pa'i don ni theg chen sgom lam bsgoms snobs kyis zob pa dang thob 'gyur gyi phan yon la byed pa yin zhing / de yang 'di'i dngos bsnan ni theg chen gyi sgom lam rang rgyud la skyes pa zhig gis de bsgoms pa'i phan yon yin la/ theg chen sgom lam mos pa yid byed kyis sgom pa dang de bsgoms pa'i phan yon tsam la ni sgom lam thob pas ma khyab ste/ lam ma zhugs na de sgom pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de na rnam mkhyen sgom pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de na sangs rgyas kyi sku sgom par byed pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam/ zag med sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ mos pa sgom lam/bsngo ba sgom lam/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam bshad pa dang gsum/ /༈ dang po la/ dngos dang / phan yon no/ /dang po sna/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi mos pa sgom lam chos can/ rnam pa gsum du shes par bya sde/ rang gi don gyi mos pa sgom lam dang / de bzhin rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don dang / gzhan don mos pa sgom lam dang bcas pa

skabs gnyis pa'i ṭik+ka/ 105rnams su yad pa'i phyir/ gsum po de yang ni chos can/ khyod la dbye na so sor rnam pa gsum du yad de/ khyod re re la der gyur pa'i chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i mos pa sgom lam rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mos pa sgom lam chung 'bring chen po de yang chos can/ re re la'ang rnam pa gsum gsum du 'dod pa yin te/ chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs te chung ngu'i 'bring dang de'i chen po sogs kyi dbye ba yis de ltar du yad pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/ bsdu na mos pa sgom lam de la rnam pa nyi ro/ bdun du 'dod pa yin te/ lngar bshad pa ltar dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun du 'gyur ba de ltar na'i phyir/ gnyis pa phan yon ni/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang don gzhan don gnyis don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni chos can/ de ltar mos pa'i byang sems sgom lam pa la sangs 41sa byang sems rnams kyis bstod pa dang bkur ba dang ni bsngags par 'dod de/ sngar ltar dgu tshan gsum gyis bstod bkur bsngags par bzhed pa'i phyir/ mos pa sgom lam la mos pa zhes baji+od pa'i snye/ mtshan pa/ོda de/ gzhukying lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum po re re'ang don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches shing mos pas na de ltar du brdzod pa'i phyir/ sgom lam 'di

106 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/gtso bo'i dbang du byas na rjes thob ye shes kyis bsdus te/ sngar ltar mos shing sgom pa ni rjes thob nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ mnyam gzhag yin pa yod kyang rtog bcas yin te/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pas bsdus pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'dir rtog pa dang bcas pa'i sgom lam la ni zag bcas sgom lam zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa bsngo ba sgom lam ni/ yangs su bsngo ba khyad par can / / zhes pa nas/ bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i 4 ngas su bsngo ba khyad par can de yi byed pa ni bsngo ba gzhan lanu/ mchog yin te/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba rdzogs byang du sgyur bar byed pas khyad par du byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam de chos can/ rnam pa bcu gnyis su 'gyur te/ ji skad bshad pa'i byed pa mchog dang ldan pa'i bsngo ba dang / bsngo bya'i rdzas la bden zhen 'gog pa'i dmigs med kyi rnam pa can gyi bsngo ba dang / gang gis bsngo bar byed pa'i phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi bsngo ba dang / bsngo ba podo na dam par dben par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i bsngo ba dang / rang dang sangs rgyas kyi

skabs gnyis pa'iṭik+ka/ 107bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin don dam par mi dmigs par dran pa'i spyod yul can gyi bsngo ba dang / phyin drug gi dge rtsa don dam par mi dmigs par bsngo ba'i thabs mkhas dang bcas pa'i bsngo ba dang / gang gis gang du gang bsngo ba'i nyakhor gsum gyi bden zhen 'gog pa mtshan ma med pa'i bsngo ba dngo / don dam par med kyang sgru ma lta bur shes nas sangs rgyas kyi sar bsnga ba'i sangs rgyas kyis rjes su yi rang ba'i bsngo ba dang / 'khor ba'i rgyur mi bsngo bas 'dod pa'i khams la sogs pa'i khams gsum du gtogs pa ma yin pa'i bsngo ba dang / stong gsum gyi sems can rnams dge ba bcu la bkod pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam pa'i bsngo ba chung ngu dang / rgyun zhugs la bkod pa'i bsod nams 'bring dang / sangs rgyas kyi lam la bkod pa'i bsod nams chen po 'byung ba yi bsngo ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de rnams las gang bsod nams lhag par che ba yod de/ phyi ma gzhan ni rnam pa gsum po de bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam 'di ni dge rtsa bsngo tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin te/ dge rtsa rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ 'di yang rjes thebo tu 'byung ba yin te/ bsngo smon gyi bya ba rjes thob tu mdzad dgos pa'i

108 ma ngonartogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/phyir / byang sems sgom lam pas rang myud kyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar nges kyang de kho nar bsngo ba min te/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde la 'god pa'i ched du bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir / des gzhan gyi dge rtsa rnams rdzogs byang du bsngo yang / de tsam gyis dge rtsa de rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i go chod par bzhag dka' ste/bzhan du na nyan rang la sogs pa'i dge rtsa thams cad kyang rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i dge rtsar thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dge rtsa rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ mi 'dzad cang bsod nams rgya chen po 'byung ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung / /zhes pa nas/byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa rjes su yi rang gi sgom lam ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ /zhes pa nas/ sgom pa yin par 'dir bamod do / / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ byang se mas sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa'i sgom lam chos can/ khyod rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa'i sgom pa'i lam yin par skabs 'dir brdzod pa yin te/ dge rtsa rnams bden stong sgyu ma

skabs gnyis pa'i ṭik+ka/ 109lta bur rtogs pa'i thabs dang de rnams don dam par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa dag gis rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la dga' ba sgom pa'i yid bde dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam 'di yang rjes thob tu 'byung ba yin te/ rang gzhan gyis dge ba sgrubs pa'i tshul shes nas rjes su yi rang mdzad pa ni rjes thob nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba sogs bya ba bzang po gang la yang rjes su yi rang bar byas na phan yon chen po 'byung ba yin te/ sdud pa las/ stong gsum ri rab srang las gzhal bas tshad bzung rung / rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de ltar min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa zag med sgom lam bshad pa la/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /ces pa nas/ gtod par byed par don chen nyid / / ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/khyod la ldog pa'i sgo nas rnam pa lnga yad de/ gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam de yi ngo 'i ted dang / thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pa'i sbyin sogs

110 mngonartogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/kyis sangs rgyas mi 'thob cing thabs la mkhas pas de 'thob pa'i thabs kyi mchog nyid dang / chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pas kun la bden par mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang / gnas skabs kyi byang chub khyad par can chos rnams dmigs su med par ni gtod par byed pa dang /mthar sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur bas don chen po nyid du byed pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam 'di dang / 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rnam dag sgom lam gnyis ka gnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su 'byung ba yin la / 'di'i dngos brnya na ni gtso bor stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i dbang du mdzad cing / spyir sgom lam de gnyis la stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab ste/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam yin te/gtso bor rtogs ji mthar thug sga lag rjes 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir te/bdage med mngon su/ma du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug sgrub byed kyi byang sems kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ rnam dag sgom lam yin te/ gtso bor spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir te/ bdag 'dzin gnyis sbangs pa'i spangs pa mthar thug sgrub par byed pa'i ye shes khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang / de gnyis sgrub byed dang lag

skabasaganyisapa 'i ṭik+ka/ 111rjes 'jog byed kyi rigs su gnas pa ni min te/ de rtogs pa nyi tshe ba dang spangs pa nyi tshe ba'i lag rjes 'jog byed kyi rigs su gnas pa'i phyir te/de rtogs rigs gnyis las theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa la/ rgyu'i khyad par/ yul gyi khyad par/ 'bras bu'i khyad par/ ngo bo'i khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang / /zhes pa nas/ sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs zin pa'o / / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ phyi'i rkyen sangs rgyas kyis mtshon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsden pa dang / nang rkyen sbyin sogs dang zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa de chos can/khyod rnam dag sgom lam 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin te/ de skye ba'i mthun rkyen khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ bdud kyis zibs kyis non pa'i gnodi pa byas pa dang / zab mo'i chos snong pa nyid la mi mos pa dang /phung po la sogs pa'i chos la bden par mngon par zhen pa dang / sdig pa'i ༷thogs pos yongs su zin pa rnams chos can/ khyod rnam dag sgom lam sogs chos kyis phongs pa'i rgyu dag yin te/ de skye ba'i gegs byed 'gal rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yul gyi khyad par ni/ 'bras bu

112 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi cik+ka/dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /zhes pa nas/ gcad du med par dag par brjod / / ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa'i theg chen sgom lam rnam grol lam ni rang 'dren byed bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na/ de'i dmigs yul gzugs la sogs pa yang bar chad med lam de'i ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa nyid yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na dag pa de gnyis dag bya gcig gis dben pa'i sgo nas ngobo tha dad ma yin zhing / lngog pa yang rigs tha dad par gcad du med pas te de'i phyir/ de gnyis chos can/ rigs tha dad ma yin te/ rigs gcig par brdzod pa'i phyir/ de yang cung zad phye na/ sa gnyis pa'i sgom lam rnam grol lam chos can/khyod rang 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri pas rnam par dag pa'i tshe/ khyod kyi dmigs yul gzugs sogs kyang khyod 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa yin te/ de'i tshe khyod rang nyid 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i dag pa de dang /khyod kyi dmigs yul gzugs sogs khyod 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i dri mas rnam par dag pa'i dag pa de gnyis

skabasaganyis pa'i ṭik+ka/ 113dag bya gcig gis dben pa'i dag pa rigs gcig yin pa'i phyir/ de'i don yang yod de/ sa gnyis pa'i sgom lam rnam grol lam lta bus rang 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma spangs nas/ rjes zob tu gzugs sogs kyi chos gang la dmigs kyang sngar spangs pa'i dri ma rnams slar skye mi rung du song bas de'i sgo nas rang dang dmigs yul gnyis dag par mtshungs pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa 'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ slob ma nyan zos kyi rnam dag yin te/ nyon mongs spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag yin te/gzugs sogs phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i rang rgyal gyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags kyi 'gog bden chos can/ rgyal sras rnams kyi rnam par dag pa yin te/ nyan rang byang sems kyi lam gsum gyi sgrib pa ci rigs nyams shing spangs pa'i byang sems kyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi 'gog bden chos can/

114 mngon rtogasakhyun gyi ṭik+ka/rnam kun shin tu ba'i dag pa yin te/ sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ rnam dag gi tha snyad de dag yum gyi mdo las gsungs pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ snga ma ni mdo las/ rab 'byor gzugs rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni 'bras bu rnam par dag pa'o / / zhes pa nas/ de lār na thams cad mkhyen nyid rnam par dag pa dang / 'bras bu rnam par dag pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa gang yin pa 'di la gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med so so ma yin tha mi dad do/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / phyi ma ni/ 'dod chags dang zhe snang dang gasta mug rnam par dag pa dang / zhes pa nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yongs su dag pa gang yin pa 'di la gnyis su byar med de tha mi dad cing mchad pa'o zhes pa dgos pa yod/ ces pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ bzhi pa ngo bo'i khyad par la/ rnam dag shin tu ba yin min gyi khyad par dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu bar bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po sna/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes pa nas/ sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ done ni/ shes bya chos can/rnamadag la shin tu ba yin min gyi khyad par 'thad de/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam

skabasaganyisapa'iṭik+ka/ sdi15dag don 'dod pa dang bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi sde sa dgu la ni gtogs pa'i sgomaspang bden 'dzin lhan skyes chen po yi chen po nas chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams rim gyis 'joms byed gnyen po ga chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam chung ngu'i chung ngu dang chung ngu'i 'bring la sogs pa'i lam ni rim gyis skye stobs kyis dri ma de dag dag par byed pa'i rgyu byas pa'i sgo nas mthar thug pa'i rnam dag shin tu ba yin la / nyan rang gi rnam dag ni tshul de ltar thob pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa ni/ de la klan ka spangs pa yis/ /zhes pa nas/gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsu ngas/ ngag don ni/theg chen (1 sgom lam bar chad med rnams ni chos can/ khams gsum sa dgus bsdus pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po khyad par can nyid du 'dod pa yin te / spang bya che rim nas 'gag cing gnyen po chung rim nas skye ba'i spang gnyen gyi rim pa de la gzhan gyis rtsod pa 'i klan ka spangs pa yi sgo nas spang bya de rnams kyi gnyen por grub pa'i phyir/ de ltar grub ste/ dper na/snang ba skye stobs kyis mun pa rim gyis phel ba ltar/ 'jal byed shes pa dang / gzhal bya dag bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa nyid kyi sgo nas ye shes de rnams kyis spang bya de dag rim gyis 'joms

116 mngon hoṃgs rgyan gyi snyik+ka/par byed pa'i phyir/ klan ka ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam chung rim nas bden 'dzin che rim gyis spong ba mi 'azad par thal/ sgom lam che rim gyis bden 'dzin che rim nas spong ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ dper na / dgra stobs lngan 'dul ba la gnyen po yang stobs dang ldan dgos pa bzhin no zhe na/ lan ni skabs 'dir skyon de mi 'jug par thal/ 'dir spang gnyen gyi rim pa de ni gos la chags pa'i dri ma che rim nas sel ba dang mtshungs kyi/ snga ma dang dpe mtshungs pa ma yin pas so/ /gtso bo'i dbang du byas na theg chen gyi sgom lam sa gnyis pa nas sa bcu pa'i bar la 'jog kyang / sa dang por yang sgom lam yod de/ theg chen sgo 'byed las/ sa dang po sna bskal pa la sogs pa'i yun gyis rdzogs dgos pas de'i ngo bore gyur pa'i sgom lam yod par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sa dang po na sgom lam mnyam gzhag ye shes yad par ma zad/ rjes thob ye shes kyang yod de/ rnam bshad las/mos pa sgom lam de ma dag sa bdun na yod par bshad pa'i rigs pas 'grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / sa dang po'i ngo bor gyur pa 'i sgom lam yad de/ 'grel chen las/ sa dang po'i skad cig ma dang po ni mazong ba'i lam yin no/ /skad cig ma gnyis pa nas rdo rje lta bur brdzod pa'i bar chad med pa'i lam gang las de ma thag sangs rgyas kyis kun tu 'ode

skabasagasum pa'i ṭik+ka/ 117byed pa'i bar 'di dag thams cad ni sgom pa'i lam yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /skabs gsum pa'i ṭik+ka legs par bshad pa'i snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /smungamadzosno ༈ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum pa gzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ skabs 'dir gzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / gzhung don bshad pa gnyis/ /༈ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam shes bshad zin pa'i 'og tu bzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/las shes rgyud la skye ba la mi rtag sogs bcu drug yongs su shes pa'i sgo nas bzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyams su len dgos shing med na mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'grel pa las/gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med par lam legs par yongs su shes pa med pas thams cad shenu pa nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /

/18 mngon rtogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/༈ gnyis pa gzhung don bzhed pa la/ dngos dang / mkhyen gsum gyi 'jug bsdu ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'bras yum la nye ring gi lam bshad pa/ bzhi shes sbyor ba bshad pa/ sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ nye ring sga rgyu mtshan/ rgyu mtshan de nyid sgrub pa/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po sna/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min/ /zhes pa nas/ shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ngag don ni/ 'dir bsnan bzhi shes pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos can/ khyod sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la nye bar 'dod pa yin te/ dus gsum gyi chos rnams bden pa'i rang bzhin med pa ra mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du shes pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ tshu rol 'khor ba'i mtha' dang pha rol zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis la gnas pa ma yin te/ mtha' de gnyis 'gog byed kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mtha' de das gi bar na yang don dam par gnas pa ma yin te/ snong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha'i khyad par yod de/ srid mtha' ni gzhi kun rdzob la ltos pa'i

skabs gsum pa'iṭik+ka/ /19srid mtha' sde 'khor ba yin la/ zhi mtha' ni de la bltos pa 'i zhi mtha' sde chad pa'i myang 'das la byed pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags chos can/ 'dir bstan srid mtha' la mi gnas te/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khotha bar skye ba mi len pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba len pa yin te/ der skye ba len pa'i rgyu brtse ba snying rje sogs thabs dang shes rab khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'dir bstan 'i mtha' la khri/nga mi gnas te/ las nyon chad tsam /) myang 'das thob byar don du mi gnyer ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ de lta bu'i myang 'das don du mi gnyer te/ sems can gyi don du 'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba bzhes nas don mdzad cing sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa nye ring sga rgyu mtshan sgrub pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs/ sgo nas/ /zhes pa nas/ yang dag nye ba nyid du bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ nyan rang 'phags pa chos can/ gzhi bes pa'i sher phyin de ni khyod la ring ba yin te/ khyod gzhi bden pa'i ma tshan mar dmigs pa sde bzung ba'i sgo nas 'bras yum bskyed pa'i thabs ma yin pas zin pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags chos can/ sher phyin de ni khyod la spong dag par nye ba nyid du bshad de/ 'bras yum bskyed pa'i thabs la

120 mngon rtogasargyan (kyi ṭik+ka/mkhas pa stong nyid rtogs pa yis zin pa'i phyir/ de ni bden 'dzin yod pa tsam min gyi/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings ma bcings kyi dbang gis yin te/ skabs gsum pa'i lugs 'dir nyan rang la snong nyid rtogs pa med pas bden 'dzin gyis bcings par 'dod cing / byang 'phags rnams kyis stong nyid rtogs myong bas des ma bcings pa'i phyir/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i don yang yod de/ stong nyid rtogs ma myong zhing bden zhen las re zhig 'da' mi nus pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum dzimi mazun phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs kyi dbye ba bshad pa la/ bzhi lam la mtshan 'dzin spang gnyen dang / 'bras bu la ma 'dzin spang gnyen dang / /mjug bsdu ba bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mi mthun phyogs dang / gnyen po'i phyogs gnyis las/ /༈ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs phung po snong nyid dang / /zhes pa nas/ spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/ gzhi shes bya ji lta bas bsdus pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid dang / ji snyed pas bsdus pa 'das pa la sogs pa'i dus gsum du gtogs pa'i chos rnams dang / lam sbyin pa dang tshul khrims sogs byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams la bden zhen

skabasagasum pa'i ṭik+ka/ 121gyis spyod pa'i 'du shes kyis bcings pa'i lam chos can/ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs nges pa de'i lam gyi tredzel sa'i mi mazun phyogs yin te / 'bras bu sher phyin sgrub pa'i ring lam yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /ces pa nas / de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pas/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/ lam sbyin pa la sogs pa la bden zhen gyi ngar 'dzin med pa la rang nyid gnas shing / gzhan dag de la sbyor bar byed pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de ni chos can/ bzhi lam la bden par chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pa yin te/ chags pa de'i gnyen po khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman gyi bzhi shes la mi mthun phyogs kyi bzhi shes kyi tha snyad mdzad pa ni bden 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i byang sems kyi lam la bltos nas yin gyi/theg dman gyi gzhi shes de mi mthun phyogs dngos ma yin te/ mthun phyogs khyad par can yin pa'i phyir te/ 'phags lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs gsu ma pa 'dir mi mthun phyogs kyi bzhi shes la bden 'dzin gyis bcings pas khyab par bstan pa ni dgos pa'i dbang gis yin gyi/ de kho na ltar 'dod dgos pa'i nges pa ni med de/ skabs gzhan dang khyad

122 mngoni rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/pa ra du rigs kyi skabs su theg dman 'phags pa la stong nyid rtogs myong yod par la bsnan pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang gnyen bshad pa la/chags pa'i ngobo / de'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i gnyen po/ 'phros don bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po 3/ rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra/ /zhes gsungs/don ni/ rgyal ba la sogs pa'i 'bras bu la bden par chags pa phra mos bcings bzhin du de la phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa chos can/ byang sems lam gyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ de'i gol sa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni / chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /dben pa'i phyir na de zab pa nyid / / ces gsungs/ don ni/ chos rnams kyi lam gnas lugs mthar thug de ni chos can/ zab nyid yin te/ bden par grub pa'i rang bzhin gyis dben pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sna/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig pa ni/ /shes pas chags pa spong ba yin/ /zhes gsungs / don ni/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin bden stong du gcig par ni mngon sum du shes pa'i byang 'phags kyi ye shes chos can/ khyod kyis 'bras bu la bden par chags pa spong ba yin te/ de 'joms byed kyi gnyen po khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ zab pa'i rgyu mtshan

skabs gsumapa'i ṭik+ka/ 123dang / rtogs dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan dang gnyis/ dang po sna/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis/ /de ni rtogs par dka' bar bshad/ /ces gsungs / don dam pa'i bden pa de ni chos can/ zab mo thogs pa ra dka' bar bshad de/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs shes kyis rtogs par bya ba yin gyi gzugs sgra mthong ba la sogs pa'i tha snyad pa'i tshad mas khyod mthong ba bkag pa yis te de'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir/ /de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod/ /ces gsungs/ don ni/ don dam bden nga de ni chos can/ tha snyad pa'i blos rtogs par dka' ba yin te/ blo des bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa de'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod gzugs la sogs pa kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin par mi shes pa'i phyir ram/gzugs sogs ltar mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la / / zhes pa nas/ ji skad bshad pa 'dir shes bya/ /zhes pa 'i bar gsungs / don ni/ shes bya chos can/ kun shes gzhi shes nyid kyi lugs la ste skabs su mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes dag gi rnam par dbye ba ma lus pa yum gyi mdo las

124 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/ji skad bshad pa de rnams 'dir yang dad+nghos shugs ci rigs kyi sgo nas bshad par shes pa bya sde/ sngar bshad pa de ltar shes par bya dgos pa'i phyir / gnyis pa bzhi shes sbyor ba 'chad pa la/ dbye ba dang / rang bzhin bshad pa gnyis/ /༈ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /zhes pa nas/ snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni / shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba de la bcu yod de/yul gyi sgo nas bzhi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gsum/ byed las kyi sgo nas gnyis / dpe'i sgo nas gcig rnams su yad pa'i phyir/ dang po yul gyi sgo nas bzhi yod de/ khyad bzhi gzugs sogs la bden par zhen pa dang /khyad chos de mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs dang / de yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs pa dang rab tu rdzogs pa dang / de la bden par chags pa med nyid la bden par spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ngo ri'i sgo nas gsum yod de/ bya ba la bden zhen 'gog pa mi 'gyur ba dang / byed pa po la bden zhen 'gog pa byed po med pa nyid dang /'bras/ bu la bden zhen 'gog pa bya dka' ba rnam pa gsum gyi sbyor ba dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ bya dka' ba gsum yod de/ ched du bya dka' ba/

skabs gsum pa'i ṭik+ka/ 125sbyor ba bya dka' ba/ las bya dka' ba dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byed las kyi sgo nas gnyis yod de/ rigs can gsum gyi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin 'bras bu thob pas 'bras bu yod par 'dod pa'i sbyor ba de dang ni/phan yon dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan la rag las pa med pa gang yin pa'i sbyor ba dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa shes byed dpe'i sgo nas gcig yad de/ snang ba rnam pa bdun du shes par byed pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba gcig yad pa'i phyir/ snang ba rnam bdun yad de/ rmi lam sgyu ma smig rgyu sgra brnyan gzugs brnyan dri za'i grong khyer sprul pa'i dpe bdun gyis/phyi nang gi chos rnams bden par med kyang rten 'brel gyi snang ba tsam du sgrub tshul rnam pa bdun yod pa'i phyir/ de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang / /zhes pa'i dngos bsnan gyi yan tan gyi rten du rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi khyad par yod de/ gang la dmigs na nyon mongs skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyogs gzugs sgra sogs yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs la/gang la dmigs nas bsgoms pas rtogs pa gong 'phel du 'asdi/ra ba gzugs sogs mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang snong pa dang bdag medacipa lta bu yon tan gyi rten du rdzogs par 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa rang bzhin ni/ gzugs la sogs pa rlom med

126 mngonartogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/pa / / rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid/ /ces gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir sems dpa'i bzhi shes sbyor ba de yi mnyam nyid de la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ yul gzugs la sogs pa'i nge sto dang mtshan ma dang dbye ba dang yul can la bden par rlom pa med pa'i sbyor ba bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba dang / de'i mnyam nyid kyi khyad par yod de/ spyir theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes rnams dang po yin zhing / stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes rnams phyi ma yin la/ gzhung gnyis ka'i dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas na de 'dra ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam la byed pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa la/skad cig ma mdor bstan pa dang / rnam pa rgyas/ par bshad pa gnyis/ /༈ dang po sna/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ /zhes pa nas / kun shes tshul la mazong ba'i lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi po so so la dmigs nas chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang / rjes

skabasagasum pa'i ṭik+ka/ 127su shes pa'i bzod pa dang / chos dang rjes su shes pa'i mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gi bdag nyid 'di chos can/ kun shes tshul la mthong ba'i lam yin te/ 'da' byed kyi theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dis 'da' bya 'da' byed gnyis kyi nang nas 'da' byed kyi mthong lam bstan pa yin la/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ snong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de gnas nas 'da' byed dang / gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de shes ma'ong gis bltas nas 'da' bya'i lam yin pa'i phyir / de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems kyis thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i don du stong nyid gtso bor bsgom dgos shing / nyan rang gi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du gang zag gi bdag med zhar byung ngam phal pa'i tshul gyis sgom par byed pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba gnyis/ /༈ dang po sna/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min/ /zhes pa /khukhu / shes pa skye ba med pa ni/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sdug sdis la gyi bden pas bsdus pa'i gzugs tshor sogs mi rtag pa chos

128 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/can / don dam par rtag pa yang min mi rtag pa yang ma yin te/ don dam par rtag mi rtag gnyis ka dang bral ba'i phyir te/ don dam par ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ rtags 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar dgos te/ bden bzhi don dam par med par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sdug bden gyi rnam pa phyi ma gsum chos can/don dam par rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das padang / don gzhan gyis snong pa rnam par dag pa dang / rang dbang ba'i bdag gi ngo bo ma grub don dam par ma skyes pa dang ma 'gags pa la sogs kyis kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba min te/ rim pa bzhin don dam par sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal ma yin pa dang bral ba'i phyir dang / snong mi stong dang / bdag dang bdag med pa dang yang bral ba'i phyir te/ mthong lam sdug bsngal shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par ma grub par rtogs pa'i phyir/ las sred kyis bsdus pa'i kun 'byung gi rnam pa 'di chos can/ don dam par ma grub pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ba dang / chags sogs kyi sred pa don dam par grub pa spangs pa dang / don dam par yongs su 'dzin pa las sngo la ba dang / don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis brdzod du med pa yin te/ rim pa bzhin sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa dang / kun 'byung yin min dang / rab skye yin min

skabasagasum pa'i ṭik+ka/ 129dang / rkyen dang rkyen min rnams su dosko dam par ma grub pa'i phyir te/kun 'byung shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par mgrub par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden 'di'i don sdug bsngal spangs pa'i bral ba chos can/ don dam par ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na tshig tu brdzod pa yi sgo nas gzhan rgyud la don dam par sbyin du med pa dang /dmigs pa don dam par med par byed pa dang / rtag chad las 'das shing rang bzhin gyis shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / gnod pa'i nad thams cad mi 'byung ba'i yon tan dang lngan pa yin te/ rim pa bzhin 'gog pa yin min dang / zhi ba yin min dang / gya nom yin min dang / nges 'byung yin min rnams su don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir te/ 'gog pa shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par ma grub par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam bden chos can/ ngan song gsum chad pa dang / rgyun zhugs sogs kyi 'bras bu ni mngon du bya ba la rnam par mi rtog pa nyid dang /don dam par grub pa'i mtshan ma dag dang ma 'brel ba dang brjod bya'i dngos po dang rdzod byed kyi ming soso ba dang gnyis po la gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis shes pa skye ba med pa ni yin te/ rim pa bzhin lam dang lam ma yin pa dang / rig pa dang rig

130 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/pa ma yin pa dang / sgrub pa dang sgrub pa ma yin dang / nges 'byin dang nges 'byin ma yin par don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par ma grub par gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa don bsdu tshul ni/ kun shes nyid kyi skad cig ma / / zhes gsungs/ don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i kun shes nyid kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug chos can/ byang sems kyi mthong lam yin te/de'i bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs su mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngeni sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam 'chad rigs pa las/ de mi snon par stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen mthong lam ston pa mi 'azad do zhe na/ skyon med de/'dir zin byed 'da' byed kyi mthong lam dngos su bstan pa'i shugs la/theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i de 'dra ba'i 'da' bya'i mthong lam bsdus nas bsnan pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ 'dir nyan thos rang rgyud kyi mthong lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la bsgom par bya ba shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' bar bya ba'i mthong lam gnyis ka bsdus nas bsnan nga yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir mthong lam

skabasagasumapa'iṭik+ka/ 131bstan pa'i 'jug de ma zag mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam dngos su ston pa'i gzhung zhig 'byung rigs pa las mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/de byang chub sems dpas gnas nas 'da' ba'i lam du ston mi rigs pas ma bstan la/ shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba'i lam du ston mi dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ sngar de 'dra ba'i mthong lam de shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba'i lam du bsnan pa la brten nas/ de'i rigs rgyun du gyur pa'i sgom lam yang de 'dra ba'i lam du go nus pas mobastan pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu sna/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang / /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs par yongs su bstan pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ rtsa ba ltar na de ltar mkhyen gsum rgyas par bstan nas/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor yum 'di ni chos gang yang thob par byed pa ma yin/ zhes sogs gzhi shes kyi mjug bsdur ston pa'i tshig bcu dgu po 'di dang / yang rab 'byor de ltar khams gsum las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin zhes sogs lam shes kyi mjug bsdu ba'i tshig 'di dang / yang rab 'byor yum 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi

132 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/chos rnams ster bar byed pa'am 'phrog par byed pa ma yin zhes sogs rnam mkhyen gyi mjug bsdu ba'i tshig 'di yin te mdo sachog rnam pa gsum po 'di ni chos can/ sngar mkhyen gsum brdzod byar byas pa'i gnas skabs gsum po dag gi mjus rdzogs par yangs su bsnan pa yin te/ de rnams kyi mjug sdud rdzogs par ston pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'grel pa las rnam mkhyen gyi mjug sdud thog mar byas nas 'chad de/zams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di dang / lam shes pa nyid 'di dang / thams cad shes pa nyid 'di ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi dgongs pa mi 'gal te/ rtsa ba ltar bshad pa ni yum bar ma'i dbang du byas la/'grel par bshad pa de nyid brgyad stong pa'i mjug sdud ston tshul yin pa'i phyir / yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum po tshig rgyas bsdus yad kyang don 'dra ste/ brgyad snong par yang gzhan gnyis kyi don thams cad tshang bar ston pa'i phyir te/ brgyad stong don bsdus las/ de ltar ji skad bshad rnams ṅgha /brgyad stong 'dir don ma tshang med/ /'dir gzhung bsdus pa yin 'dod de/ /don ni ji skad gsungs de nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro / / de lta bu'i skabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i ṭik+ka legs par bshad pa'i snying po 'di nyid shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas

skabs gsum pa'i ṭik+ka/ 133sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa'i gsung par 'di bzhin ser smad grwa tshang gi mkhas grub chen po bsnan pa dar rgyas kyi yig cha gzhir bzung ste yig cha'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus rnams spros bshad dang / kha skong / mtha' dpyod/thun mong min pa'i khas len mi gsal ba rnams 'dir gsal yad par brten snga dus blo gsal ba rnams nas yig cha dang zung sbrel gsan sbyong mdzad mus dang / mkho gnad kyang shin tu che rung / gsung par co ne dgon chen du bzhugs pa dus 'gyur dbang gis sngar nas me bzhes zin 'dug pas da phan slob gnyer ba'i khrod du yig cha dkon gzhis grwa tshang mkhan po rgyal rong blo bzang bsnan 'dzin dang / dge bshes/ slob gnyer ba rnams nas yig cha cha tshang gsung par zhig 'ashākha thabasazugs gnyer che ba dang bcas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun phan bde'i rtsa ba 7rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che bzhad sgrub dar rgyas gong 'phel yun ring du gnas ched ser smad gzhung pa grwa sku bcar mkhan drung tā bla ma rong rnam sras pa zub bstan nor bzang shag tshang nas lhag bsamarnatshipar dag pas rgyu sbyor 'du 'god kyis gong gsal yig cha co ni'i par rnying khyangs dag rang la ma phyi byas te rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags pho stag lor gsung par du legs bskrun thog grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi chos mdzod du bzhugs su

134 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/gsol ba'o/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i sa bon legs smin thub pa'i ring lugs yongs 'du'i ljon/ /bsnan 'dzin rkang drug bye ba rnam rtsen kun dga'i me tog phyogs mthar rgyas/ /ma nor lam bzang 'bras bu'i khur chen bsnan srid 'gro phan zungs su dud/ /bla med zhi ba'i grib bsil snum por 'gro ba ma lus dbugs 'byin shog / dge legs 'phel/ /

135skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka legs par bshad pa'i snying po ba3/sa pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//smuru smuru sko2༈ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa sbyor bzhi rgyas par bshad pa la sbyor bzhi'i dang po rgyu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa la/ skabs 'dir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang /gzhung don dngos bshad pa gnyis/ /༈ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ mkhyen gsum bshad zin pa'i 'og tu sbyor bzhi'i dang po rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yad de/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la goms pa dbang du bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ zams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum yongs su shes pa nyid dbang du bya ba'i phyir yang rnam pa thams cad dang lam dang bzhi shes pa bsdu ba'i sgo nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum sgom par byed pas / rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs pa rtogs pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir / gnyis pa la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / thar pa cha mazun nas bzung ste rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/

136 mngoni hoṃgs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/sbyor ba'i ngobo / sbyor ba'i skyon yin/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa dang gsum / dang po la/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po rnam pa'i bye brag bshad pa dang / bden 'dzin dngos su 'joms par byed pa'i sbyor ba khyad par can nge sa bzung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bsnan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ /༈ dang po sna/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /zhes pa nas/de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/gzhi bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug shes pa yi ye shes kyi bye brag gam khyad par rnams ni rang gi mi mazun phyogs de dang de'i yul gyi ldog phyogs kyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas de dag 'joms par byed pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes zhes bya ba chos can/ skabs 'dir gtso bor bstan pa'i gnyen po'i mtshan nyid ces bya bar brdzod de/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir / gnyen po'i ye shes kyi rnam pa de chos can/ rigs bsdu na rnam pa gsum du 'dod pa yin te/ bsgom bya kun mkhyen nyid kyi ni rnam pa gsum du nges pa'i phyir/ don ni 'di ltar du 'gyur ba yin te/ phung po mi rtas/ par rtogs pa la sogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes chos can/ phung po rtag 'dzin la sogs pa'i gnyen po yin te/ de rnams kyi zhen yul gyi

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 137ldog phyogs mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa legs par shar ba'i sgo nas de dag la dngos su gnod byed kyi sems dpa'i ye shes yin pas so zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsgom bya don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis bstan pa yin te/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po de don rnam dang / de rtogs pa'i ye shes rnams shes rnam du bstan pa'i phyir/ don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis ka bsgom bya yin kyang bsgom bya sgom byed sgomapa po gsum du phye ba'i tshe shes rnam sgom byed dang / don rnam bsgom bya dang / rten gyi gang zag sgom pa por 'gyur ba yin te bya byed las gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'thad pa'i phyir/ shes rnam yin na bsgom bya yin pas ma khyab ste/ nyon mongs phyogs kyi shes rnam rnams bsgom bya ma yin pa'i phyir te/ dug gsum sgom pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du de don rnam la yang bsgom byas ma khyab ste/shes rnam thams cad kyang don rnam yin pa'i phyir te rtogs bya yin pa 'i phyir / gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ gzhi shes kyi/ lam shes kyi/rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa dang gsum/ /༈ dang po ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ /zhes pa nas/lam la de ni bco lnga bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ yum

138 ma ngon rtogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/bar ma las sher phyin 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'o zhes sdug bsngal rtag ji ra med pa'i rnam pa ston pa nas bzung ste/ sher phyin 'di mi g.ya ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'o zhes lam bden gyi mi g.ya ba yi rnam pa'i bar ston pa'i mde swābyeg chos can/ khyod kyis bzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun bsnan pa yin te/ bden pa dang po gsu ma so so la dmigs pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bzhi bzhi dang / lam bden la dmigs pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa de ni bco lngar bshad pa'i phyir/ sdug bden la dmigs pa bzhi yod de/ sdug bsngal rtag par med pa dang / don dam par mi skye ba dang /don gzhan gyis stong pa dang / rang gi ngo thong gyur pa'i bdag gis mi brdzi ba dang bzhi mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung la dmigs pa bzhi yod de/ sred pa don dam par gnas med pa dang / kun 'byung don dam par nam mkha' dang 'dra ba dang / rtog dpyod don dam par brdzod du med pa dang / sred tshor don dam par ming med pa dang bzhi mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa 'i sgo nas bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden la dmigs pa bzhi yod de/ 'gog pa don dam par 'gro ba med pa dang / zhi ba rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa dang / gya nom pa'i thar pa mi zad pa
