skabasabazhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 139dang / nges 'byung skye ba med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ lam bden la rnam pa bco lnga yad de/ byed pa po dang / shes pa po dang / gnas nas 'pho ba po dang /nyon mongs 'dul ba po'i gang zag gi bdag med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam bzhi dang / phyi don ngo bo nyid meng/ pa dang /ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang / gzod ma nas zhi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis yangs su mya ngan las 'das par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi sgom lam lnga dang / phyi rol don gyi kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang rnam par byang ba med pa dang / bag chags kyis ma gos pa dang / dbye ba'i spros pa med pa dang / rlom pa'i zhen pa med pa dang /mi g.ya ba'i gzung bya don gzhan med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam drug yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma bsngoms na bco lnga yin te / nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po mthong lam zag med bzhi/ shes sgrib gzung rte ga gi gnyen po sgom lam zag bcas lnga/ de'i gnyen po mthong lam zag med drug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug jibasngal dang / /zhes pa nas/ lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so/ /zhes

140 mngon rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam shes rnam pa de la sum cu tsa drug yad te/ rgyu kun 'byung dang / lam bden dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang 'gog pa'i bden pa la ni go rim bzhin du sbyar na/kun 'byung bden pa la rnam pa de dag brgyad dang / lam bden la bdun dang / sdug bsngal bden pa la lnga dang / 'gog bden la dmigs pa bcu drug yod ces yum gyi mdo las bshad cing bsgrag pa yin pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung la dmigs pa brgyad yod de/ rgyu'i rnam pa yul la 'dun pa'i sred pa dang / 'dod chags kyi sred pa dang / yang srid la dga' ba gsu4gyi gnyen po byang sems kyi ma ོnga la.oṃgasum/ kun 'byung gi rnam pa 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gasta mug gsum gyi gnyen po byang sems kyi mthong lam gsum/ rab skye'i rnam pa gtsang bde rtag bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen po byang sems kyi mthong lam gcig rkyen gyi rnam pa rang dbang ba'i sems can du zhen pa'i gnyen po byang sems kyi mthong lam gcig sde brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ lam bden la bdun yod de/lam gyi rnam pa la sems can tshad med pa la thar pa'i go skabs 'byed ji dang / 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel bar byed pa'i mthong lam gnyis/ rigs pa'i rnam pa la chos thams cad bden stong du tha mi

skabs bzhi pa'iṭik+ka/ 141dad par rtogs pa dang / nyan rang gi lam mchog tu mi 'dzin pa'i mthong lam gnyis// sgrub pa'i rnam pa la chos thams cad don dam par rnam par mi rtog pa dang / gzhal du med par rtogs pa'i mthong lam gnyis/nges 'byin gyi rnam pa la chos thams cad don dam par chagasapa med pa'i rnam pa can gyi mthong lam gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sdug bden la lnga yod de/ phung po mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / snong pa dang /bdag med pa dang / don dam par mtshan nyid med par rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi lam shes kyi rnam pa dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden la dmigs pa bcu drug yod de/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa la nang dang phyi dang gnyis ka'i chos la bden zhen ci rigs spangs pa'i nang dang phyi dang phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa gsum rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi lam shes gsum dang / de bzhin du zhi ba'i rnam pa la snong pa nyid dang / chen po dang /don dam pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / mtha' las 'das pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa brgyad rtogs pa'i lam shes brgyad/ gya nom pa'i rnam pa la rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa rtogs pa'i lam shes gcig nges 'byung gi rnam pa la chos thams cad dang / rang gi mtshan nyid dang / mi

142 mngon 3snags rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa gsum rtogs pa'i lam shes gsum/dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi snong pa nyid kyi rnam pa rtogs pa'i lam shes kyi rnam pa gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste/ /zhes pa nas/sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs / don ni/ sher phyin 'di ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes sogs kyis dngos su bstan pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste/ sher phyin 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo las bsnan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa'i mazar thug pa'i shes rnam rnams ni chos can/ rnam mkhyen r+bhe/ rnam pa yin te/ chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar zug yin pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can / rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la sum cu rtsa bdun dang / sum cu rtsa bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu dbye bar mdo las bzhed de/ sde tshan du phye nas slob ma nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas rnams la rim pa bzhin du de ltar bzhage pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan yod de/rnam mkhyen nyid la rigs kyi sgo nas kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na de'i phyir te/ gang zag de gsum gyi rgyud la lam gyi bden pa mi 'dra ba gsu ma

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 143yad pa'i rjes su mthun par rnam mkhyen nyid la gsum du phye ba yin pa'i phyir / med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung sne 'di'i bar gyi mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa thams cad bsngoms na brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum du 'asdi/ra te/'grel pa las/ rnam pa rnams gcig tu bsngoms na ba41 bdun cu rtsa gsum yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la so bdun yod de/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga/byang chub // 44na lag bdun/ 'phags lam ༷/na lag ba41da ni/ོda pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ lus dran pa nyer gzhag tshor ba dran pa nyer gzhag chos dran pa nyer gzhag sems dran pa nyer gzhag dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ mi dge ba'i chos skye 'gyur mi skye ba/skyes zin spong ba/ dge ba'i chos skye 'gyur skyed pa/ skyes zin spel bar byed pa'i yang dag spong ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yad de/'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / se mas dang dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang bzhi yod pa 'i phyir/ bzhi ji yod de/dad pa'i dbang po/ brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / stang nge 'dzin dang /shes rab kyi dbang po dang lnga yad pa'i phyir/ lnga pa yod de/ dad pa brtson

144 mngon rtogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi stobs dang lnga yad pa'i phyir/drug pa yod de/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag de bzhin du sbyar te/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed yang dag brtson 'grus yang dgadaga' ba yang dag shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag ting nge 'dzin yang dag btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang bdun ji5ོda pa'i phyir / bdun pa yod de/ der gyur pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la so bzhi yod de/ rnam thar sgo gsum / rnam thar brgyad/ snyoms 'jug dgu spong ba'i lam bzhi/phar phyin bcu yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yad de/ gzugs can gyi rnam thar gsum / gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar gcig sde brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gcig dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 145pa yod de/ bden bzhi bden med du rtogs pa'i lngog chas bar chad med lam gyi ming can bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa yod de/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin bcu yod pa'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la so dgu yod de/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag pa'i rig pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sogs gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yad de/gnas dang gnas min mkhyen dzi'i stobs nas/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi bar bcu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yad de/ rang don du sbangs rtogs phun sum tshogs par dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis dang / gzhan don du bar chad dang nges 'byung gi chos dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis te bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ chos so so yang dag rig pa/ don so so yang dag rig pa/ nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag rig pa/ spobs pa so so yang dag rig pa dang bzhi yad pa'i phyir / bzhi pa yod de/ 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba'i ye shes sogs rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug 'dun pa la sogs pa'i ye shes ma 'dres pa drugasku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ dus gsum chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum ste bco

146 mngoni rtogasargyan 3) ṭik+ka/brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa yod de/ de bzhin nyid dang rang byung dang sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam mkhyen kyi rnam pa gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa bden 'dzin dngos su 'joms byed kyi spyor ba khyad par can bshad pa la/ rten gyi gang zag dang / sbyor ba bshad pa gnyis / dang po sna/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /zhes pa nas/snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya byang sems chos can/ sher phyin 'di nyan pa yi snod yin te/ sngon sangs rgyas rnams la bkur sni lhag par byas pa dang / sangs rgyas de la bsod snyoms 'bul ba sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mgon dang bcas pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ yum gyi gzhung deni blo la len pa dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i snod du rung bar dam pa rnams bzhed de/ de'i ched dusangs rgyas grangs med pa bsnen pa dang de la don kun 'dri ba dang /dris pa'i don sbyin pa dang tshul khrims sogs la tshul bzhin du spyod pas nyams su len par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ de ni dag pa mtshams dang bcas / / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 147bsnan ngo tho'i sbyor ba de la lnga yod de/ yul gzugs la sogs pa la don dam par mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba dang / yul can de la bden zhen gyis sbyor ba bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang/ gzhi de yi de bzhin nyid zab par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / lam de rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gting dpag dka' bar rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / rnam pa'i chos de dag gi chos nyid tshad ni med par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang bcas pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ phyir zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di lnga ka la'ang sbyor ngagos te/ khyad par de dang de'i sgo nas sbyor ba khyad par can du bzhag par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rten gyi sgo nas brgyad yad de/ gogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor ba/ drod sogs bzhi la rim pa bzhin du lung bstan pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa nyid dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / bar chad med bcas dang / mthong lam la byang chub nye ba dang / sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar la myur du 'tshang rgya ba dang / sa brgyad pa la gzhan don gyi sbyor ba 'jog pa'i phyir/ thabs kyi sgo nas bzhi yod de/ sa brgyad pa la 'phel med 'grib med dang / don dam par chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong ba dang / gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab tu mi mthong ba dang / gzugs dang gzugs rung sogs de'i mtshan ma dang gsum/ de

148 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭilko/yi mtshon bya'i nga ba dan dam par rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu dang dus kyi sbyor ba yod de/ sa dgu pa'i ye shes 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed dang / sa bcu pa'i ye shes de ni rnamapar dag pa dus kyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba yod de/yum myur du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de sa mtshams dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bsnan sbyor ba nyi shu yod de/ rang bzhin gyis sbyor ba lnga dang / gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga yod pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa sbyor ba'i skyon yan bshad pa la/ yon tan bshad pa dang / skyon bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdud kyi mazu bcom la sogs pa/ /yan tan rnam pa bcu bzhi'e / /zhes gsungs/ don ni/shes bya chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi yod de/ sbyor ba bsgoms snobs kyis bdud kyi mthu bcom pa dang la sogs pa ste sangs rgyas dgongs shing gzigs pa dang /des mngon sum du mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la nye ba dang /don che ba dang / lung bstan pa'i yul la dpyad pa dang / zag med kyi yon tan rdzogs par byed pa dang / smra ba'i skyes bu chen po 'gyur ba dang /

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 149bdud kyis mi phyed pa dang / nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dge rtsa bskyed pa dang / gzhan don chen po sgrub pa'i don 'grub pa dang / 'bras bu rgya chen po 'dzin pa dang / sems can gyi don sgrub pa dang / yum nges par 'thob par 'gyur ba'i yon tan rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni / skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa/ /drug tu nges par rtogs par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sbyor ba skye ba dang gnas pa'i skyon zhe drug yod de/ de 'dra'i skyon ni bcu tshan bzhi dang bcas pa'i drug tu nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ de yang yin te/der gyur pa'i sbyor ba'i 'gal rkyen rang la brten pa nyi shu/ rang gzhan gang rung la brten pa nyer gsum/ gzhan la brten pa gsum dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ yum gyi tshig don tshegs chen pos 'thob pa cha/sa/ bdud kyi las la 'jug pa'i bar nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ nyan pa po ༷/ma la 'dun kyang 'chad pa po snyom las kyis nyams pa nas/ 'chad pa po bsod snyoms ster ba'i khyem du 'gro 'dod kyang nyan pa po 'gro mi 'dod pa'i bar nyer gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ bdud kyi chos dang gang zag gnyis so sor 'byed pa sogs gsum yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la/ mdor bsnan pa dang / rgyas

50 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/par bshad pa gnyis//༈ dang po ni/gang gi mtshon de mtshan nyid du//zhes pa nas/ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang //zhes pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/shes bya chos can/ 'dir lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/mtshon byed gang gis lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor du mtshon nus pa de de'i mtshan nyid du shes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir / mtshan nyid de chos can/ khyodi la yang rnam pa gsum yod de/mkhyen gsum sbyor ba mtshon byed shes pa'i mtshan nyid dang /nyan rang gi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid dang /gzhan don sgrub pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ljan pa'i byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug bsnan pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid gang yin pa mtshon bya dang / mtshan gzhi yang shes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/mtshon tshul yod de/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang //zhes sogs kyi skabs 'byung ba ltar nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo 2 3da kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po mtshan gzhi/lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor yin par mtshon/stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang

skabasabazhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 151snying rje chen po gnyis kyisazin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po de mtshan gzhi dang / mtshon bya dang / mtshan nyid gsum gyi sgo nas bsnan pa yin te / mtshon par bya bas na mtshon bya dang mtshan bzhi gnyis ka'i ming gis bstan/ mtshon par byed pas na mtshan nyid kyi ming gis bstan pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar mtshon bya yang zhes yang gi sgra smros pa la dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ shes mtshan/ khyad ma /byed mtshan/ ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po la/ gzhi shes / lam shes/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang gsum/ dang po ni / de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / zhes pa nas/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can / 'dir thams cad shes pa nyid kyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid bcu drug tu bsdus nas bstan pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba shes pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dang / de bzhin du 'jig rten don dam par 'jig pa med pa'i bdag nyid du rtogs pa dang / sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa dang / gang zag gi bdag med la sems de bsdus pa dang / de las

152 mngon lta gas rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/sems phyir bltas pa dang / sems can nam mkha' dang 'dra bar mi zad pa yi rnam pa dang / sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa sogs te zhe snang gti mug dang bcas pa dang / ro/gas bstan sems 'dod chags sogs dang bral ba dang / sems kyi gnas lugs rgya chen po dang / sems sgyu ma ltar snang ba'i chen por gyur pa dang /don dam pa'i sems tshad med pa dang / sems rnam shes dbang shes kyi ngo bor bsnan du med pa dang /sems sbyan lngas bltar med pa dang /shes pa de la g.ya ba dang la sogs pa 'du ba dang bkramopa dang bcum pa bzhi yad par shes pa zhes bya ba dang /shes tshul de las gzhan yang g.yo ba sogs de dag ni rang bzhin bdecha pas stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / thub pa'i dbang pos de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de gzhan la bstan pa shes pa zhes bya ba'i sems dpa'i ye shes 'di dang bcu drug yod par bstan pa'i phyir/ bcu drug po de'i sgo nas mtshon tshul yad de/ nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug gi nang tshan gyi rnal 'byor dang po bzhi/ mtshan bzhi/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sems dpa'i bzhi shes sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo

skabasabazhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 153nas nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ dbye na bcu drug yod de/ zin byed kyi dbye bas de ltar du yod pa'i phyir/ g.yo ba la sogs zhes bya dang / / zhes sogs kyis lta ngan bcu bzhi bstan pa yin la/ de'i khyad par yod de/ gzhan sde'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag dang 'jig rten rtag par lta ba sobalta/sngon gyi mtha' la brten pa'i lung ma bstan gyi ltangan bzhi/gang zag gi bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' dang ldan pa skye ba phyi mar mi 'jug par lta ba sogs phyi ma'i mtha' la brten pa'i lta ngan bzhi/sngo la ba po'i bdag grongs nas de phan chad du 'byung bar lta ba sogs myang 'das kyi mtha' la brten pa'i lta ngan bzhi/ gang zag gi bdag dang phung po rdzas gcig tu lta ba dang za dad du lta ba'i lung ma bstan gnyis te bcu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir bsnan lta ngan bcu bzhi po de kun btags yin te/ grub mtha' ngan pas blo bsgyur ba'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam shes sbyor ba ni/ stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang / /zhes pa nas/shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i lam shes sbyor ba bcu drug yod de/lam shes pa'i sher phyin la brten nas ngo bo bden par grub pa'i stong pa

154 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/nyid dang / rgyu la don dam par mtshan ma med pa dang bcas pa dang /'bras bu la don dam par smon pa rnam par spangs par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes gsum dang / de bzhin du 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad don dam par skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / sogs sgras kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba dang spang bya'i dngos po dang snori pa'i ngo tho nyid dang rten rnams don dam par med pa dang nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de drug dang / chos nyid gzhan du rnam par 'khrug pa med pa dari / blo sngon du btang nas 'du mi byed pa dang / mtshan nyid dang gzhi'i rab dbye la rnam par mi rtog pa dang / mtshan nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba dang /don dam par mtshan nyid med pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dari bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid de rnams chos can/larmu shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni/ bsdus pa yin par bzhed de/ mtshon bya'i sgo nas bsdus pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ gzhan don bya dka' ba sogs sgrub pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bar pa lnga po mabon gzhi/ 'dir bsnan sems dpa'i lam shes sbyor ba yin pa ra mabo+on / stong nyid mtshan med sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul

skabasaba'i pa'i ṭik+ka/ 155gyis mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rnam mkhyen sbyor ba ni/de ni nyid kyi chos bstan nas/ /zhes pa nas/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i rnam mkhyen sbyor ba yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni/ de nyid kyi chos la brten nas mthong chos la bde bar gnas par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dang / de bzhin du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus par bya ba dang /bka' las mi 'da' bar bla ma nyid du bya ba dang / rnyed bkur gyis mnyes par bya ba dang / bla ma de la mchod par byed pa dang / don dam par mchod par byed du med pa dang / ye shes kyis shes bya kun tu 'jug par mkhyen ji gang yin pa dang / don dam par ma mthong ba'i don ston par mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid rnam par shes pa dang /'jig rten bden snong nyid du brdzod pa dang / de bden stong nyid du shes par mdzad pa dang / de ltar mngon sum du mthong bar mdzad pa dang /tshe sa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du ston pa dang / don dam par spros pa zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang / 'jig rten la bden par 'du shes pa 'gog pa dang / 'di dang pha rol la don dam par blang dor gyi 'du shes 'gog pa shesapa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dang bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ bcu drug po

156 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/de chos can/ rnam pa kun mkhyed+dha pa'i tshul la ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid du bshad pa yin te/ sngar bshad pa de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yad de / bzhi lam gyi khyad par la dmigs pa sogs sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor tha ma bdun po mtshan gzhi/ 'dir bsnan pa'i sems dpa'i rnam mkhyen sbyor ba yin par mtshon/thub pas de bzhin nyid kyi chos rtogs nas mthong cho sa la bde bar gnas pa sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa khyad mtshan ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis / / zhes pa nas/ khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la mdore bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las / dang po sna/ shes bya chos can/ khyad mtshan bcu drug yod de/sdug bden gyi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab par thugs su chud pa dang /mi mnyam pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gyis bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas nyan rang gi sbyor ba las khyad par du zhugs pa'i bden pa'i spyod yul can gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi dbang gis mtshon byed khyad par gyis mtshan nyid bcu drug tu bshad pa

skabasabazhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 157yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chom can/ khyad mtshan la rgyas par dbye na bcu drug yod de/ sdug bden gyi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / dpes mi mnyam pa dang / tha snyad pa'i tshad mas gzhal ba las 'das pa dang / grangs kyis bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das par rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag gi yon tan can sdud pa dang / chos thams cad shes pa'i skyes bu mkhas pa yis rig par bya ba nyid dang / nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos po yongs su shes par bya ba nyid dang / rang gi mngon par shes pa shin tu myur ba sde kun 'byung gi chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi dang / chos zams cad don dam par bri ba dang gang ba med pa dang / phyin drug shugs drag tu sgrub pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par 'grub pa dang / thabs kyis zin pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa chos thams cad la dmiḍa pa sne 'gog pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rigs la brten pa dang bcas pa dang / pha rol tu ca'i pa'i tshogs mtha' dag pa ldan pa dang / theg chen gyi lam rdzogs par ste pa'i yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bcas pa dang / chos ring la'ang bden zhen gyis ngo myang ba med pa sne lam bden gyi chos nyid

158 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes bzhi dang bcas pa khyad par gyi ni ma nyid bcu drug gi bdag nyid du shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can / gang gis lam shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'i lam ni khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam gzhan nyan rang gi ni lam dag las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgo nagabazhag pa'i phyir/de ltar yin te/ lam de sangs rgyas legs par sgrub pa'i shes rab khyad par can sngar bshad pa de dag gis zin pa yin pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yad de/ nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po mtshan bzhi/'dir bsnan dman pa'i sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sems dpa'i sbyor ba yin par mtshon/sdug bden gyi tshe sa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shesarab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba de/dman pa'i sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags kyang skabasa'adir dngosausu de las 'phags par mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bzhi shes sbyor ba nyan rang la'ang yod pas de ltar ma bsnan pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa byed mtshan ni/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang / /

skabs bzhipa'iṭik+ka/ /59zhes pa nas/ 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs / don ni/ shes bya chos can/ byed las khyad par can gyi sems dpa'i sbyor ba bcu gcig yod de/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba'i byed pa ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa dang tshe 'di'i bde ba dang / sems can sdug bsngal las skyobs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes gsum dang / mi rnams kyis ni skyabs sogs byed pa dag dang / ྅/ga bsngal ྅) rgyu zlog pas gnas pa dang /'khor 'das don dam par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas dbung gnyen dang /srid pa'i chu klung las sgrol zhing rang gzhan gyi dotsha rtogs pa'i rten gyi ngobo gling dang / rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pas yongs su 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang /don de yang lhun gyis grub par byed pa dang / theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba'i dus moyin par mngon du mi byed pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems dpa'i ye shes te lam shes kyi byed pa bdun dang byed pa bcu gcig gi tha ma rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba ni sems can gyi rten gyi mdzad pa gcig ste bcu gcig po 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/mtshon tshul yod de/ nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po mtshan gzhi/ 'dir bsnan gzhan don rgya chen po sgrub pa'i byed las khyad par can gyi sems dpa'i

160 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ phan bde skyob pa sogs byed las bcu gcig po ci rigs dang lngan pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ bzhi pa ngo bo nyid mtshan ni/ /nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang / /zhes pa nas/ mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug yad de/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa spong ba dang / de'i rtags lus kyi gnas ngan len spong ba dang / de'i rgyu mtshan ma tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa med pa dang / chags sogs mi mazun phyogs dang de'i gnyen po dag don dam par bdag gis dben par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i bzhi shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid bzhi dang / don dam par med pa'i sems can maza' yas pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gzhan don bya dka' ba sgrub pa dang / theg pa gzhan du mi ltung bar 'tshang rgya bar nges pa sgrub pa dang / ched du bya ba chen po gsum sgrub pa dang /bsgom bya dang sgom pa po'i chos don dam par mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang / dngos po la bden par mngon par zhen pa bkago pa'i sems dpa'i lam shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid lnga dang / gzhi shes dang lam shes kyi

skabs bzhi pha'i ṭik+ka 161khyad par la dmigs pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa dang / byis pa 'dzin pa mi mazun pa dngos po dang dngos med la bden zhen med pa dang / gzugs sogs kyi chos rnams thogs pa med par shes pa dang / shes bya gzugs sogs de rnams don dam par med pas 'khrul bzhi bden par med par shes pa dang / don dam par gang du 'gro ba med pa dang / don dam par skye ba med pa dang /dngos po dang dngos med dang gnyis ka'i de bzhin nyid ni don dam par midamigs par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnam mkhyen sbyor ba bdun dang bcas pa ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'argyor bcu drug gi bdag nyid rnams su yad pa'i phyir/ bcu drug po de chos can/ mtshan nyid bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin par bzhed pa yin te/ khyod kyis me dang tsha ba ltar mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba sngar bshad pa de dag rang gi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mtshon bya lta bur mtshon par byed pa'i phyir ngo/ /sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi grangs bsnoms na sgo gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir mtshon bya dang mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad ni bya byed gnyis ka dang 'brel ba'i dbang gis yin gyis ༈ mtshon bya dang mtshan nyid dngos yin pa'i dbang du byas pa ni min te/ rnal 'byor tha ma bcu drug po la mtshan mtshon gnyis ka'i tha snyad mdzad kyang de gnyis ka yin pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /

sdi62 mngon stogasargyan gyi ṭilko/༈ gnyis pa thar pa cha mthun nas bzung sde rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa bshad pa la/ grangs med gsum nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi thog ma ngos bzung ba'i sgo nas rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ngos bzung ba/rgyud smin byed kyi lam gyi rim pa/ mngon rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ lam snyu'i mtshan nyid dang /lam gyi chings lngar bsdus nas de la mkhas par bshad pa dang gnyis/dang po 'e/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ /zhes pa nas/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i theg chen (1 tshogs lam sna chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i skabs 'di'ang thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa yin par 'dod de / don dam par mtshan momed par rtogs pa'i shelorab kyis zin pa'i rab tu sbyin pa la sogs pa nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar rang rgyud la yang dag par sgrub bcas la mkhas pa'i theg chen gyi chos mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir / gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang / /zhes pa nas / rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/'di la lam gyi chings dang / de la mkhas pa'i gdul bya ngos bzung ba

skabasabazhipa'i ṭik+ka/ 163gnyis / dang po'i don ni/ shes bya chos can/ zeg chen gyi rigs can theg chen lam du zhugs nas spyod pa gang la slob tshul yod de/ sangs rgyas sogs la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang / sbyin sogs phar phyin drug spyod yul du byed pa'i brtson 'grus dang / zeg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo bsam pa phun tshogs byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas de'i 〈snags rnam mkhyen yang yang dran pa'i dran pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dmigs yul du byas pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam pa lngas slob dgos pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya de la nang gses kyai dbang po'i rim pa sanyis su yad de/rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni dbang porno na po yis rtogs pa ste thob sla ba/ de la ltos nas dbang po rtul pos rtogs pa ste thob dka' bar bzhed pa'i phyir ro / / theg chen gyi tshogs lam yin na/ dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas pas ma khyab ste/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i zeg chen gyi tshogs lam yod pa'i phyir/ de yin na bskal pa grangs med gsum nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi thog ma yin pas kyang ma khyab ste/ sems bskyed nas bskal pa grangs med so gsumanas 'tshang rgya ba yang srid pa'i phyir ro/ /rtul pos

164 mngon stogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/rtogs dkar bzhed ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi dbang rtul la dbang stul gyis ma khyab ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dbang rtul de dbang rtul ma yin pa'i phyir te/ dbang rnon yin pa'i phyir/ de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin pa'i phyir/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas rgyan la brten nas lam bgrod tshul yang shes dbe sa te/bsdu na thog mar skabs dang po nas bsnan pa'i rigs sad par byas nas sems bskyed 'dir bstan pa'i tshogs lam rang rgyud la bskyed dgos/de nas dro ba rnams kyi zhes sogar+sākyi skabs dang de'i gong nasabasnan pa'i sbyor lam dang / skabs dang po gsum dang / lnga pa'i skabs nas bsnan pa'i sbyor lam rang rgyud la bskyed dgos/ de nas skabs gnyis pa'i bden dang bden la sogs dang / skabs gsum pa'i gzugs rtag ma yin zhes sogs dang / rtse sbyor dang / rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i skabs nas bstan pa'i mthong lam rang rgyud la bskyed dgos/ de nas skabs gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa'i skabs nas bsnan pa'i sgom lam rang rgyud la bskyed dgos/ de dag gi tshe skabs 'di nas bshad pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob par byed pa dang / sgom sgrub la sogs pa'i sgrub pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len cing / drug pa'i mthar gyis sbyor bas go rim ma

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 165snachol bar sgrub pa dang / bdun pa'i skad cig sbyor ba la brten nas brgyad pa 'i 'bras bu chos sku thob par byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa rgyud smin byed lam nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /zhes pa nas/ smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi'i dmigs pa yod de/ dang po sbyor lam dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa skabs 'dir sems can thams cad yin par yum gyi mdo las bsngags shing brjod pa'i phyir/ tshul ji ltar zhe na yad de/sems can de dag nyid la dmigs nas sems mnyam par lta ba sogs rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa'i dmigs pa yod de/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad la dmigs rtse mo ba bdag nyid sdig pa mi dge ba bcu las lngog cing / sbyin sogs la gnas pa'i sgo nas sems can gzhan dag de dag la ni 'godapa dang / de dag gi bsngags pa brjod pa dang mthun pas dga' bar byedapa nyid kyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam bzod pa'i dmigs pa yod de/de bzhin du sems can la dmigs nas rang bden pa bzhi shes pa laganas shing sems can gzhan gyi rten can bden pa shes pa de la 'god pa'i tshul gyis

/66 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/dmigs pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam chos mchog gi dmigs pa yod de/ de bzhin du sems can rnams la dmigs nas smin par byed pa dang grol bar byed pa sogs kyis dmigs par shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon gyi dam pa kha cig skabs 'dir bsnan pa'i sbyor lam sbyor lam btags pa bar 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ skabs gang du yin yang sbyor mthong sgom gsum bsnan pa de rnams mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mngon rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skye ba'i lam bshad pa la/phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags bshad pa dang / sku gsum sgrub byed kyi lam khyad par can bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir bsnan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste/ /zhes pa nas/ de 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ doni ni/ shes bya chos can/ skabs 'dir phyir mi lngog pa'i dge 'dun gyi cho+ogs rnam pa gsum yod de/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i sems dpa' dbang rnon nas bzung ste/ zeg chen gyi mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam dag la byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas pa de dag rnams su yod pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog

skabasabazhi paji ṭik+ka/ /67pa'i rtags/ mthong lam pa phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags/ sgom lam pa phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags dang gsum/ dang po la/ mdor bstan dang / rgyas par bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po sna/ gzugs la sogs la ldog sogs rtags / / zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi phyir mi lngog pa'i mtshan nyid de rtags yad de/ 'chad 'gyur ltar gzugs la sogs pa la bden zhen mngon sdo/ra ba lngog pa sogs rtags rnam pa nyi ro/ra brdzod pa yis ni shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ljog /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ drod sogs bzhi las/ dang po ༷di kyi rtags bcu gcig yod de/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba ci rigs las lngog pa dang / skyabs gnas de yin min gyi the tshom mngon du 'gyur ba zad pa dang / dal ba lngan pas mi dal ba mi khom pa brgyad du skye ba zad pa dang / bdag nyid sbyin sogs dgi ba la gnas shing gzhan dag de la 'god par byed pa'i spyod pa dang /sems can gzhan gyi rten can bdag gi sbyin sogs kyi 'bras bu la longs spyod par gyur cig pa'i gso ba dang / snong nyid zab mo'i don la'ang

168 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/som nyi med pa dang / byams pa'i sems kyi lus soges te ngag dang yid kyi las dang lngan pa dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang gnod sems dang gnyid rmugs gnyis dang 'gyod rgod gnyis dang the tshom nyon mongs can gyi sgrib pa ni rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs pa dang / ma rig pa dang lngan pa'i lta ba ngan pa'i bag la nyal kun 'jom par byed nus pa'i mthu dang ljan pa dang / spyod lam thams cad du dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang lngan pa dang gos la sogs pa yangs su spyad pa gtsang ba zhes bya ba dang bcu gcig yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtags drug yod de/ gang zag de'i lus la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri rnams mi 'byung ba dang / rang don yid byed kyi sems gya gyu med pa dang / phyag dar khrod pa la sogs pa'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan ni len pa dang / sbyin sogs la spyod pa'i tshe ser sna med pa sogs dang ldan pa dang / snong nyid kyi chos nyid dang 'gal bar mi byed pa'i sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor dang lngan par 'gro ba dang / sems can gzhan gyi don du dpyal bar 'igro bar 'tshol ba'i 'dod pa dang drug yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i rtags gnyis yod de/ ston pa gzhan gyis lam ngan pa la bkri bar mi btub pa dang / me lnga bsten pa sogs lam ltar bcos pa gzhan nye bar snon pa'i bdud yin pa la bdud ces bya

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 169bar rtogs pa dang gnyis yad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtags yod de/sgo gsum gyi spyod pa thams cad sangs rgyas dges pa ste dgyes pa'i spyod pa zhes bya ba thob pa gcig dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /don bsdu ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i rtagasani nyi shu po de dag gis byang sems sbyor la.oṃpa dbang snani rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi snog par shes par bya ste / drod dang rtse mo dang bzod pa dang bcas pa dang chos mchog rnams la gnas pa'i rtags ni sngar ltar shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa mthonge lam pa phyir mi/ ldog pa'i rtags bshad pa la / mdor bsnan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/mthe nga ba'i lam la bzod pa dang / /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/don ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa dbang 'bring gi rgyud kyi mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang shes pa'i skad cig ma bcu drug gis bsdus pa'i char gtogs pa'i thabs shes khyad par can dang bcu drug po des drangs pa'i lus ngag gi tha snyad khyad par can 'khrul med brtan po gnyis ni chos can/byang chub sems dpa' dbang 'bring mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid de rtags yin par shes par bya ste/ de sgrub kyi tshul gsum yin pa'i phyir / gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs 'du shes lngog pa dari / /zhes pa

170 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/nas / phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags dag yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug yod de/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming can mthong lam pa'i lus ngag gi tha snyad khyad par can gzugs sogs la bden par 'du shes pa kun btags ldog pa dang / kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan pa dang / theg pa dman pa'i sems de dag las rnam par ldog pa dang / bsam gtan dang la sogs de gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi dbang gis dbang med du skye ba'i rgyu'i nus pa'i yan lag yongs su zad pa dang bzhi ni sdug bden la dmigs pa'i rnam pa can dang /lus sems yang ba shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba khyad par can dang lngan pa nyid dang / zhen pa med par 'dod pa la spyod pa la thabs mkhas pa dang /rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa nyid dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnam par dag pa nyid dang bani ni kun 'byung bden pa la brten pa'i rnam pa can dang / phung po la sogs pa sne khams dang skye mched la dang po dang rjes su bden par zhen pa'i sbyor ba bkag pa dang / bar chad byed pa'i mi mthun phyogs rnams la sngar ltar bden par sbyor ba ba/ga pa dang / sbyin sogs kyi tshogs la sngar ltar sbyor ba bkag pa dang / mdo las grong khyer gyi sgras

skabs bzhi pa 'i ṭik+ka/ /71bstan pa mig gi dbang po sogs dbang rten dang grong rdal gyi sgras bstan pa dbang yul rnams dang bcas pa'i yul/ yul can la spong gnyen gyi g.yul 'gyed pa la snga ma bzhin sbyor ba bkag pa bzhi ni 'gog pa la brten pa'i rnam pa can dang / ser sna dang tshul 'chal la sogs pa la dang por bden par sbyor ba dang rjes su bden par sbyor ba yi gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang / lam dang 'bras bu'i chos sna don dam par sdug bsngal tsam yang mi dmigs pa nyid dang lngan pa dang / byang sems rang gi sa la the tshom dang bral bar gnas pa nges pa nyid kyis mkhyen gsum gyi bdag nyid dang rang gis thob pa'i sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang ldan pa dang / rnam mkhyen sogs thob bya'i chos kyi don du srog gtong ba la ser sna dang sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba bzhi ni lam bden la dmigs pa'i rnam pa can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i skad cig ma bcu drug po ni chos can / blo ldan byang sems mthong lam pa'i lam la gnas pa de rnams kyi phyir mi ljog pa'i rtags dag yin te/ rgyu mtshan sngar bshad pa de'i phyir/'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i don yod de/ lam gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bla med byang chub tu 'gyur nges de de'i don yin pa'i phyir/ don de tshang ba tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pas ma khyab ste/ mngon rtogs

172 mngon rtogs rgyan gyisnyik+ka/rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin na de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug po de phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags ma yin te/ byang sems mthong lam rnam grol lam pa ba yin na/ de thob pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / rang las rtogs pa dma' bas mngon sum du nges mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sgom lam pa phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags bshad pa la/ sgom lam rgyas par bshad pa dang / phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags bshad pa gnyis/ /༈ dang po la/ sgom lamagyi khyad gzhi/ khyad chos/ dbye ba bshad pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa sde/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/don ni/ theg chen sgom pa'i lam bar chad med lam ni chos can/ zab pa yin te/ rang gi gnas lugs zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can yin pa'i phyir / stong pa nyid de ni chos can/ zab pa yang yin te/ sgro 'dogs dang skur ba 'debs pa'i mtha' la sa grol ba nyid kyi yul zab mo yin pa'i phyir / gnyis pa ni/ nges 'byed yan las dang mthong ba'i/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ rgyun chags su gnas pa yin te/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong

skabs bzhipa'iṭik+ka/ 173ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la rang gi mthong ba'i don mkhyen gsum 3) rnam pa la thos sogs kyis yang dang yang du sems pa dang / tshad mas 'jal ba dang / zhib tu nges par rtogs pa'i sgom pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir / gsum pa ni/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ 'di la dngos dang / rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ dang po'i doni ni/ zeg chen sgom lam de ni chos can/ rnam pa dgur bzhed de/khyod la der gyur pa'i chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po rnams su yad cing de re re'ang chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs te chung ngu'i 'bring dang chung ngu'i chen po dang / 'bring dang chen po la'ang de ltar dbye ba yis rnam pas de bzhin du ṭ+wāṃbye dro+o'i/ phyi/ra/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod rgyun chags su 'byung ba yin pa'i ༈ gnyis pa la/ dbye ba'i rtsod spong dang / grangs nges kyi rtsod pa spong ba dang / byed las la rtsod pa spong ba gsum/ dang po la/ rtsod pa dang / lan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam la rnam pa dgur grangs nges rnga mi 'thad par thal/ sgom lam dang de'i bsod nams grangs med par mdo las bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/bye ngas med la sogs bsnan pa rnams/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi

174 mngon stogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/gsungs / don ni/ shes bya chos can/ yum gyi mdo las sgom lam gyi 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med la sogs pa bsnan pa rnams ni dam pa'i don du ste don dam par dbyer bzod pa ma yin yang / kun rdzob tu 'bras bu de ltar 'grung ba mi sangs rgyas nyid kyis zugs brtse ba'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu bsnan pa de dag thub pa rang nyid bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa la/ don dam la ltos pa'i rtsod pa dang / tha snyad la ltos pa'i rtsod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/dang po sna/ dngos po brdzod du med pa la/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs /tsho don ni/ theg chen sgom lam zhes bya'i lam gyis ni chos can / sbang bya ci zhig nyams shing gnyen po ci zhig thob pa mi 'thad par thal / don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sgom lam gyi dngos podo na dam par brdzod du med pa la sbang bya nyams pa dang gnyen po 'phel ba'i rnam gzhag mi rung ba'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ byang chub ji ltar de bzhin du/ zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ don dam par spang gnyen 'phel 'grib med kyang / spang gnyen mi 'thad pa'i skyon med par thal/ bla med byang chub kyi ye shes de don dam par med kyang tha snyad du gdul bya'i don byed pa ji lta ba de bzhin du sgam

skabasaba'i pa'i ṭik+ka/ 175lam 'di ni don dam par med kyang tha snyad du spang bya la gnod pa la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i don sgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ dpe don mi mtshungs pa'i skyon med par thal/ de gnyis tha snyad du bya ba byed nus par mtshungs shing /byang chub don dam par med pa de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid can yin pa de ltar snom lam de yang de yi mtshan nyid can du bzhed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la / rtsod pa dang / lan no/ /dang po 3/ sems ni snga mas byang chub bar / / rigs min phyi mas kyang ma yin/ /zhes gsungs/don ni/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni chos can / rang 'bras rdzogs pa'i byang chub bskyed par mi rigs par thal/khyod skad cig snga ma kho nas rang 'bras rdzogs pa'i byang chub bskyed pa ni rigs pa ma yin la/ skad cig phyi ma kho nas kyang bskyed nus pa rigs pa ma yin zhing /cig car rim can gyis kyang de ltar rigs pa ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni/ /zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad/ /ces gsungs/ don ni/ sems bskyed pa skad cig snga phyi mang po rimogyis 'byung bas rang 'bras byang chub mi bskyed pa'i skyon med par thal/ mar me skad cig snga ma las phyi ma nus lngan du rimogyis 'byung bas sdong bu snum ldan rdzogs par sreg par byed pa'i mar

176 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/me'i dpe'i tshul gyis ni/ sems bskyed snga phyi rim gyis 'byung bas rang 'bras sku gsum bskyed pa'i phyir dang / zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad po 'chad pa 'di rnams kyang khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa rtags ni/ skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang / /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ sa brgyad pa chos can/ zab mo rnam pa brgyad thugs su chud pa dang ldan te/ gzhi'i gnas lugs skye ba'i rten 'brel zab pa dang / 'gag pa zab pa dang / spyod pa nyams len gyi de bzhin nyid zab pa dang / sbyin sogs don dam par med kyang kun rdzob tu yod pa'i shes bya zab pa dang / chos thams cad spros bral du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can gyi shes pa zab pa dang / don dam par med kyang tha snyad du sbyod pa zab pa dang / mtshan ma dang de med pa gnyis ka done dam par gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i zab pa dang / 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid dang lngan pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa sku gsum sgrub byed kyi sbyor ba khyad par can bshad pa la/ chos sku sgrub byed srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba dang / longs sku sgrub byed zhing dag sbyor ba dang / sprul sku sgrub byed thabs mkhas sbyor ba bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir/ /zhes

skabasabazhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 177sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ 'di la dngos dang / klan ka spang ba gnyis/dang po ni/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba yin te/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das par don dam par rnam par mi rtog par 'khor 'das bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir / der thal/ 'khor 'das kyis ma pa'i chos rnams don dam par med kyang tha snyad tsam du grub pa rmi lam dang 'dra bar rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ klan ka dang / de'i lan no/ /dang po ni/ nyin par dge mi dge'i las gsog par byed pa med par thal/ chos thams cad don dam par ma grub par tha snyad du rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ shes bya chos can/ ji skad bshad pa'i klan ka de mi 'jug par thal/ las med du thalob la sogs pa'i klan ka de yi lan ni yum gyi mdo las ji skad bshad zin par zad par de'i phyir/ mdo las gsungs tshul yod de/ las gsog pa 'dzad par thal ba dang / las 'bras don dam par med par thal ba dang / lung dang 'gal bar thal ba dang / rmi lam du las gsog dzimi ༷thad pa'i klan ka bzhi dang lan bzhi gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po grub

178 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/ste / rab 'byor byang chen gyis rmi lam du las gang gis byas pa'i las de la gsog pa dang bri bar 'gyur ba na/ zhes bkod nas/ lan ni/ tshe dang lngan pa shā ri'i bu ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur gsungs pa de ltar na de zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i phyir/gnyis pa grub ste/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ nyin par srog bcad pa dang rmi lam du srog bcad pa de la 'di snyam du de bdag gis bsad legs par bsad do shin tu bsad do zhes sad de rnam par rtog na zhes sogs bkod nas/ lan ni/ rab 'byor dmigs pa med par las mi skye sde las ni dmigs pa dang bcas pa kho nar skye'o zhes sogs kyis bsnan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ rab 'byor las thams cad dang sems pa thams cad dben pa 'o zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas ji ltar dmiganu pa dang bcas par las skye zhes sogs bkod nas/ lan ni/ tshe dang lngan pa shā ri'i bu mtshan mar byas na dmigs pa dang bcas par las skye ste zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ rab 'byor gal te byang chen gyis rmi lam du sbyin pa byin/ zhes pa nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de bla na med par yang dag pa ra rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos na zhes sogs bkod nas/ lan ni/ shā ri'i bu byang chen byams pa skye ba gcig

skabs bzhi pa'i ṭik+ka/ 179gis thogs pa 'di la dris shig zhes sogs kyis bstan pa ltar yin pa'i phyir / rmi lam du dge mi dge'i las byed par rmis nas sad pa'i tshe mngon zhen gyis dga' ba sgom na las de las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung ba srid kyang / rmi lam gyi mi de mi ma yin pas srog gcod kyi las lam dngos bzhi med de/ de bzhin du rmi lam du sbyin pa btang ba rmis pa sogs la yang las lam 〈sna dngos gzhi rdzogs pa med pa'i phyir/ 'o na/gnyid de dge mi dge gang yang min nam zhe na/ min te gnyid gzhan 'gyur yin pas de dang dge ba'i gzhi mthun dang / mi dge ba'i gzhi mthun dang / lung ma bstan yang yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ rmi lam du dkon mchog gsum la dad gus byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ rmi lam du srog gcod byed pa rmis pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ gnyid dus dran med du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ srid zhi mnyam nyid ces gsu ngas pa ni de gnyis bden stong du mtshungs pa'i don yin gyi/ srid zhi gnyis mnyam pa nyid du 'dod mi rung ste/ gzhan du na 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid dang / bzang ngan yang mnyam pa nyid du 'asdo/ra bas ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa zhing dag sbyor ba ni/ sems can 'jig rten de

180 mngon lto gas rgyan gyi snyik+ka/bzhin du/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/don ni/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni dag pa nyid kyi sbyor ba yin te/bcud kyi sems can 'jig rten ma dag pa rnams dag par sgrub par byed pa de bzhin du/ snod kyi 'jig rten yang ma dag pa de la dag par sgrub pa yi dge rtsa mthu can du gyur pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa thabs mkhas sbyor ba ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni/ /zhes pa nas / thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni rnam thar sgo gsum sogs sher phyin gyi yul dang yul can du dus dang dus ma yin par sbyor ba la mkhas pa can gyi dag sa'i ye shes 'di ni chos can / khyod la thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa bcu yod de/ phung po'i bdud la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i dgra ci rigs pa rnams las ni 'das pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang / chos zams cad la don dam par mi gnas par za snyad du spyod pa'i sbyor ba dang / gzhan gyi don sngon gyi smon lam ji bzhin shugs kyis 'phangs pa'i byed pa can gyi sbyor ba dang / nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dka' spyad goms pa dang / chos zams cad la bden zhen gyis ma chags pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo snong pa nyid kyis 'dus byas thams cad kyi nga dan dam par

skabs bzhipa'iṭik+ka 181mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang / mtshan med kyi rgyu'i mtshan ma don dam par med par rtogs pa dang / smon med kyis 'bras bu la don dam par smon lam zad par rtogs pa dang / rang nyid phyir mi lngog pa yin pa de yi rtags khyad par can dang lngan pa dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i rtogs pa tshad med pa zhes bya ba'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ sbyor ba de gsum lngog pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa yin gyi/ 'gal ba ni ma yin te/ dag sa'i ye shes yin na/ de gsum ka yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de gsum lag rjes 'jog tshul tha dad pa tsam gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir te/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum sgrub byed kyi lag rjes tha dad pa tsam gyis bzhag pa'i phyir te/sa brgyad pa nas bden 'dzin mngon gyur ba spangs shing mi rtog ye shes la goms pa dbang sgyur thob pas de gsum gyi lag rjes khyad par can 'jog nus par mtshungs pa'i phyir / 'dir bdud bzhi'i khyad par yod de/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga phung po'i bdud rags pa dang / nyon sgrib zams cad nyon mongs pa'i bdud rags pa dang / lha'i bu dga' rab dbang phyug lha'i bu'i bdud rags pa dang / las nyon gyi dbang gis srog dbang 'gag pa'i cha de 'chi bdag gi bdud rags pa yin la/ ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang zag

182 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/med kyi las kyi dbang gis skye ba blangs pa'i phung po de phung po'i bdud phra mo dang / ma rig pa'i bag chags phra mo de nyon mongs pa'i bdud phra mo dang lha'i bu'i bdud phra mo gnyis ka dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho byed pa'i cha de 'chi bdag gi bdud phra mo yin pa'i phyir/ bdud bzhi lam gang gi gnas skabs su bcom tshul yod de/ theg pa che chung gi dbang du byas na/ theg dman dgra bcom sbru/ go 'phang dang / sa brgyad pa thob nas nyon mongs pa'i bdud rags pa ci rigs bcom/ theg dman gyi mazong lam dang sbyor lam pa phyir mi lngog pa'i rtags thob nas lha'i bu'i bdud rags pa bcom/ theg dman gyi lhag med myang 'das dang theg chen gyi mthong lam thob nas phung po'i bdud rags pa dang 'chi bdag gi bdud rags pa gnyis ka bcom pa'i phyir/ bdud bzhi ma lus par bcom pa dang sangs rgyas pa gnyis dus mnyam pa yin te/ tshig gsal las/ khyod kyis byang chub pa dang kho nar bdud bzhi bcom pa lags/ zhes pa nas/rnam bshad las kyang / bdud bzhi ma lus par b.ru ma pa ni sangs rgyas pa na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa 'di yang grags pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis bgyis pa'o/ /zhes pa'i gsung par 'di bzhin ser smad grwa tshang gi mkhas grub chen po bsnan pa dar rgyas kyi yig cha bzhir

skabs ba'i pa'i ṭik+ka/ 18 3bzung sne yig cha'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus rnams spros b.rizhad dang / kha skong / mtha' dpyod/ thun mong min pa 'i khas len mi gsal ba rnams 'dir gsal yod par brten snga dus blo gsal ba rnams nas yig cha dang zung sbrel gsan sbyong mdzad mus dang / mkho gnad kyang shin tu che rung / gsung par co ne dgon chen du bzhugs pa dus 'gyur dbang gis sngar nas me bzhes zin 'dug pas da phan slob gnyer ba'i khrod du yig cha dkon ga'as grwa tshang mkhan po rgyal rong blo bzang bsnan 'dzin dang / dge bshes/ slob gnyer ba rnams nas yig cha cha tshang gsung par zhig 'grub thabs thugs gnyer che ba dang bcas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun phan bde'i rtsa ba 7rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub dar rgyasagong 'phel yun ring du gnas ched ser smad gzhung pa grwa sku bcar mkhan drungatā bla ma rong rnam sras pa thub bstan nor bzang shag tshang nas lhag bsam rnam par dag pas rgyu sbyor 'du 'god kyis gong gsal yig cha co de'i par rnying khungs dag rang la ma phyi byas te/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags pho stag lor gsung par du legs bskrun thog grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi chos mdzod du bzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i sa bon legs smin thub pa'i ring lugs yongs 'du'i ljon/ /bstan

184 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi snyik+ka/'dzin rkang drug bye ba rnam rtsen kun dga'i me tog phyogs mthar rgyas/ /ma nor lam bzang 'bras bu'i khur chen bstan srid 'gro phan zungs su dud/bla med zhi ba'i grib bsil snum por 'gro ba ma lus dbugs 'byin shogasarba maṅga kla/ /

185skabs lnga pa'i ṭik+ka mthong ba don yod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /lke.oṃ.oṃ༈ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo / / gnyis pa rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ rgyu mtshan dang / gzhung don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bshad zin pa'i 'og tu rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la goms pa dbang bsgrur ma thob pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bsgoms pa la brten nas de thob pa'i rtse sbyor 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir te/de ltar yang 'grel pa las/ rnam pa zams cad mngone par rdzogs par rtogs pa thob pa la rab kyi mthar phyin pa'i rtogs pa 'byung bas/zhes pa nas / rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhi/ /༈ dang po la bzhi las/ dang po drodi ni/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed/ /ces pa'i

/86 mngon rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/bar gsungs/ gnyis pa rtse mo ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo snyed/ /ces pa nas/ rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/gsum pa bzod pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi/ /nas/brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brdzod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/bzhi pa chos mchog ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang / /nas/ ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ dang po'i don ni/ drod rjes thob la gnas pa'i sems dpa' dbang rnon chos can/drod rtse sbyor thob pa yin te/ bsgoms stobs kyis nyin par ma zad rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun bden stong rmi lam lta bur lta ba la sogs pa'i rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba thob pa'i rtags rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu mdo las bzhed pa sde bshad pa de dag dang lngan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbyor lam rtse mo la gnas pa'i sems dpa' dbang rnon chos can/ rtse mo'i rtse sbyor thob pa yin te/ mdo las 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo la sogs pa stong gsum gyi sems can gyi grangs kyi sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge ba la sogs pa rnam pa mang du ni dper mdzad nas bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba bcu drug gi bdag nyid thob pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam ba1de pa chos can/khyod la brtan pa'i rtse

skabs lngaba'i ṭik+ka/ 187spyor zhes pa ni yum gyi mdo las mngon par brdzod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/bzhi shes la sogs pa'i kun mukhyen nyid gsum gyi chos rnams kyi rtogs rigs yongs su rdzogesapa bla na med pa thob cing sems can gyi done byed pa yongs su mi gtong ba thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mazun gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog pa'i stang nge 'dzin khyad par can chos can/ khyodi mdo las ting nge 'dzin ces yongs su bsgrags pa yin te/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dang po dag dang snong gnyis pa dang snong gsum gyi sa dag srang grangs kyis gzhal ba dang chu skra rtses gzhal nus pa dper mdzad nas/ /de bas kyang sems dang por bskyed pa sbyod pa la zhugs pa phyir mi ldog pa skye ba gcig gis zogs pa'i byang sems kyi dgi ba la rjes su yi rang ba'i bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni mtshon te bstan pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha bzhi pa yin pa'i phyir/ drod rtse sbyor gyi rtags bcu gnyis yod de/ rmi lam du chos thams cad bden med rmi lam ci 'dra de lta bur lta ba dang / rmi lam du dman pa'i lam la dga' ba mi bskyed pa dang / rmi lam du de bzhin gshegs pa 'khorngi bcas mtheng ba dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis rdzu 'phrul snon pa mthong ba dang / des chos snon pa mthong ba dang / ngan song mthong nas spong ba'i

188 mngonirtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/smon pa byed pa dang / rmi sad gang rung la grong khyer sogs mes 'tshig pa mthong nas bden pa'i byin gyis de dag zhi bar byed nus pa dang / rmi sad gang rung gi tshe sems can gzhan mi ma yin gyis zin pa bden snobs brdzod pas zhi nus pa dang / bdud las shes nas de zil gyis gnon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / sher phyin la slob pa dang / chos thams cad la bden par mi zhen pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sar nye bar gyur pa'i ye shes thob pa dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rtse mo'i rtags bcu drug yod de/ snong gsum gyi sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas mchod pa'i bsod nams las lhag pa thob pa dang / de gong du 'phel bas sher phyin yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / snong nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa thob pa dang / byang chub thob byed kyi lam don dam par mi dmigs pa dang / dge ba bcu dang bsam gtan gzugs med la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / 'dodi gzugs kyi lha 'ongs nas srung ba dang /bdud zil gyis gnon nus pa dang / byang sems dang grogs brteg par bslab pa ste phyi'i rtags gtso bor gyur pa brgyad dang / nyan rang yid byed dang bral ba'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rigs khyad par can du sdo/ra pa dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu nus lngan 'grub

skabasalnga pa'i ṭik+ka/ 189pa dang / phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs ser sna sogs cher mi skye ba dang /zos rnams la bden zhen ci rigs mi skye ba dang / sher phyin gyis phyin drug smu slob tshul shes pa dang / theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs phun sum tshogs pa thob pa dang / sher phyin gyi mthus rdzogs byang la nye ba thob pa sde nang gi rtags brgyad dang bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ bzod pa'i rtags yod de / gzhan don khyad par can sgrub nus pa'i thabs kyis zin pa'i snying rje chen po dang /bsgoms byung gi shes rab kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i thabs shes kyitsho rtogs pa brtan po de de yin pa'i phyir/ chos mchog rtse sbyor thob pa'i rtags 44ོda de/ mdo las bsod nams mang po 'byung bas mtshon te bstan pa de lta bur shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa mthong lam rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ spang bya rtog pa dang / gnyen po rtse sbyor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ljog pa la/ nas/ min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen mthong lam gyi spang bya 'jug pa gzung rtog dang ni lngog pa la gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis chos can/ so sor dasdo/ dasdo/'i bdag nyid du shes

90 mtho rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/par bya ste/dmigs yul gyi sgo nas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/ji lta ba rgan du yul gyi rang rgan 'dzin pa ma yin pa'i bdag nyid dag tu shes par bya ste/rang gi zhen yul la phyin ci log tu 'khrul ba'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/so so skye bo 'phags dbye bas//nas/bo sa stong pa'i mtshan nyid do//zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ done ni/ so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'i rten dbye bas semasacan rdzas yod dang skyes bu btagasapar yod par bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod pa de dag chos can/so sor dgu'i bdag nyid du 'dod de/dmigs yul gyi sgo nas de ltar 'byed pa'i phyir/rtog pa de dag chos can/gnas tshod dang mthun par yulagang giga'adzin par 'dod pa mi rigs te/ rgyu mtshan gal te 'am gang gi phyir na gzung ba'i don de bzhin med pa'i log shes yin pa'i phyir te/de la rtog pa de dag rang gis ji ltar zhen pa ltar 'dzin pa yi bo sa stong pa'i mtshan nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/gzung rtog dang /'dzin rtog bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/'jug pa gzung rtog dang /ldog pa tshong rtog gasmo las/dang po ni/po 'i kho dang rigs dang ni//nas/rnamartog de ni rna.oṃdagur 'dod//ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/

skabs 5pa'i ṭilko/ /9/byang sems kyi 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi rnam rtog de ni chos can/rnam pa dgur 'dod pa yin te/byang sems kyi 'jug bya spyi'i ngo bo nyid la dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par zhen pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te bye brag sangs rgyas kyi rigs nges pa dang / byang chen gyi lam ni yang dag par 'grub pa dang / blo'i shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul ba dang / mi mthun phyogs 'joms nus shing gnyen po skye ba dang / rang gi rtog pa mthar thug pa dang / gzhan gyi don byed nus pa dang / gzhan don de'i ni las su bya ba dang / de'i bya ba'i 'bras bu la dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ srid dang zhi bar snung ba'i phyir/ /nas/ nyan thos la sogs yid las 'byung / / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes sgrib ldog pa gzung rtogo ces pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi sde nyan zos la sogs pa'i yid las 'byung ba dman pa'i lam la ltos pa'i ldog byar bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'di chos can/ rnam pa dgu yi bdag nyid du yod de/ srid pa dang zhibar rtsang ba'i phyir na zeg chen las rtog pa dman pa nyid la dmigs nas sdog byar bden par zhen pa dang / de bzhin du lam khyad par can gyis chiyangs su 'dzin pa med pa la dmigs pa dang / gzhan don sgrub pa'i

192 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba la dmigs pa dang / thar pa bzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba la dmigs pa dang / ched du bya ba chen po gsum las log pa la dmigs pa dang / spangs pa nyi tshe ba'i lam la ngamigs pa dang /rtogs pa mtho dman sna tshogs pa nyid dang / zhi mtha' mngon du ma byas par theg chen gyi lam la gnas pa dang der 'jug pa la rmongs pa'i lam la dmigs pa dang / zhi mtha' mngon du byas pa'i rjes la rnam mkhyen du 'gro ba zhes bya ba la dmigs nas lngog byar bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir dngos su bsnan pa'i gzu nga rtog gnyis kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ byang sems lam gyi 'jug bya'i chos la dmigs nas de'i 'jug byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de la 'jug pa gzung rtog dang / de la ltos pa'i ldog bya'i chos la dmigs nas de'i ldog byar bden par 'dzin pa 'i bden 'dzin de la ldog pa gzung rtog tu bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa'i dgos pa yod de/byang sems kyis 'jug par bya ba blang bya dang / ldog par bya ba spang bya'i chos gang la'ang bden par mi 'dzin cing / bden med du rtogs nas bsgom par bya dgos so zhes go ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dzin rtog rgyas par bshad pa la/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / btags 'dzin rtog

skabs lnga pa'i ṭik+ka/ 193pa'i dbye ba bzhad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dzin ji/ dang ni 'dor ba dang / / nas/ 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/ 'dzin pa dang po rdzas 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ khyod la rnam pa dgu yad par shes par bya sne/ kun rdzob tu yon tan 'dzin pa dang skyon 'dor ba'i gang zag la dmigs nas bden par 'dzin pa dang / de bzhin du gang zag la zhes sbyar te gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci log tu yid la byed pa la dmigs pa dang / bden 'dzin gyi khams ni 'dod khams sogs gsum po dag dang nye bar 'brel ba la dang / chos rnams bden par bzung nas gnas pa la dang / de la bden med du bden par mngon par zhen pa dang / chos thams cad tha snyad du chos kyi dalnga sa po tsam du btags pa la dang / mi mthun phyogs la bden par chags pa dang /bden 'dzin gyi gnyen po sgom pa la dang / rnam mkhyen du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin myur du 'gro ba las nyams pa'i gang zag la dmigs nas longs sbyod pa por bden par zhen pa'i rnam rtog dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang / /nas/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin sna / /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan brtags 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ rnam pa dgu yod pa yin te/ ched du bya

194 mngoni rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/bar ji lta ba bzhin nges par mi 'byung ba'i skyes bu btags yad la dmigs nas bden par zhen pa dang / de bzhin du lam min drug la lam ma yin par nges par snyesnadzin pa'i skyes bu la dmigs pa dang / rgyu 'gag pa dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu skye bar zhen pa'i skyes bu la dang /bden 'dzin gyis ma brtsings pa'i lam gyi dngos po ldan pa dang /bcings pa'i lam gyi dngos po mi ldan par 'dzin pa'i sgyes bu la dang /gzung rtog la bden par zhen te gnas pa'i skyes bu la dang / theg dman gyi migs ni 'jig cing nyams par byed pa'i skyes bu la dang /rdzogs byang don du gnyer ba med pa'i skyes bu la dang / rgyu shen phyin sgom pa med pa'i skyes bu la dang / bdud sogs phyir sgomal ba ni dmigs pa'i skyelobu btanas yod la longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i rna.oṃrtog dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ 'dzin stog 'di gnyis kyi 'jog tshul yad de/rdzas yod rdzas 'dzin 3) chos la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / btags yod btags 'dzin la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin la btags 'dzin rtog par bzhig pa yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan ni kun btags kyi dbang du byas pa yin 2/ mazong

skabs lngaba'i ṭik+ka/ 195lam bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi spang bya 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir gzung rtog 'dzin rtog gnyis ni bden 'dzin la 'jog par mtshungs kyang khyad par yod de/ gzung rtog gnyis yul la zhen pa dang / 'dzin rtog gnyis yul can dze+ezhen pa gtso bo'i dbang du mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir te/ snga ma gnyis yul la longs spyad bya dang phyi ma gnyis yul can la longs spyod pa por zhen pa'i khyad par gyis yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa gnyen po rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ mablong lam rtse sbyor gyi rgyu/ de'i 'bras bu byang chen/ rtse sbyor gyi bo bshad pa gsum/ dang po sna/ byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang / /nas/ bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi rigs can gzhan byang chub la snon pa ste/ 'god pa dang / byang chub de yi rgyu sher phyin gyi tshig don ni yongs su gtong ba ste 'chad pa dang / byang chen de thob byed bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid can gyi sbyor lam mnyam gzhag ye shes chos can/ khyod mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi bar chad med pa'i rgyu yin te/ de bar chad med par skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/byang chen ngos bzung ba/ dngos po bden grub tu khas len pa mi 'thad pa/

196 mngon rte gas rgyan gyi snyik+ka/dbu ma pas chos thams cad bden snong du khas len dgos par bsnan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i/ /nas/ go rim bzhin du shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ byang chub chen po yin zhes brjodi de/ dri ma don dam par zad pa med pa dang mi skye bar rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar zug yin pa'i phyir te/de ltar rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes de dag go ri.oṃbazhin du zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub chen por shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ dri ma de yang chos can/ don dam par zad med skye med yin te/ deni dam par grub pa med pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa la/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba dang / lung dang 'gal ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /nas/skye med rnam pa ci zhig 'thob/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni chos can/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa'i rigs bden grub sngar yod ci zhig zad cing / de bden grub skye 'phro chad pa'i skye med kyi rnam pa ci zhig kyang 'thob ste 'thob pa med par thal/ dri ma bden grub sngar yod gsar du 'bags pa'i 'gog pa med pa ste/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/

skabs lngapa'i ṭik+ka/ 197gnyis pa ni/ gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yad la/ /nas/ de la khe rwa1sa mtshar du brtsis/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ dngos smra ba gzhan gyi lugs la phyi nang gi chos rnams kyang don dam par yad la/shes bya la yang rmongs pa'i sgrib pa mtha' dag snon pa yis zad par brjod pa gang yin pa'i dngos smra ba'i lugs de la byams pa khobo sa ngo mtshar du brtsis pa la chos can/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ sgrib pa bden par grub na gnyen pos spang du mi rung bas de ltar 'dod pa de bzhad gad kyi gnas yin par rtogs pa'i phyir/ /༈ gsum pa ni/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /nas/ yang dag mazong nas rnam par grol/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i 'di la chos can/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag nyid sngar yod gsar du bsal bar bya ba dang / bdag 'dzin gnyis don dam par grub pa ci yang med de/ bdag 'dzin gnyis zhen yul dang bcas pa don dam par grub ma myong ba'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ bdag med gnyis sngar med par gsar du gzhag par bya ba cung zad kyang med de/ bdag nyid gdod ma nas ma grub pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ rten 'brel

198 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi snyik+ka/bden par med pa'i yang dag pa'i don de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i shegarab kyis yang dag par lta ba yin te yang dag pa'i don ji ltab bzhin du mthonge nas yang yang goms par byas par mthong ba po sgrib gnyis las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'di'i don go bde bar bshad na 'di ltar yin te/ chos thams cad grub tsam nyid nas bden par med pa yin gyibaden grusade nyid sngar yod lung rigs sogs kyis gsar du med par byas pa min cing / bden stong de yang sngar med gsar du lung rigs sogs kyis bzhag pa ma yin pas/ yang dag pa'i don gyi gnas lugs sngar yod la der ngo shes par byas nas grol bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ 'dis dbu ma'i lugs kyi bzhi lam 'bras gsu.oṃbastan pa yin te/ gzugs sogs bden snong bzhi/ de rtogs pa'i ye shes lam / ngo bo nyid sku lta bu 'bras bu dbu mar bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir//༈ gsum pa la/ dngos dang / spangs pa la dbang byed pa gnyis / dang po ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni/ /nas/ bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i ngo bo 'dir sna sbyin sogs de dag phan tshun bsdus pa gang yin pa skad cig gcig pa'i sdug bsngal chos shes pa'i

skabs lngapa'i ṭik+ka/ 199bcadi pa yis bsdus pa'i theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can / skabs 'dir mazong ba'i lam gyi rtse sbyor yin te/ mthong spang shes sgrib dngos su 'jom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi bden par mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas seṅge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ /nas/lugs mi mthun la rtogs par byed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ done ni/bshad zin pa de nas mthong lam rtse sbyor la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chos can /ཿ rang gi spangs pa la dbang byed pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan te / mnyam gzhag tu seṅge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dus phyis rjes thob tu rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis kyi lugs mazun dang lugs mi mthun la rtogs par byed pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ seṣ+pe rnam par bsgyi ngas pa'i stang nge 'dzin rnam grol lam las langs rjes su ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed 'byung ba nas skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi 'byung ba'i bar nyon mongs phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mthun dang ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gags pa nas skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar rnam byang phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mazun dang / yang rga shi skye ba las 'byung

200 mngorme rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/ba nas 'du byed ma rig pa las 'byung ba'i bar nyon mongs phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mi mthun dang / rga shi 'gags pas ma rig pa 'gags pa'i bar rnam byang phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mi mthun du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sgom lam rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ gnyen po sgom lam/spang bya rtog pa/ de spangs pa'i phan yon gsum/ /༈ dang po ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ /nas / 'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni / sa brgyad pa'i rgyud kyi seṅge rnam par bsgyings pa'i stang nge 'dzin gyi snyoms 'jug chos can/ thod rgal gyi sbyor ba yin te/ thod rgal gyi dngos gzhi sngon 'gro 'gog pa dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu po'i bar dag tu/ gang yang ma bcug par lugs mthun dang lugs mi mazun rnam pa gnyis su yar song zhing mar 'ongs nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i mngon rtogs mdor rngagad pa de yin pa'i phyir/ sa brgyad pa ba'i rgyud kyi mnyam gzhag ma yin pa'i 'dod par gtogs pa'i sas bsdus pa'i rnam par shes pas sa mtshams gzung ste bar la 'dod sems spel ba'i snyoms 'jug de chos can/ thod rgal du ni snyoms par 'jug pa'i dngos

skabs lngapa'i ṭik+ka/ 201gzhi yin te/ sbyor ba seṅge rnam bsgyings sngon du btang nas dang por 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug de las langs nas 'dod sems mngon du byed/ de nas 'gog pa gcig pu brgal nas srid rtse dang / de nas 'dod sems/ de nas 'be ga pa dang srid rtse gnyis brgal nas ci yang med dang / de nas yang 'dod sems/ de ltar de gsum brgal nas rnam shes mtha' yas dang / de nas 'dodi sems/ de ltar bzhi brgal nas nam mkha' mtha' yas dang / yang 'dod sems/ de ltar lnga brgal nas bsam gtan bzhi pa dang / yang mdod sems/ de ltar drug brgal nas bsam gtan gsum pa dang / yang 'dodi sems/ de ltar bdun brgal nas bsam gtan gnyis pa dang / yang 'dodi sems/ de ltar brgyad brgal nas bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug cing /de las langs nas 'dod sems mngon du byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i thod rgal gyi stang nge 'dzin de chos can/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi rang bzhin thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug ces bya sne/ 'alog pa dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu'i bar du 'dod sems spel te/spel gzhi dang spel chos mi 'dra bar spel nas 'gro ba'i theg chen gyi rjes

202 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir te/ spel bzhi mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu la spel chos 'dod sems spel nas snyoms par 'jus pa'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ de ni dngos bstan yin la/ de'i shugs kyis gang bsnan pa yang yod de/ bar du gang yang ma bcug pa'i yar song gcig dang / mar 'ongs bsam gzugs brgyad la 'gog pa spel ba gnyis don gyis bstan pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa spang bya rtog pa la/ gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jug pa gzung rtog ngang / ljog pa gzung rtog gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /nas / sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni / gnyen po sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can spang bya shes sgrib 'jug pa gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa 'di chos can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ mdor bsdus pa'i gsung rab baspyodi bya dang bcas la dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par zhen pa dang / de bzhin du gsung rab rgyas par brdzod bya dang bcas pa la dang / sangs rgyas kyis bstang bas te grogs kyis yongs su ma bzung ba'i gnyen po sher phyin yid la byed pa la dang / 'das pa sbyor lam dang da lta ba mthong lam dang ma 'ongs pa sgom lamastedus gsumagyi

skabasalngapa'i ṭik+ka/ 203yon tan don dam par med kyang tha snyad du yod pa la dmigs pa dus la ltos pa gsum dang / legs pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ni sbyor mthong snom pa'i lam rnam pa gsum gyi ngo tho la dming/sa nas 'jug byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gsum dang bcas pa dgu yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams/ /nas/ sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi sgom pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i sems dang sems byung 'jug pa'i yul can bar chad med lam rnams kyis spong bar yin par bzhed pa'i gnyis pa shes sgrib lngog pa gzung rtog chos can/ khyod la dgu yod par shes par bya ste/ re zhig byang chub kyi sems mi skye ba la dmigs nas lngog byar bden par zhen pa dang / de bzhin du byang chub kyi snying po chos sku yid la mi byed pa la dang / nyan rang gi theg pa dman pa yid la byed pa gnyis la dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid la mi byed pa la dang / lam sher phyin gyi gzugs brnyan sgom pa la dang / stong nyid phra mo sgom pa med pa la dang / sgom dang sgom pa med pa de dag las ni bzlos pa sgom mi sgom min pa nyid la dmigs pa gnyis la dang / gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin gyi don ma yin pa rnams la dmigs nas ldog byar bden par rnam

204 mngon rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/par rtog pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ dang po sna/ sems can btags pa'i spyod yul can/ /nas/ shes par bya ba bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ spang bya rdzas su 'dzin par byed pa dang por gnas pa de ltar shes par bya ba mdo las bsgrags pa gang yin pa'i sgom spang rdzas 'dzin rtog pa chos cagi / khyod la dgu yad de/ sems can du btags pa'i sbyod yul so skye la dmigs nas longs sbyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa dang /de bzhin du phung sogs kyi chos su btags pa tsam gyi gang zag la dang / tha snyad du yod pas stong pa ma yin pa nyid kyi mkhyen gsum sgom pa'i gang zag la dang / dmigs pa la bden par chags pa'i skye bo la dang / gnas lugs kyi don rab tu 'byed pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang sems la dang / dman pa'i myang 'das kyi dngos potho ba byar byed pa'i nyan rang 'phags pa la dang / theg pa gsum gyis nges par 'byung ba'i byang sems la dang / sbyin bdag gi yon gyi dag pa ma yin pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa la dang / phyin drug gi spyod pa rnamopar 'khrug pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa la dmigs nas longs spyod du bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sems

skabs lnga pa 'i ṭik+ka/ 205can btags dang de rgyu yi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis mdor bstan nas/bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni/ /nas/ rnam par rtog pa tha mar bzhed / / ces pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bshad la/ dang po'i don ni/sems can du tha snyad du btags pa dang tha snyad de 'dogs pa'i rgyu yi phung po la bden par zhen pa'i yul can gzhan sgom spang btags 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ theg chen gyi sgom pa'i lam de yis rnam par 'joms pas sgom pa'i lam de dang 'brel ba yi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam pa dgu yod de / dmigs yul gyi dbye bas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'i don ni / rtog pa de chocha/ can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ rang gi dmigs pa'i bdag nyid ji bzhin du gzhi shes sogs kun mkhyen ni rnam pa gsum gyi sgrib pa rnam pa gsum spong ba'i skyes bu la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i me+ongs pa gsum dang / de bzhin du sgrib pa thams cad zhi ba'i lam la rmongs pa dang / chos nyid kyi de bzhin nyid la sogs pa dang chos can gzugs sobs mtshungs par ldan pa lnga rwa1 gcig pa dang mi ldan pa ngobo tha dad pa la dang / theg pa che chung gi lamakhami mnyam pa la dang / sdug bsngal la sogs pa bden bzhi'i choms nyid la dang /nyon mongs rnams glo bur ba nyid kyi rang bzhin la dang / gzung 'dzin
