1 06 mngon rtogasargyanagyi ṭik+ka/rdzas za dad pa'i gnyis su med pa'i de kho na nyid la kun tu rmongs pa'i skyes bu la dmiges nas longs spyod pa por bden par rnam par rtog pa za mar bzhed pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa ni rtog pa lhan skyes kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ sgom spangs kyi dbang du mdzad nas gsurngas pa'i phyir/gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog 'jog tshul gyi khyad par sngar bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gsum pa phan yon ni/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni / / nas/ rnam pa kun tu bsnen par byed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/ theg pa chen po'i spangs rtogs kyi 'bras bu mchog gis sba ba sde mdzes pa yi sgom lam chen po'i chen po la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po de chos can/ khyod la ni theg pa gsum gyi spang rtogs kyi yan tan gyi rigs phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed de/ nad pa nad las grol nas yun ring lon nas dga' bas dbugs phyin pa ltar mi bzad pa'i yams nad dang 'dra ba'i sgom spang chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs spang bya 'di rnams zad nas ni rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba la sgrib gnyis kyi nad sel bar byed pa'i spangs pa'i yon tan dang / rgya mtsho che la chu bo 'du ba bzhin du theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs rnams ngang gis 'du bar 'gro

skabs lnga pa'iṭik+ka/ 207ba'i bde ba mam lus pa sgrub par byed pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ bzhi pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ dngos kyi don dang / log rtog bsal ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bsod nams mang pos mtshon te bstan pa dang / dmigs rnam bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni / snong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang / /nas/ de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid / / ces pa 'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ mdo las stong gsum gyi skye bo rnams nyan thos dang bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' skyon med pa'i sa dang po la bkod pa'i dge ba rnams bsod nams che ba dper mdzad nas de bas kyang bsod nams ches mang po nyid kyis ni mtshon te bstan pa'i rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni chos can/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor yin te/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi ye shes rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid bar chad med du dngos su skyed par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar zug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de/ /nas/rab tu smra rnams rgyud mar rgol/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/bden grub kyi dngos po med pa de chos can/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor

208 mngonartogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/'di yi dmigs pa yin te/ de'i sgro 'dogs gcad gzhi yin pa'i phyir/rgyun mtha'i sbyor ba'i dus kyi dran pa theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ rtse sbyor de'i bdag po'i rkyen yin par bzhed de/ de rang dbang du dngos su skyed par byed pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor chos can/ rnam pa zhi ba nyid yin te/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas gnyis snang gi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ bar chang med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnam 'di chos can/ shin tu zab pa yin te/ khyod la ni bden gnyis ngobo 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i dbang gis rtsod pa rab tu smra ba rnams kyis rgyud mar rgol bar 'byung yang klan ka'i gnas ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa log rtog bsal ba ni/ dmigs pa 'thad dang de yi ni/ /nas/rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/ rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid dang bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnam la brten pa can gyi bden gnyis ngobo gcig tu 'du mi rung bar 'gal bar smra ba rnams /rmis 'o/ོga par rtog pa chos can/ rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed de/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor de'i dmigs pa 'thad pa la mi 'thad do snyam du log par rtog pa dang / de bzhin du dmigs pa de

skabs lnga pa'i ṭik+ka/ 209yi ni ngo bo nyid bden stong du nges par bzung ba la dang / 'bras bu rnam kun mkhyen nyid kyi ye shes la dang / don dam pa'i bden pa'i don dang kun rdzob kyi bden pa gnyis la dang / spyod pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor pa dang / skyabs dkon mchog gsum so so la dang / thabs la mkhas dang bcas pa la dang / thub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa 'a/ dang /rtag 'dzin sogs phyin ci log bzhi dang ni de dag spong bar byed pa'i lam dang bcas pa gnyis pa la dang / gnyen po ye shes dang spang bya mi mthun phyogs dag la dang / bsgom bya dang spyi'i mtshan nyid dang de sgom pa gnyis la log par rtog pa gnyis rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ log rtog rnams kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i sun 'byin de la gnyis yod de/ kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka dang / don dam sgo can gyi klan ka gnyis yod pa'i phyir/de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ dbu ma pa'i kun rdzob kyi khas len rtags su bkod nas don dam sun 'byin pa'i sun 'byin de/ kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka dang / dbu ma pa'i don dam gyi khas len rtags su bkod nas kun rdzob sun 'byin pa'i sun 'byin de/ don dam sgo can gyi klan ka yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ dngos smra bas dbu ma pa la sa bon gyis myu gu bskyed pa mi 'thad par thal/ sa myug kun rdzob tu grub pa'i phyir zhes

210 mngonartogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka 'phangs pa 'i sun 'byin lta bu yin pa 'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnam mi 'thad par thal/ chos thams cad done dam ji ra ma grub pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

21/skabs drug pa dang bdun pa'i ṭik+ka mthong ba don yod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /gangathortesnokhu༈ gsum pa mthar gyi sbyor ba ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang / /zhes pa nas/ mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/don ni/shes bya chos can/ mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed pa bcu gsum yod de/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi mthar /rmis bar drug dag dang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa sde chos dge 'dun tshul khrims gtong ba lha rjes su dran pa drug dang / chos thams cad don dam par dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa nyid kyi sna dbye bas mthar gyis sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mthar gyi sbyor ba'i don yod de/ mkhyen gsu ma gyi rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bsgom pa'i tshe chos bcu gsum po des zin pa 'i sgo nas go rim ma 'chol bar sgom ji ra byed pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ bzhi pa skad cig sbyor ba bzhed pa la/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa 'i skad cig sbyor ba/ rnam par smin pa 'i/ mchan nyid med pa'i/

212 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ba dang bzhi/ dang po la dngos dang /dpe gnyis las/ dang po sna/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang / /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/don ni/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i thub pa'i rgyud kyi rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi lam gyi rigs rnams mngon du byed pa'i sbyor ba 'di sna chos can/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma gcig pa yi rtogs pa yin par shes par bya ste/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phyin drug re res kyang rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi chos kyi rigs kun bsdus nas mngon du byed pa'i sems dpa'i sbyor ba mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dpe ni/ ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud/ /ces sogs rkang pa bzhi/ don ni/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig girmi zag med kyi ye shes thams cad shes nus pa thob pa yin te/ ji ltar te dper na zo chun gyi rgyud gcig skyes bus rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na rgyun thams cad cig char 'gul ba ltar dpe tshul de bzhin du shes nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnam par smin pa ni/ gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi/don ni/ sgrib gnyis kyi dngos gnyen bar chad med lam sgom pa gang gi tshe dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i chos dkar po thams cad kyi rang bzhin

skabs drug padang bdun pa'i ṭik+ka/ 213shes rab kyai pha rol tu phyin pa zag med rnam par smin pa'i chos nyid kyi gnas skabs rgyun mtha'i ye shes skyes pa de'i tshe rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam chos can/ zag med kyi chos thams cad skad cig ma gcig gis mngon du byed nus pa yin te/ snong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa tshan nyid med pa ni/sbyin pa la sogs sbyod pa yis/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/rgyun maza'i bar chad med lam chos can/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ kun byang gi chos rnams don dam par mtshan nyid med pa nyid du dus skad cig ma gcig gis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin drug gi spyod pa yis chos kun snang la rang bzhin med pa rmi lam dang 'dra bar rtogs pa la gnas nas goms pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ba ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid/ /ces sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam chos can/gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos rnams rdzas tha dad gyis stong pa gnyis su med pa yi de nyid skad cig ma

214 mngon hoṃgs rgyan gyi snyik+ka/gcig gis mngon sum du mthong nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar zug yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rmi lam gyi ri ra ba khang khyim sogs dang ni de mthong ba'i sad pa'i shes pa nyid rdzas tha dad pa gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ba ltar ro/ /skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bzhi po sna 'gal ba ma yin te/bzhi gcig byed las tha dad pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i ngo sna gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar mtshan nyid lkus ni rnam pa bzhi / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di nyid kyang bshad sgrub ming can gyis bris pa'/ /zhes pa'i gsung par 'di bzhin ser smad grwa tshang gi mkhas grub chen po bstan pa dar rgyas kyi yig cha gzhir bzung ste yig cha'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus rnams spros bshad dang / kha skong/mtha' dpyod/ thun mong min pa'i khas len mi gsal ba rnams 'dir gsal yad par brten snga dus blo gsal ba rnam/sa nas yig cha dang zung sbrel gas/na sbyong mdzad mus dang / mkho gnad kyang shin tu che rung /gsung par co de dgon chen du bzhugs pa dus 'gyur dbang sgas sngar nas me bzhes zin 'dug pas da phan slob genyer ba'i khrod du yig cha dkon gshis grwa tshang mkhan po rgyal rong blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / dbe bshes / slob gnyer ba rnams nas yig cha cha tshang gsu nga par zhig 'grub

skabasadrugapa dang bdunapa'i ṭik+ka/ 215thabs thugs gnyer che ba dang bcas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun phan bde'i rtsa ba 7rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub dar rgyas gong 'phel yun ring du gnas ched ser smad gzhung pa grwa sku bcar mkhan drung tā bla ma rong rnam sras pa thub bsnan nor bzang shag tshang nas lhag bsam rnam par dag pas rgyu sbyor 'du 'god kyis gong gsal yig cha co ne'i par rnying khungs dag rang la ma phyi byas te/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags pho stag lor gsung par du legs bskrun thog grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi chos mdzod du bzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i sa bon legs smin thub pa 'i ring lugs yongs 'du'i ljon/ /bstan 'dzin rkang drug bye ba rnam rtsen kun dga'i me tog phyogs mthar rgyas/ /ma nor lam bzang 'bras bu'i khur chen bstan srid 'gro phan zungs su dud/ /bla med zhi ba'i grib bsil snum por 'gro ba ma lus dbugs 'byin shog /sarba dza ga ti/ /

2/7skabs brgyad pa'i ṭik+ka don gyi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhu/gas so/ /thongagartesmuru༈ gsum pa chos sku rgyas par bshad pa la/ skabs 'dir chos sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / gzhung don dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/shes bya chos can/ skad cig sbyor ba bshad zin pa'i rjes su 'bras bu chos sku 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ skad cig sbyor ba sgom pa'i byang sems rgyun mtha' ba des skad cig gnyis pa'i dus su 'bras bu chos sku 'thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan kyis bshad pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang 'grel pa las / skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rtogs pa byang chub pa rnam par bsgoms pa'i skad cig ma gnyis pa la chos kyi sku mngon par byang chub pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ byang sems rgyun mtha' ba gsar du sangs rgyas pa'i dus mtshams yod de/ rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po bo pa dang / ji lta ba la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i ngang nas ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa dang / yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa dang / mtshan dpes sbras pa'i lus kyi rigs 'dra phyi ma longs

28 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭi k+ka/skuX lus su gnas gyu/ pa daX /loXs sku dang doXs rgyu tshogs pa ༷ra gcag la rag las ༷'aspe tshul gyas ༷bral ba grub pa' sprul sku grangs mad thoX pa dus mnyam pa' phyar ne+e/gnyaX pa gzhung don ༷ngos bshad pa la/༷༷༷ /ma gzhadzi ༷nga / 'phran las kya rnam gzhag ༷nyam/ dang po la/nga ba nyad ༷spyo/ya shas chos sku/longs sku/sprul sku' rnam gzhag bshad pa dang bzha// zhe spe'unye spe ru rīmu༈ dngaspe pa na/thub rda' ngamu ba nyad sku na/zhas pa ༷sa/da dag raX ༷ kyi mtshan 3da can//cas pa' bar gsungs/don na/ tram̐b ༷'a nga ba nyaX sku naspe//chorji ca//sngi+od khyaX chos sdusum dang ldan pa yan ta / zag pa mad pa' chos ngas shas sna tshan spyar gasdug po gang dag rdzogs pa ra thob par gyur ༷ ldan pa 'a khyad pa//rdzuX dzinyaX rnam ༷ kun / rnam ༷ ra dag pa brasdu ba'asgo khyad pa ra/zag tram̐d kya ༷ shas sda tram̐X ༷༷ gcag po ༷ dag rang bzhan bdan pas rnyo rda pa' mtshan+d+ra nyad can3 nga dro' lji ṭ+wāṃ ra ta tram̐d chosdu gsum sdong lngan pa 'a n+d+rag pa gnyas sa lngan gya sku yan+d+ra ༷ gir/tsā na gnyas yod da/ rang dzon rnam dag sdu ༷༷༷ spyor pa' ḍi ba nyad sku n+d+raḍi / glo bur /ma ༷ga sdu char gyur paX nga ༷ nyad sku ༷༷༷ yod pa' phyar/skabs 'dar da gnyam 'gal ba yan ta/dang pa dan dam

skabs brgyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 219bden pa dang / phyi ma kun rdzob bden pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dang po ni stong gzhi zag med kyi ye shes rnams bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid dang / phyi ma ni de rnams kyi dri ma spangs pa'i cha la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa ye shes chos sku bshad pa la/ dngos dang / bye brag tu bshad pa dang / de la rtsod pa spong ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dran pa nyer bzhag nas/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi bar byang chub kyi phyogs dang mazun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs can gyi rnam thar gnyis sdug pa'i rnam thar gcig gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi 'gog pa 'i rnam par thar pa dang brgyad/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug bzhi 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gcig ste mthar gyis ni gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yi bdag nyid dang / zad par sa chu me rlung sngon po ser po dmar po dkar po nam mkha' rnam shes kyi skye mched de zad par gyi skye mched bcu yi bdag nyid dang / rnal 'byor pa rang lugs la gzugs kyi 'du shes bzhag nas phyi rol gyi gzugs che chung la lta ba gnyis dang / gzugs/ kyi 'du shes ma bzhag par gzugs che chung du lta ba gnyis te bzhi dang / de'i 'du shes ma

220 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/bzhag par sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i zil gnon gyi skye mched bzhi'i rab tu dbye bas rnam pa brgyad dang / nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smon gnas mkhyen pa dang / mig gi mngon shes sogs mngon shes drug dang / chos don nges pa'i tshig spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / rten dmigs pa zugs ye shes te rnam pa thams cad dag pa bzhi dang / tshe sems yo byad las skye ba mos pa smon lam rdzu 'phrul ye shes chos la dbang ba sde dbang bcu dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i snobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang / sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa yongs su dag pa 'i bsrung ba med pa rnam pa gsum dang / chos ston pa'i tshe gdul byas nyan 'dod pa dang mi 'dod pa dang de gnyis ka la chags snang med pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa rnam pa gsum dang / sems can 'dul ba'i dus las mi 'da' ba'i bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid dang / sgrib gnyis kyi bar chags yang dag par bcom pa dang / skye bo mtha' dag la phan pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na'i ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad mdo las bshad pa gang yin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / dang gi sgras bsnan pa'i lam shes dang /

skabasabargyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 22/gzhi shes te zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig po de dag chos can/khyod la ye shes chos sku zhes brdzod pa yin te/ ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir//༈ 'dir slob dpon 'phags pa dang seng bzang gnyis kyis rtsa ba'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul la khyad par cung zad yod de/ 'phags pas thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis ngo bo nyid sku mdor bstan nas/ byang chub phyogs mazun tshad med dang / nas/ chos kyi sku zhes brdzod pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ngo bo nyid sku rgyas par bshad par bzhed la/ slob dpon seng gi bzang pos thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ zhes sogs kyis 13 ga nyid sku gtso bor bsnan nas/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang / zhes sogs kyis chos sku gtso bor rgyas par 'chad par bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar bshad kyang dgongs pa ni mi 'gal te/ tshig gi 'brel ltar na ni/ 'phags pa bzhin 'chad dgos la/ don gyis thub tshul la seng ge bzang po'i bzhed pa ltar byas pa la'ang dgos pa khyad par can yad pa'i phyir/ rgyas bshad kyi skabs 'dir ma zad lus rnam gzhag gi skabs kyi tshig don 'chad tshul la'ang cung zad mi 'dra ba yod de mi 'gal lo/ /des na/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di

222 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/'phags pa ltar na chos nyid sku zhes brjod pa yin zhes thob la seng bzang ltar na ye shes chos kyi sku zhes brjod/ /ces pa zhig don gyis thob pa yin te/ snga mas de ltar thob pa yin kyang rgya skad la mi bde ba'i dbang gis chos nyid sku zhes mi 'byung bar chos kyi sku zhes 'byung bar bzhed/ phyi mas tshig sdud kyi dbang gis de ltar du 'byung bar bzhed pa'i phyir te/ snga mas zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig po de dag bden pas stong pa'i chos nyid la chos nyid kyi sku zhes baju+od pa yin zhes bzhed la/ phyi mas de las logs su chos can zag med kyi ye 3go de rnams la ye shes chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smon gnas mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin bshad pa dang gnyis/dang po ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs / don ni/ rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med pa'i stang nge 'dzin de chos can / nyan rang gi nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ nyan thos sogs kyi nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin sna rang la lta ba'i mi yi mi dgi ba'i nyon mongs kyi dmigs rkyen byed pa yongs su spong ba tsam nyid yin la/ khyod kyis rang rgyud lngan gyi rgyal ba

skabs brgyad pa'i ṭilko/ 223grong sogs su byon pa na lta ba'i skye bo de'i nyon mongs rnams rgyun gcod nus pa'i byed las dang lngan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas smon gnas mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni chos can/ smo rang gi smon gnas mkhyen pa las khyad par du 'phags te/ 'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub pa dang / bden 'dzin gyi chags pa spangs pa dang /shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa dang / dus rgyun mi 'chad par rtag tu gnas pa dang / 'dri ba kun gyi lan 'debs nus par mdo las bzhed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de la rtsod pa spong ba la/ chos sku rtag pa la rtsod pa spong ba/ khyab rtag gnyis ka la rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ /༈ dang po la/ rtsod pa dang lan no/ /dang po rtsa bar dngos su ma zin kyang 'grel pa ltar na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos can/se mas can la sku dngos su snang ba'i sgo nas don mdzad mi mdzad kyi khyad par mi 'azad par thal/ dus rtag tu thugs rje chen po 'i ngang las ma g.yas pa ra bzhugs pa'i phyir zhes rtsod/ gnyis pa lan la sgrub phyogs dang / dgag phyogs kyi lan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po sna/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ snon pa chos can/

224 mngonartogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/rtag tu thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa yin yang gzhan la sku dngos su snang mi snang gi sgo nas don mdzad pa mi 'gal bar thal/ khyod la dngos su chos nyan pa'i rgyu tshogs ni yangs su smin par gyur nas gdul bya gang dang gang la yul gang la ni dus gang gi tshe dngos su chos de snon pa'i bya ba phan par gyur pa de dang de la sku dngos su snang ba'i sgo nas don mdzad pa yin 24 cho+ogs ma bsags ma smin pa'i gdul bya la de ltar snang ba'i sgo nas don mi mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / / zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos can/ 'jig rten du dngos su byung bar gyur kyang sems can kha cig gilokhyod la dngos su chos nyan pa la sogs pa'i skal ba bzang po mi myong ba'i rgyu mtshan yad par zal/ de dag khyod la dngos su chos nyan pa sogs kyi skal ba med pas so/ /dper na/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / rul ba la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis sa bon mi rung bar gyur pa de las myu gu sngon po mi 'khrungs pa ltar ro/ /༈ gnyis pa khyab rtag gnyis ka la rtsod pa spong ba la/ dri ba dang / lan gnyis/ dang po rtsa bar dngos su mi gsal yang 'grel pa ltar na/ ye shes chos sku de chos can/ khyod la khyab pa zhes brdzod mi

skabasabargyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 225rigs par thal/ khyod sangs rgyas 'phags pa nyid kyi rgyud kho na la yod pa'i rten nges pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la rtag pa zhes kyang brjod mi rigs par thal/ skad cig re re la skye zhing 'byung ba'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/sangs rgyas de nyid chos can/ khyod la khyab pa zhes nges par brdzod pa yin te / skal ldan mtha' dag la mdzad pa 'phrin las 'jug pa rgya che bas na/de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas de chos can/ khyod la rtag pa zhes brdzod pa yin te/ rang nyid rgyun 'chad pa'i zad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa longs sku bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas mdor bsnan pa dang / yon tan gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ /༈ dang po ni/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /zhes pa nas/thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/'chad 'gyur ltar mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid can gyi gzugs skur dngos su bstan pa 'di chos can/ thub pa/'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed pa yin te/ theg chen gyi chos la nye bar longs spyod pa la sogs pa nges pa lnga lngan gyis rab tu phye ba'i gzugs sku mthar thug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa yon tan gyi sgo nas

226 mngon rtogs rgyanagyi ṭik+ka/rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshan dang / dpe byad bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la / dngos dang / de'i rgyu bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/ /༈ phyag zhabs 'khor le'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ /zhes pa nas/ 'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs / shes bya chos can/ longs sku'i mtshan 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis su grangs nges pa yin te/ de yang longs sku'i phyag dang zhabs gnyis 'khor le'i mtshan dang ldan pa dang / rus sbal bzhin du zhabs gnas pa dang / phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo rnams dra bas 'brel ba dang /phyag dang zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa dang / sku 'di yi ni phyag zhabs kyi rgyab bzhi dang phrag gong gnyis dang ltag pa ste bdun po dag mtho ba dang / sor mo rnams ring ba dang / phyag zhabs kyi rting pa yangs pa dang / sku che zhing drang ba dang / zhabs kyi long bu phyir 'bur ba mi mngon pa dang / sku'i spu ni gyen du phyogs pa ste bcu dang / byin pa ri dwags e na ya'i byin pa dang 'dra ba dang / phyag ring zhing mdzes pa dang /gsang gnas 'dom gyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog dang ldan pa dang /sku'i lngags pa gser mdog mchog dang lngan pa dang / lpags pa 'jam zhing srab pa dang / sku'i spu ni re re nas g.yas phyogs su legs par

skabasabargyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 227'khyil zhing 'khrungs pa dang / zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa dang / ro snod seng ge'i stod dang 'dra ba dang / sku 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo rlum pa dang /thal gong rgyas pa ste bcu dang / ljags 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog tu snang ba dang / sku ni shing n+ya gro dha ltar 'dom gyi phan tshun gyi rtse mo nas 'jal ba'i tshad ci tsam pa zhabs nas spyi bo'i bar yang de tsam du mnyam pa'i chu zheng gab pa dang / dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa dang / ljags ring zhing mdzes pa dang / gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bu dang / 'gram pa seṅge'i 'gram pa 'dra ba dang / tshems shin tu dkar ba dang / tshems mnyam pa dang / de thag bzang ba dang / de grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba ste bcu dang / spyan ni dkar nag gi cha ma 'dres pa'i mthon mazing can dang / spyan 2) rdzi ma ba mchog ste khyu mchog gi rdzi ma dang 'dra ba gnyis dang bcas pa so gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyu ni/ 'di la mtshan ni gang gang gi /zhes pa nas/ mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ longs sku 'di la ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan ni so gnyis po 'di dag yang dag par 'grub pa'i rgyu yod de/ ma so gnyis po gang dang gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin pa de dang de ni rab tu

228 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/rdzogs pa las de dag 'grub pa'i phyir/ rgyu de dag kyang yad de/ yum gyi mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin du/ bla ma skyel ba dang bsu ba la sogs byas pas ni phyag zhabs kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan 'grub pa'i rgyu byed pa dang /sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa brtan pas ni zhabs rus sbal bzhin du gnas pa'i rgyu byed pa dang / bsdu ba bzhi brten pas ni sor mo rnams dra bas 'brel ba'i rgyu byed pa dang / gya nom pa'i dngos po gzhan la sbyin pas ni phyag zhabs bzhon sha chags pa sogs rtul rgyu dang / gsad par bya ba las thar par byed pa ni sku che zhing drang ba'i rgyu dang / dge ba'i chos ni yang dag par blangs pa spel ba la sogs pa nas/ khethong khro med pa ni ba'i rdzi ma lta bu'i mtshan sgrub byed kyi rgyu yi mtshan nyid dang rang bzhin gyi bar so gsum yod pa'i phyir/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs dang ldan pa'i gang zag la longs skus ma khyab ste/ malha ga gi sprul sku la'ang de yod pa'i phyir/ mtshan dpe dang ldan pa'i gang zag la ni sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma khyab sne/ 'khor sgrur dang byang sems rgyun mtha' ba la de yo+od pa'i phyir / dang po de ltar yin te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ nyakhar la bsgrur ba thams cad la/ /'di dag yod pa 'dod mod kyis/ /dag dang mdzes dang gsal ba ni/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i

skabs brgyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 229phyir / gnyis pa yang grub ste/ rgyun mtha' ba'i mchasan dpes longs sku'i mtshan dpe rnams kyi dngos rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa dpe byad ni/ zub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang / / zhes pa nas/sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang per bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ 'chad 'gyur ltar brgyad cu po 'di chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang por bzhed de/ de yang thubaripa'i sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu dang / de'i mdog snum pa dang / de rmatho ba dang / sor mo rnams zlum pa dang / de rgyas pa dang / de byin gyis phra ba dang / lus kyi rtsa mi mngon pa dang / de mdud pa med pa dang / long bu mi mngon pa dang /zhabs ring thung mnyam pa ste bcu dang / seṅge'i dari / gla chen gyi dang /bya ngang pa'i dang / khyu mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa dang / g.yas phyogs su gshegs pa dang / mdzes par gshegs pa dang / drang ba dang /sku 'khril bag chags pa 'dra ba dang / byi dor byas pa dag 'dra ba dang /sbom phra sogs rim par 'tshams pa ste bcu dang / sku gtsang ba dang /'jam pa dang / sku dag pa dang / mtshan ni cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sku yi rgya khyon rgya che ba'i kho lag yangs shiri bzang ba dang / gom

230 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/pa che chung med par mnyam pa dang / spyan gnyis ni ra ri sogs med pa'i dag pa dang / sku shin tu gzhon sha can nyid dang / sku zhum pa med pa dang / sku rgyas pa ste bcu dang / sku shin tu grims pa nyid kyi khyad par dang /yan lag dang nying lag tshigs ring thung gi cha shas shin tu rnam par 'byes pa ste rnam par phyed pa dang / gzigs pa glo bur gyi sgrib pa med par dag pa dang / sged skabs mtshams kyi dku zlum pa dang / dku skabs phyin pa dang / dku ha cang mi 'dibs pa ste/ ma rnyongs pa dang / phyal lam lto ba mtho dman med par phyang nge ba dang / lce ba ni gting zab pa dang / lce ba'i ri mo g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba dang / sbyod lam kun nas lta na sdug pa ste bcu dang / kun spyod gtsang ba dang / sku la ni rme ba'i gnag bag med pa dang / phyag sna shing ba la ltar 'jam pa dang / phyag mis mdangs yod pa dang / zab pa dang / ring ba dang / zhal ni ha cang mi ring ba dang /mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar ba dang / ljargas gnyen pa dang / de srab pa ste bcu dang / ljags dmar ba dang / gsung 'brug gi sgra lta bu nyid dang /gsung snyan cing 'jam pa dang / mche ba rlum pa dang / de rno ba dang / de dkar ba dang / de ming thung mnyam pa dang / de byin gyis phra ba dang /shangs gzengs mtho ba dang / de snabs sogs kyi mchog tu dag pa dag

skabs brgyad pa'i snyik+ka/ 231dang ni bcu dang / spyan yangs pa dang / rdzi ma sdug pa dang / spyan pad+ma'i 'dab ma rangs pa 'dra ba dang / smin tshugs ring ba dang / smin ma 'jam pa dang / de snum pa dang / de'i spu ni mnyam pa dang / phyag ring zhi rgyas pa dang / snyan ring zung sogs mnyam pa dang / snyan gyi dbang po nyams pa rnam par spangs pa ste bcu dang / dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang / de dbyes che ba dang / dbu rgyas pa dang / dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa dang /sdug pa dang / de 'jam pa dang / de ma 'dzings pa dang / de mi ga ོra ba dang /tsho de dri zhim pas skyes bu yi yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang / phyag zhabs kyi mthe bong la dpal gyi be'u dang / mthil la bkra shis pa'i g.yung drung 'khyil ba ste bcu dang bcas pa'i brgyad cus brgyan pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ bzhi pa mchog gi sprul sku bshad pa ni/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar/ /zhes pa nas/ thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ston pa shākya zub pa la sogs pa'i gzugs kyi sku gang gis rgyun mi chad par 'phrin las mdzad pa'i nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pas phye ba'i gzugs sku de ni chos can/ sprul sku yin te/ dus srid pa ji srid

232 mngon rtoges rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/bar dag ma dag gi 'gro ba du ma la dngos su snang ba'i sgo nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi phan pa sna tshogs pa dag dus mnyam du mdzad pa'i gzugs sku yin pa'i phyir/ sprul sku'i 'jog byed yod de/ nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pas rab tu phye ba'i gzugs sku de/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na gsum yod de/ bzobo sprul sku/ skye ba sprul sku/ mchog gi sprul sku dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum po'i mtshan gzhi yod de/ snon pas bze rwapa 'i shwa kame'i rnam par sprul pa de dang po/ dam pa tog dkar dang / dri za'i rgyal po rab dga'i rnam par sprul pa de gnyis pa/ ston pa shākya thub pa lta bu gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa mdzad pa 'phrin las bshad pa la gsum/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi chad par 'dod/ ces gsungs / 'di la tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/sprul pa'i sku dang ye shes chos sku 'di chos can/ khyod gnyis rgyun mi chad pa de bzhin du khyod gnyis kyi 'phrin las kyang rgyun mi chad du 'dod de/'gro ba'i don du srid pa ji srid bar 'jug pa'i rgyu tshogs dang lngan pa'i phyir / gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid yod de/

skabs brgyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 233rang rgyu ye shes chos sku'i bdag rkyen las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la po 'i sgo nas gnyis yod de/byed pa po la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dang / bya ba yul la yod pa'i de gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya mngon mtho nges legs la 'god pa'i 'phrin las ni sangs rgyas rang nyid la yod cing / de la bkod pa ni gdul bya'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir/ dper na/ sna res shing gcod pa'i byed las ni sta re la yod cing / shing gcad pa'i bya ba ni shing nyid la yod pa bzhin no/ /bya ba yul la yod pa'i 'phrin las yin na gdul bya'i rgyud la yod pas ma khyab ste / sangs rgyas kyis sems can gang sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod pa'i tshe bya ba'i 'phrin las de sangs rgyas kyi sa na yad pa'i phyir/ gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan gyi 'phrin las ni lam zhugs kyi dbang du mdzad kyang / sbyir sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las ni lam ma zhugs na'ang yod de/ gdul bya'i rgyud la lamadang dge sems sna gcig skyes pa yang sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las su bshad pa'i phyir/ gang zag gzhan du ma zad/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud la'ang sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las yod de/ sangs rgyas kyis de'i don yang mdzad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des sems can thams cad kyi don

234 mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnyis pa la/ lam dang lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa gnyis / dang po ni/ 'gro rnams zhi ba'i las dang ni/ /zhes pa nas/ tha dad yongs su mi shes dang / /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'dir bsnan pa'i 'phrin las chos can/ khyod la nyer drug yod de/ 'gro ba rnams thar pa don gnyer gyi bsam pa cho+ogs lam la 'god pa dang /thog ma de bzhin du sbyar te bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i tshogs lam la 'god pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rgyu 'bras sdug kun dang bcas pa'i dor bya dang rnam par byang ba'i rgyu 'bras blang byar rtogs pa'i tshogs lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las gsumodang / sems can rnams kyi don du gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin gyi don rtogs pa'i sbyor lam la 'god pa'i de dang / sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i sbyor lam la dang / sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i lam dge ba bcu'i sbyor lam la dang / don dam par rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid sgom byung gis rtogs pa'i sbyor lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las bzhi dang / gnyis snang gi spros pa thams cad zad pa'i stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las gcig dang / chos thams cad brda tsam gyis btags par rtogs pa'i sa

skabs brgyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 235gnyis pa'i tshul khrims kyi nyams len la 'god pa dang / chos thams cad de ltar rtogs pa'i sa gsum pa'i bzod pa'i nyams len la 'god pa la gnyis bsnoms pas gcig dang / chos thams cad deni dmopar dmigs pa med par rtogs pa'i sa bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa gsum la 'god pa'i 'phrin las gcig dang / lus can rnams sna yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i sa bdun pa'i thabs mkhas la 'god pa'i 'phrin las gcig dang /sa brgyad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam nyan rang gi lam shes pa'i lam shes la 'god pa dang / bden par mngon par zhen pa mngon 'gyur ba bzlog pa'i sa brgyad pa la dang / sangs rgyas dkon mchog btags pa ba'i byang chub thob pa'i sa brgyad pa dang /gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i sa brgyad pa la 'god pa ste bzhi dang / theg dman du mi snung bar 'tshang rgya bar nges pa'i sa dgu pa la dang / sems can gyi don ni tshad med pa sgrub pa'i sa dgu pa la 'god pa gnyis pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas la brten nas de la chos nyan pa sogs kyis yon tan dang / byang chub kyi yan lag sgrub pa'i sa bcu pa la dang / las phra rags rnams ni chud mi za bar rtogs pa'i de la dang / bden bzhi rdzogs par mngon sum du mthong ba'i de la dang / phung po gtsang bde rtag bdag tu

236 mngon rtogasargyan gyi ṭik+ka/'dzin pa'i phyin ci log ni spangs pa'i de la dang / phyin ci log bzhi po de bskyed pa'i gzhi sne rgyu bden 'dzin med pa'i tshul la dang / chos thams cad bden stong mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rnalobyang rdzogs pa'i de ladang /byang chub kyi rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i de la dang / 'dus byas 'khor ba dang 'dus ma byas mya ngan las 'das pa la don dam par tha dad du yongs su mi shes par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sa bcu pa la 'godi pa'i 'phrin las dang dgu ste dag sal 'god pa'i 'phrin lasabaco lngayod pa'i phyir /tsho gnyis pa ni/ mya ngan las 'das la 'godi pa ste/ /zhesagasungs/don ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa gcig yod de/mchog gi sprul skus gdul bya rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la 'god pa'i 'phrin las bcug yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/chos kyi sku yi 'phrin las ni/ /rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed/ /ces gsungs / don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bsnan pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku yi 'phrin las ni rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun du bzhed pa yin te/ gong du bshad pa ltar tshogs lam la gsum/ sbyor lam la bzhi/ mthong lam la gcig sa gnyis pa dang gsum pa la gcig bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa gsum la gcig bdun pa la gcig brgyad pa la bzhi/ dgu pa la

skabs brgyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 237gnyis / bcu pa la dgu sangs rgyas kyi sar gcig ste nyer bdun du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /༈ gsum pa bsdus don gzhan la/ drug tu bsdu ba dang /gsum du bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs / shes bya chos can/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi don brgyad bsnan pa las don bsdus gzhan rnam pa drug tu shes par bya ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi ngo ra gyur pa'i mtshan nyid dang / mkhyen gsum de yi nyams su len byed rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang / rnam rdzogs sbyor ba de rab tu gyur pa'i rtse mo sbyor ba dang / mkhyen gsum gyi de yi nyams len gyi go rim mthar gyis sbyor ba dang / mkhyen gsum de yi sbyor ba mthar zug pa'i skad cig sbyor ba dang / mkhyen gsum de yi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chos sku dang ni drug tu shes par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa don gsum du bsdu ba ni/ yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu/ /zhes pa nas/ don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum / / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ mkhyen pa rnam pa gsum po chos can/sbyor ba'i bsgom bya'i yul ni yin te/ de'i nyams su blang bya yin pa'i phyir / sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid chos can/ mthar thug gi mkhyen gsum

238 mngon rtogs rgyan gyiṭik+ka/de'i rgyu yin te/ de thob byed kyi thabs yin pa'i phyir/ chos sku dang 'phrin las chos can/ mkhyen gsum sbyor ba'i 'bras bu yin te/ de'i stobs kyis thob pa'i thob bya yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir yum bcigam gyi don bsdus snga ma las don bsdus bzhan rnam pa ba'i/ma du bstan pa yin te/ yul dang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam pa gsum du bsdus nas bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bsdus don drug dang gsum du byas pa'i tshe rgyas bshad kyi skabasakyang de dang mthun par drug dang gsum du 'byed dgos te/bsdus don brgyad du phye ba la skabs brgyad 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa kun/ /ji bzhin gsal mdzad mi pham mgon gyi gsung / /bsnan bcos chen po 'di las gzhan na gang / /'di yi chig 'grel mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i/ /yig cha rgyas pa sngon du bris pa las/ /tshig 'grel 'di nyid logs su bkol byas nas/ /rang dang dad lngan gzhan ched par du bsgrubs/ /gang 'di'i dgongs don 'grel la rang nyid kyis/ /sgo gsum 'bad las thebo pa'i dge des bdag /tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun byams mgon gyis/ /thugs rjes 'bral med rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo//zhes pa 'di 'ang shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas dad

skabs brgyad pa'i ṭik+ka/ 239pas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa'i gsung par 'di bzhin ser smad grwa tshang gi mkhas grub chen po bstan pa dar rgyas kyi yig cha bzhir bzung sne yig cha'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus rnams spros bshad dang / kha skong / mtha' dpyod/ zun mong min pa'i khas len mi gsal ba rnams 'dir gsal yod par brten snga dus blo gsal ba rnams nas yig cha dang bzung sbrel gsan sbyong mdzad mus dang / mkho gnad kyang shin tu che rung / gsung par co ne dgon chen du bzhugs pa dus 'gyur dbang gis sngar nas me bzhis zin 'dug pas da phan slob gnyer ba'i khrod du yig cha dkone gshis grwa tshang mkhan po rgyal rong blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / dge bshes/ slob gnyer ba rnams nas yig cha cha tshang gsung par yig 'grub thabs thugs gnyer che ba dang bcas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun phan bde'i rtsa ba 7rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bsnan rnga/ rin po che bshad sgrub dar rgyas gong 'phel yun ring du gnas ched ser smad gzhung pa grwa sku bcar mkhan drungatā bla ma rong rnam sras pa zub bsnan nor bzang shag tshang nas lhag bsam rnam par dag pas rgyu sbyor 'du 'god kyis gong gsal yig cha co de'i par rnying khungs dag rang la ma phyi byas te rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcagasapho stag lor gsung par du legs bskrun chog grwa tshang 'di nyid

240 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/kyi chos mdzod du bzhugs sus gsol ba'o/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i sa bon legs smin thub pa'i ring lugs yangs su 'du'i ljon/ /bstan 'dzin rkang drug bye ba rnamartsen kun dga'i me tog phyogs mthar rgyas/ /ma nor lam bzang 'bras bu'i khur chen bstan srid 'gro phan zungs su dud / / bla med zhi ba'i sgrab bamail snum por 'gro ba ma lus dbugs 'byin shog / sarba maṅga lam̐/ /

241༈ dpar byang smon tshig /zag med rnam grol 'bras bu'i rin chen mdzod/ /thar 'dod blo gsal bye ba'i dga' ston du/ /'bad med lhug por dbye ba'i legs bshad 'di / / dag gsal dpar gyi ri mor drangs pa'i dges/ /thub bsnan bye ba'i yang snying tsong kha pa'i/ /lugs bzang mtha' yas phan bde'i byin du rgyas / / gangs can mgos po'i 'phrin las nyi zla'i rlabs/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lor rdzogs par gdal gyur cig /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin mtho ris dga' tshal du/ /bgrode byed ri mo 'god pa'i skye rgu kun/ /phan tshun byams brtse'i mdza' bas lag sprel te/ /dga' bdes myong pa'i zlos gar rtsen gyur cig /dmar ser mdangs 'dzin 'jam mgon mi yi gar/ blo bzang bzhed gzhung ma smad rgya mtsho cher/ /thos dang bsam sgom bsam 'phel nor gyi bu'i/ /gter brgya 'dzam gling dpal du 'dzin gyur cig /rgyu sbyor nyid kyang deng nas byang chen bar/ /mkhasaudang grub pa'i khyu mchog rten bzang brgyud/ /thub bstan yang snying 'jam mgoni lugs bzang 'di / / nam yang mi 'bral byang chub myur zob shog /ces pa 'di yang bkrin zla med 7skyabs rje yangs 'dzin khri byang rdo rje 'chang chen po mchog gis sngone nas bka' brjodi zin pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du zhus pa'o// //

242 mngoni rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/dmigs bsal re bskul/phyag dpe 'di ser smad dpe mdzod khang nas chog mchan bka' khrol med par sus kyang dpar bskrun zhus mi chogamangon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭik+ka/zhus dag pa/sgomar mkhan nur rin po che blo bzang dngos grub mchogagatsang rgan blo bzang dpal ldan lags/ gtsang chos rgyal/spomakhar dge bshes thub kun/ mkhas btsun dang byams chos sogs/deb gzugs phyogs bsgrigs pa/ser smad dpe mdzod khang gi kam bu ṭar sde tshan/ser smad dpe mdzod khang gi kam pu ṭar sde tshan nas par rtsa bsgrigs/ser smad dpe mdzod khang nas 1lngaṭha7 lor par du bskrun/ser smad dpe mdzod khang gi phyag dpe blu yon khang gis bkram/
